🪐 Discover our galaxy
 
Join the Future of Work ! Malt is Europe's leading freelance marketplace, connecting over 1,000,000 talented freelancers with 100,000+ companies. Founded in 2013, we're transforming how work gets done through our tech-powered, human-centered platform. What makes us different:
 
- A diverse team of 600 Malters across 6 European countries

Ready to help shape the future of work? Your next chapter starts here! 🪐

Explore your future career  🔭

 
Join our Finance Operations team as an Intern and gain hands-on experience in a fast-paced, international environment!
 
With a dedicated focus on the Spanish market, your core mission will be to help manage the complete order-to-cash cycle for our clients in Spain, while also working on team projects to improve our day-to-day operations. 
You'll ensure smooth financial workflows, making a tangible impact on our business in this region.
 
This internship is a unique opportunity for a curious, proactive, and motivated individual—fluent in Spanish—eager to learn and develop new skills.

Key responsibilities ✨

Management of the Order to Cash activity :

  • Help in managing the invoicing process for our various Spanish clients.

  • Ensure that invoices are timely, accurate and complete, in line with our model and customer expectations.

  • Collaborate with other departments to ensure billing accuracy: accounting, sales, legal

  • Manage customer support on issues relating to purchase orders, invoicing/payment and management of specific off-platform invoicing (credit notes).

  • Reconciliation of customer payments and cash collection of payment notices.

  • Collecting invoices due and overdue and ensuring that payment deadlines are met.

  • Innovation / Process automation : Optimize current financial processes and help the team to reduce manual process and scale.


About you 🧑‍🚀

  • You are currently enrolled in a business school or similar and looking for a full-time 6-month-internship starting from January 2026

  • Having knowledge in finance / administration or a first experience in that field is a big plus !

  • You are proactive, organized and responsible.

  • We are looking for someone eager to learn and discover the freelance world.

  • You have a good command of Excel (ENI, VBA certifications are a plus).

  • You are fully fluent in Spanish and English to communicate with our Spanish-speaking colleagues as well as our clients.


How to join the mission? 🚀

  • First call with Sarah, our Talent Acquisition Manager, to better understand your background, aspirations and answer any questions you may have. . (30-45 minutes)

  • Home assignment for you to complete in order to assess your technical skills

  • Final interview with a C-level executive to discuss Malt’s long-term vision

Malt is the perfect space to thrive personally and professionally 💫
 
- Onboarding: Before easing into your new role, you’ll spend your first week learning about our culture, products, and services with other onboardees at our office in Paris
- Paid vacation - 1 paid day/month worked for interns, 5 weeks/year for apprenticeships

jobs.title: Staff Information Security Manager (w/m/d)
jobs.description:
Bei IONOS arbeitest Du bei dem führenden europäischen Anbieter von Cloud-Infrastruktur, Cloud-Services und Hosting-Dienstleistungen partnerschaftlich mit unterschiedlichen Teams zusammen. Wir bieten Dir eine Perspektive in einer der zukunftssichersten Branchen. Uns zeichnen offene Arbeitsstrukturen, Duz-Kultur und flache Hierarchien mit unvergleichlichem Team-Spirit aus. Wir sind fest davon überzeugt, dass Job und Spaß vereinbar sind und bieten Dir hierfür das entsprechende Umfeld. Bei ständigem Wachstum sind wir stets auf der Suche nach neuen Teammitgliedern. Werde Teil von IONOS und lass uns gemeinsam wachsen.

Wenn du an diesem ständig pulsierenden Arbeitsumfeld interessiert bist und Cybersicherheit für dich mehr als nur ein Modewort ist, bist du bei uns genau richtig.

Aufgabenbereich

  • Verantwortung für die Sicherheitszertifizierungsstrategie und die damit verbundenen Standardisierungsstrategien.
  • Strukturierung von Standardisierungs- und Zertifizierungsaktivitäten sowie die Vorbereitung für die Skalierung auf mehr internationalen Märkten.
  • Einführung von Zertifizierungsreadness-Routinen in interne Entwicklungs-, Betriebs- und andere organisatorische Einheiten, die in Zertifizierungsbereichen arbeiten.
  • Verantwortung für strategische Projekte sowie Förderung der Schnittstellen zu unseren Kunden und dem Business.
  • Teilnahme und Unterstützung bei Zertifizierungen und Attestierungen, die von Zertifizierungsteams durchgeführt werden.

Qualifikationen

  • Grundsolide, mehrjährige praktische Erfahrung mit standardisierten Managementsystemen und Zertifizierungen, Attestierungen im Bereich Cybersicherheit.
  • Du hast praktische Erfahrung aus zwei oder mehr zertifizierten Bereichen nach ISO 27001, IT-Grundschutz, BSI C5, PCI. Weitere Erfahrung mit ISO-Managementsystemen aus Datenschutzstandards ist ein Plus.
  • Du hast mehrjährige Erfahrung mit den oben genannten Standards und Zertifizierungen in einer technischen Organisation, wie in einem Unternehmen, das technische Produkte anbietet, mit Nerds.
  • Du brennst für die moderne, tool-gestützte, effiziente Integration von Managementsystemen und Zertifizierungsaktivitäten in den täglichen Routineablauf einer Organisation.
  • Du bringst intrinsische Motivation und Leidenschaft für die Arbeit mit, auch um dein Know-How kontinuierlich auf dem neuesten Stand zu halten.
  • Du liebst Technologie, scheust dich nicht vor Dokumentation, aber möchtest sie so effizient wie möglich strukturieren.
  • Du überzeugst durch deine selbstsichere und kommunikative Art, wenn du zielorientierte Ergebnisse mit deinen internationalen und internen Schnittstellen erreichst.
  • Du führst Diskussionen auf Englisch (CEFR C1 oder höher) sicher und sprichst außerdem vollkommen fließendes Deutsch (mindestens C2).

Benefits

  • Hybrides Arbeitsmodell mit Homeoffice-Möglichkeit.
  • Flexible Arbeitszeiten durch Vertrauensarbeitszeit.
  • An einigen Standorten eine bezuschusste Kantine und verschiedene kostenfreie Getränke.
  • Moderne Büroflächen mit sehr guter Verkehrsanbindung.
  • Diverse Mitarbeiterrabatte für Aktivitäten und Produkte.
  • Mitarbeiterevents wie Sommer- und Winterfeiern, sowie Workshops.
  • Zahlreiche Weiterbildungs- und Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten.
  • Verschiedene Gesundheitsangebote, wie Sport- und Gesundheitskurse.

Über IONOS

IONOS ist der führende europäische Digitalisierungs-Partner für kleine und mittlere Unternehmen (KMU). IONOS hat mehr als sechs Millionen Kundinnen und Kunden und ist mit einer weltweit verfügbaren Plattform in 18 Märkten in Europa und Nordamerika aktiv. Mit seinen Web Presence & Productivity-Angeboten agiert das Unternehmen als “One-Stop-Shop" für alle Digitalisierungs-Bedürfnisse - von Domains und Webhosting über klassische Website-Builder und Do-It-Yourself-Lösungen, von E-Commerce bis zu Online-Marketing-Tools. Darüber hinaus bietet IONOS Cloud-Lösungen für Firmen, die im Zuge der Weiterentwicklung ihres Geschäfts in die Cloud wechseln möchten.

Wir wertschätzen Vielfalt und begrüßen alle Bewerbungen – unabhängig von z. B. Geschlecht, Nationalität, ethnischer und sozialer Herkunft, Religion, Behinderung, Alter sowie sexueller Orientierung und Identität, körperlichen Merkmalen, Familienstand oder einem anderen sachfremden Kriterium nach geltendem Recht.

jobs.description:
Who we are

Alecto is the UK's first AI-native law firm.

 

Our mission is to make the law accessible to everyone on the planet. We believe that the quality of service currently offered by the legal profession is woefully inadequate. It delivers bad value for money, frustrates the people it exists to serve, and lacks basic accountability.

We believe that a law firm should:

  • Speak in language people actually understand.

  • Equip people to make informed decisions on the issues that matter to them.

  • Provide an empathetic, proactive service aligned with people's end goals, not billable hours.

 

We're starting with conveyancing; the legal service that consumers are most likely to need, and the one most desperately in need of change. Conveyancing today is slow, opaque, and failing. One in three property transactions fall through, complaints run 3.3x higher than any other legal sector, and many firms still rely on post and fax. We're working hard to change that.

 

Backed by Firstminute Capital and a strong group of angel investors, we’re led by a founder who built and scaled Gen H, a fintech mortgage lender, to £1bn in annual lending and £5bn in financing. That hands-on experience in regulated financial services gives us a clear path to disrupt a fragmented £2.5 billion market. Our ambition is to build a full-service, AI-first law firm with global reach.

The Role

We're hiring qualified residential conveyancers of all experience levels to manage purchase and sale transactions in England & Wales.

You’ll be expected to manage high-volume caseloads while delivering outstanding legal work and customer service. You'll work with proprietary AI tools that handle routine tasks, freeing you to focus on complex legal issues and client relationships.

  • Location: Work from home as standard, with the option to work from our London office.

  • Hours: Manage your own hours so long as you make yourself available for your clients and attend key company meetings.

  • Reports to: Head of Legal Practice or Team Lead.

What to Expect

  • Real impact: Improve the way people navigate some of life’s most important moments.

  • Ownership: You'll have real responsibility from day one.

  • High standards: We don't compromise on quality. You'll have support from technology and colleagues, but we expect excellence.

  • Fast pace: We move quickly. Our technology evolves rapidly. You'll need to adapt and embrace continuous improvement.

  • Transparent assessment: Your performance will be measured across quality of legal work, customer satisfaction scores, transaction speed, and case volume. All metrics are clearly defined and tracked.

  • Direct feedback: You'll get thoughtful feedback regularly, with monthly performance reviews.

  • Career progression: Advancement and pay increases are based entirely on results delivered, not tenure or other attributes.

Who Thrives Here

We’d love to talk to you if you’re:

  • Relentless: You're never satisfied with good enough. You push yourself to improve constantly, and you measure your progress.

  • Uncompromising: You have incredibly high standards. You sweat the details. You take pride in your work even when no one's watching. You speak up when standards slip.

  • Accountable: You own outcomes. You fix problems rather than waiting for someone else to. You want to be measured on your impact.

  • Humble: Low ego. Self-critical. Open to feedback. You change your mind with new information. You give honest feedback directly and kindly.

  • Optimistic: You approach problems as solvable. You find opportunity in challenges. You energise and elevate the people around you.

And you believe that

  • Consumers deserve much higher quality service than the conveyancing industry delivers today.

  • Technology is essential to doing better, not a threat to the profession.

  • Change is coming and carries huge potential with it.

Compensation & Benefits

We have a fully transparent pay scale for each role.

  • Salary range: Up to £100,000 (dependent on levelling).

  • Bonus: Up to 50% of base salary, paid semi-annually based on performance metrics.

  • Pension: 5% employer contributions.

  • Health insurance: Comprehensive private medical cover including dental and optical.

  • Holiday: 25 days plus bank holidays.

  • CPD: Full support for CLC CPD requirements and professional development.

Interview process:

  • Initial screening call

  • Critical Thinking Assessment

  • Skills Assessment

  • Values & Culture interview

We review applications on a rolling basis and aim to respond within 2 working days.

 

Compensation: £30K – £100K • Dependent on levelling

We're not your average benefits platform; we're the unordinary force that uplifts people's lives. Our technology is the link that connects the entire benefits ecosystem, creating better outcomes for employers, employees, brokers, and providers.

Our mission is clear: we're here to create a world where everything operates at its very best, ensuring that every employee receives the support they need to live life to the fullest, both at work and beyond.


Your Mission

As a backend leaning Full-stack Engineer at Ben, you’ll help build and scale the features that power our platform from benefits browsing and payments to provider integrations and smart admin tooling.

You’ll take features from idea to production: understanding the problem, scoping solutions, building, shipping, and making sure what you deliver truly solves the need. You won’t just be handed tickets, you'll contribute to shaping why we build things, how we build them, and what the future of our product looks like.

You’ll collaborate across product, design, and engineering to make decisions that matter: data models, integration patterns, API design, scalability choices, and how we support a system used by hundreds of thousands of people. At Ben, everything is connected so what you build helps power payroll workflows, provider integrations, notifications, and everything in between.

And you’ll do all this as part of a fun, fast-moving startup, spending 2 days a week with the team in our Barbican office.


Things you will be working on…

  • Build and ship backend-leaning fullstack features across the product (APIs, services, integrations, and React frontend)

  • Are pragmatic and can balance shipping fast with thoughtful engineering

  • Work closely with product managers to understand context and shape solutions early

  • Collaborate with designers to create polished, intuitive experiences

  • Contribute to technical discovery, architecture thinking, and implementation planning

  • Ask product and UX questions when something doesn't quite add up

  • Design with scale, reliability, and enterprise readiness in mind (security, compliance, flexibility)

  • Own your work from idea to production and care about the impact once it’s live

  • Help improve developer experience, tooling, and internal standards

  • Are comfortable in Python and TypeScript (or excited to learn quickly)

  • Care about solving real user problems, not just closing tasks

  • Enjoy collaborating directly with PMs and designers without needing perfect specs

  • Like figuring out the how with autonomy and the why with curiosity

  • Know what it means to build for enterprise scale

  • Are pragmatic able to balance scrappy shipping with thoughtful engineering

Our mission is to make first contact with superintelligence.

We are creating a superlearner that discovers all knowledge from its own experience, from elementary motor skills through to profound intellectual breakthroughs. This superlearning capability - the ability to endlessly discover knowledge and skills, without relying on human data - will be driven by the world’s most powerful reinforcement learning algorithms.

The superlearner is expected to rediscover and then transcend the greatest inventions in human history, such as language, science, mathematics and technology. You'll own the infrastructure that the mission depends on; keeping large-scale GPU compute reliable, developer environments fast and the whole platform humming.

jobs.description:
Lead ClickHouse Engineer

Remote (UK-based) | Full-Time

About Us

Reactive Markets is the 2026 OTC Trading Platform of the Year (Risk.net). Our network handles over $50 billion in daily trading volumes across FX, Equities, and Cryptocurrency, connecting 40+ of the world's leading liquidity providers.

We build trading systems that operate at the edge of what's technically possible — where nanoseconds matter and a dropped message costs real money. Our engineering team is small, senior, and deeply invested in the craft of building cutting edge, reliable, high-performance systems.

 

The Role

We're looking for a Lead ClickHouse Engineer to own our data plant: a multi-datacentre, multi-AZ ClickHouse cluster ingesting billions of rows a day, underpinning compliance, billing, and a growing family of real-time and historical analytics.

This is a core-platform engineering role, not a DBA role. You'll own the full engineering scope of a serious ClickHouse estate: cluster operations and upgrades, schema and sorting-key design, materialised views, ingestion performance, query optimisation, workload isolation, capacity planning, storage tiering, backup and recovery, monitoring and alerting, and production support. You'll also set direction and work on the data pipelines around the plant — our capture services are Go, and our analytics foundation is Python.

Beyond your own technical ownership, you'll set the standard for how the estate is run, mentor the engineers who work alongside you, and ensure the plant is genuinely supportable by a team rather than dependent on any one person — including yourself.

You don't need years of ClickHouse specifically — deep experience with another columnar or large-scale time-series database qualifies you, and a strong columnar engineer learns our estate quickly. What we do need is genuine operational depth: you have run a production data platform, owned its capacity plan and its recovery procedures, and stayed calm when it mattered.

This hire helps create a follow-the-sun team — so the platform is supported across time zones rather than by heroics. On-call is a shared, contracted responsibility, planned and paid — not goodwill.

What You'll Work On

  • Cluster operations at scale — running, upgrading and evolving a multi-AZ ClickHouse estate on Kubernetes, with rehearsed backup and recovery

  • Schema and query engineering — table and sorting-key design, partitioning, materialised views, and query optimisation against multi-terabyte datasets

  • Capacity and observability — a measured capacity model, storage tiering and retention, and the Grafana monitoring and alerting that keeps the plant's health visible

  • Ingestion and data quality — correctness and completeness gates on the pipelines feeding the plant; reconciliation that proves nothing was dropped

  • Workload isolation — keeping ingest, operations, reporting and ad-hoc analytics from treading on each other as read load grows

  • Team and knowledge leadership — mentoring the engineer(s) working on the estate, setting standards for runbooks and documentation, and making the plant supportable by the team, not the author

  • AI-assisted operations — modern tooling (including MCP-based AI access to the estate) that lets a small team run a large platform well

What We Need

Technical:

  • Columnar/OLAP database engineering — ClickHouse strongly preferred; deep experience with another columnar or large-scale time-series store (BigQuery, Redshift, Druid, kdb+ or similar) also works

  • A track record of owning architectural decisions for a production data platform, not just operating within one someone else designed

  • SQL depth — execution plans, query optimisation, and schema design for very large datasets

  • Operational/SRE experience — you have carried production responsibility for a data platform: monitoring, capacity, incidents, recovery

  • Linux and Kubernetes — comfort with the operational layer beneath the database

  • A programming language — one of Python, Go, R, or MATLAB (Python preferred)

  • Engineering discipline — you write proposals, strategies, and architectural documents and diagrams well, and you manage change properly

  • Git — excellent version-control practice

  • Distributed-systems fundamentals — replication, consistency, failure modes

About Us

Reactive Markets is the 2026 OTC Trading Platform of the Year (Risk.net). Our network handles over $50 billion in daily trading volumes across FX, Equities, and Cryptocurrency, connecting 40+ of the world's leading liquidity providers.

We build trading systems that operate at the edge of what's technically possible — where nanoseconds matter and a dropped message costs real money. Our engineering team is small, senior, and deeply invested in the craft of building cutting edge, reliable, high-performance systems.

The Role

We're looking for a Senior C++ Software Engineer who can shape the technical direction of our Switchboard trading platform while continuing to write excellent code. You'll work on the most performance-critical components — pricing engines, connectivity gateways, market-data systems, and the messaging layer that ties them together — and you'll have a direct influence on architectural decisions that affect the entire platform.

This is not a role where you write code and throw it over a wall. You build it, you test it, you deploy it, you support it in production, and you improve it. Our engineers own the full lifecycle — from design through to operational excellence. When something breaks at 4pm on a Friday, you're part of the team that investigates and fixes it.

Beyond your own delivery, you'll provide technical oversight across the team — reviewing designs, challenging assumptions, and mentoring engineers who are earlier in their careers. You'll help us maintain the quality bar that our clients depend on, and you'll contribute to the architectural decisions that determine how well our platform scales.

Occasional hours outside the normal working day are required for production releases, scheduled maintenance windows, and Level 3 support during critical incidents. We keep this to a minimum and recognise the commitment — but owning a production trading platform means being there when it matters.

What You'll Work On

  • Modern C++20 and Go on Linux — a modern software stack based on open source

  • Cloud-native infrastructure on AWS with colocation in key data centres

  • Microsecond-level latency optimisation and high-throughput messaging

  • Market-data and reference-data pipelines across multiple asset classes

  • FIX protocol integrations with global banks and liquidity providers

  • Observability and monitoring — dashboards, alerting, and metrics that make system behaviour visible

  • Production systems that handle real money — reliability is not optional

  • Architectural oversight — solution design, peer reviews, and technical direction for platform components

  • Mentorship — helping junior and mid-level engineers develop their skills, improve their code, and grow into stronger contributors

  • Deep understanding of distributed systems architecture and network protocols (TCP/UDP, socket programming, FIX)

  • Experience with system design and architectural trade-offs — you've made decisions that stuck and lived with the consequences

  • Go experience is a strong bonus — we use Go extensively for microservices and command-line tooling, and you'll be expected to work with it internally. If you don't know it yet, strong C++ engineers pick it up quickly

  • You mentor. You invest in the engineers around you — sharing knowledge, pairing on hard problems, and helping people grow. You make the team better, not just the code

  • You write things down. Documentation is not an afterthought — it's how we scale knowledge across a distributed team. If it's not written down, it doesn't exist

  • You communicate. We're a distributed team across multiple time zones. Clear, proactive communication — especially when things go wrong — is essential

jobs.title: VP Finance
jobs.description:
Can you help us fix the world’s most broken supply chain?

The fashion industry produces over 100 billion garments a year. 60% end up in landfill — not because people don’t want these clothes, but because the supply chain for getting secondhand fashion from donation to resale is completely offline, manual, and broken.

Fleek is fixing this. Our mission is to make secondhand the first choice. We’re building the infrastructure powering the global secondhand clothing trade — through a B2B marketplace and the AI systems digitising the supply chain behind it.

Through Fleek, vintage stores, online resellers, and retail buyers source graded secondhand inventory directly from wholesalers and rag houses across multiple countries. Our key enabler is FleekSort — an AI model fine-tuned on secondhand fashion — that can grade, price, and categorise items with just a photo, turning what has historically been an opaque and manual trade into a structured, searchable, and tradable global inventory layer.

Since 2022, we've saved 9 million items from landfill while tripling in size year-on-year. We're backed by some of the world's best investors, including a16z, Y Combinator, and HV Capital, alongside world-class angels who helped build Depop, Shopify, and Postmates.

Today, we serve thousands of resellers and retailers across the UK, Europe, and the US. With the secondhand fashion market projected to reach $350B by 2027, Fleek is building the AI-native operational and financial backbone for secondhand commerce globally.

We’re looking for people who want to build something that matters — and move fast doing it. Sound good? Keep reading.

About the Role

The VP Finance will be a core part of Fleek’s leadership team, responsible for bringing financial discipline into the business to ready it for further rapid scale. This finance leader will build on and professionalise Fleek’s finance operations, thinking commercially across the business, and supporting on future fundraising.

What you’ll Own

  • Building, leading and developing Fleek’s finance function globally

  • Owning company-wide financial planning and analysis, cash flow forecasting, and budgeting

  • Instilling rigorous financial controls, hygiene, and compliance in a rapidly scaling organisation

  • Driving strategy alongside the founders by turning financial data into decision-making tools

  • Building the best payment experience for Fleek’s retailers and suppliers,

  • Maintaining a strong bottom-line and financial stability for the business

  • Leading and growing finance teams in Pakistan (fin-ops), India (accounting/reporting), and UK (commercial finance)

  • Supporting future fundraising efforts and investor relations

Who We’re Looking For

  • Experience in scaling the financial function from Series A through to Series C stage (or beyond)

  • Hands on leadership in finance strategy, controls, and operations

  • Ability to hire and retain world-class talent

  • Demonstrated ability to set up and scale core finance processes

  • Strong understanding of long cash cycles, forecasting, and working capital

  • Global finance experience - managing cross-border payments and multi-currency operations

  • Fintech knowledge beneficial (especially around credit, payment processing)

  • Strong commercial and product instincts - viewing Finance as a growth function

  • Previous experience in supporting on fundraising

  • Startup mentality and intellectual curiosity - thriving in high autonomy and ambition environments

  • Deeply analytical: data-driven decision making is second nature

  • Insatiably curious: you're constantly learning about new tools, approaches, and market changes

  • Hungry and ambitious: you're driven to stay relevant and push boundaries

  • Change agent: you've driven transformation in previous organizations

  • Hands-on: you're not afraid to roll up your sleeves and do the work yourself

How We Work

Fleek is an in-office company. We believe the best work happens when people are together — the quick decisions, the cross-functional energy, the ability to solve problems in real time. Most of the team works from our London HQ 4 days a week.

We’re not prescriptive about it. Performance and trust matter more than attendance. For your first six months, we’ll ask you to prioritise being in the office, to learn the business, build relationships, and get up to speed. After that, you’ll have genuine flexibility to manage your own time. We hire adults and treat them accordingly.

The Practicalities

  • Location: London HQ — Heneage Street, E1 (Shoreditch / Aldgate East)

  • Work model: In Person, with trust based flexibility

  • Stage: Post-Series B, hyper-growth

  • Team: 100+ across London, India, and Pakistan (~20 in London office)

  • Culture: High ownership, non-hierarchical, fast-moving. Founder-led with strong opinions loosely held.

Our Values

Five values shape how we work at Fleek:

  • Dream Big and Disrupt Yourself: Push the most ambitious version of what you’re building. Step out of your comfort zone. Nothing is out of reach.

  • Absolute Ownership: The buck stops with you. Drive initiatives to completion. Experiment, learn, persevere. The job isn’t done until the job is done.

  • Curiosity Leads the Way: Don’t accept anything at face value. Ask questions you don’t know the answer to. That’s how you innovate.

  • Talk to the Customer: Deeply understand their challenges, motivations, and ambitions. Every decision starts with the customer at the centre.

  • Embrace Diversity: A global team building for a global supply chain. Bring your authentic self and embrace the diversity of everyone you encounter.

jobs.title: UX Designer, AI App
jobs.description:
About ActAI

There are over 5 billion users using basic applications today such email, notes, tasks, calendar and they're not AI-native. Our mission is to build proactive applications for anyone in the world, who are not used to complex prompting. We aim to bring intelligence to conversations, errands, organising and workflows, with minimal prompting.

Our product focuses on achieving high reliability for long-running workflows, persistent context, and real-world task completion. We believe products will greatly reduce hallucinations.

Our objective is to organise anyone's life, allowing us all to spend time on valuable and meaningful things.

 

Role

You will own the UX of ActAI's core app experience. This means designing the end-to-end flows users go through every day - how they start tasks, how they follow along as the AI works, how they stay in control, and how they recover when something goes wrong.

This is a UX role for a HCI product. You need to understand both user needs and AI system behavior well enough to design product flows that feel clear, reliable, and controllable.

 

What You'll Be Doing

  • Own UX for ActAI's core app surfaces across iOS, Android, and web.

  • Design complete user flows for AI-assisted tasks - from intent capture through to task completion, including handoff, progress tracking, and error recovery.

  • Design how the app surfaces what the AI is doing, what decisions it has made, and what the user needs to confirm or adjust.

  • Map and design the full range of AI states a user encounters - loading, thinking, acting, waiting, completing, stalling, failing, and recovering.

  • Work with product, engineering, and ML teams to define user requirements and translate them into concrete design solutions.

  • Conduct usability research to understand where users lose trust, feel uncertain, or disengage.

  • Produce wireframes, user flows, and high-fidelity designs that engineering can build from directly.

  • Contribute to the design system and shared UX patterns for AI app surfaces.

  • Design for both simple everyday interactions and complex multi-step AI workflows within the same product.

 

What You Will Need

  • Experience as a UX designer on consumer mobile or web apps, with a strong portfolio.

  • Solid skills in user flow design, wireframing, and high-fidelity prototyping in Figma.

  • Ability to design for systems that are asynchronous, non-deterministic, and context-dependent.

  • Clear thinking about user trust, control, feedback, and transparency in AI-driven product experiences.

  • Experience conducting user research and turning findings into design decisions.

  • Comfortable working in fast-moving teams with evolving product scope.

  • Ability to balance simple consumer UX with complex AI system behavior.

  • Good judgment on usability, edge cases, failure handling, and recovery flows.

 

How We Work

The best products today in the world were built by small, world class teams. We are a high talent density and hands-on team. We make decisions collectively, move at rapid speed, striking a balance between shipping high quality work and learning. Joining our team requires the ability to bring structure, exercise judgment, and execute independently. Our goal is to put in hands of our users a truly magical product

 

Interview process

For design roles, we expect candidates to submit a portfolio as part of the application process.

If there appears to be a fit, we'll reach out to schedule 2 rounds of interviews and a design assessment.

Applications are evaluated by our team members. Interviews will be conducted via virtual meetings and/or onsite.

We value transparency and efficiency, so expect a prompt decision. If you've demonstrated the exceptional skills and mindset we're looking for, we'll extend an offer to join us. This isn't just a job offer; it's an invitation to be part of a team that's bringing AI to have practical benefits to billions globally.

Stell dir vor, du startest deine Woche nicht mit langweiligen To-dos, sondern mit echten Accounts, die du eigenständig führst – von der Strategie bis zur Umsetzung in Klaviyo. Du planst Kampagnen, baust Automationen und bist der direkte Draht zu deinen Kunden. Dein Input landet nicht in einer PowerPoint, sondern geht live – und du siehst die Ergebnisse in Echtzeit im Umsatz der Brand.

Bei Mail Angel schiebst du keine internen Mails hin und her und sitzt nicht in endlosen Meetings. Du übernimmst Verantwortung für deine Kunden und ihre Kampagnen-Strategie, steuerst unsere Copy-, Design- und Tech-Spezialisten und arbeitest eng mit den Gründern zusammen. Du bekommst die Freiheit, eigene Ideen zu testen – und das Mentoring, um schnell zu wachsen, bis hin zu Führungsverantwortung.

Wir betreuen wachsende D2C-Brands wie Fairnatural, Apricot Beauty, HANS Brainfood und GoodMoodFood – und machen E-Mail & CRM zu einem ihrer stärksten Umsatzkanäle.

Wenn du E-Mail-Marketing nicht als Nebensache siehst, sondern als den Umsatzhebel, der es ist – dann bist du bei uns richtig.

Aufgaben

  • Du führst deine eigenen Kundenaccounts – von der Zielabstimmung über die Roadmap bis zum monatlichen Reporting.
  • Du baust Kampagnen & Automationen in Klaviyo selbst auf – das Design liefert dir unser Team, Copy holst du dir aus dem Team oder erstellst sie KI-gestützt. Die Qualität hast du im Griff.
  • Du bist der direkte Ansprechpartner für deine Kunden in Calls, Feedback-Runden und Strategie-Abstimmungen.Du behältst die Performance im Blick, analysierst Ergebnisse und leitest konkrete Optimierungen ab.
  • Du entwickelst eigene Ideen für Tests und neue Konzepte – und bringst sie live statt in die Theorie.
  • Du sorgst dafür, dass deine Kunden messbar mehr Umsatz und stärkere Kundenbindung erreichen.

Qualifikation

  • 1–3 Jahre Erfahrung im E-Mail-Marketing / CRM, idealerweise mit E-Commerce- oder D2C-Brands – nach oben offen, wenn du mehr mitbringst.
  • Du bist sicher darin, Kampagnen und Automationen selbst aufzubauen (Klaviyo – siehe Frage unten).
  • Kommunikationsstärke: Du berätst Kunden professionell und fühlst dich in Calls und Feedback-Runden wohl.
  • Strategisches Denken: Du erkennst, welche Maßnahmen wirklich Umsatz bringen, und setzt Prioritäten.
  • Gespür für gute Copy und sauberes Design – auch wenn Copy aus dem Team oder KI-gestützt entsteht und das Design vom Team kommt.
  • Lust auf KI-gestütztes Arbeiten: Du nutzt moderne Tools, um schneller und besser zu werden.
  • Sehr gutes Deutsch in Wort & Schrift, dazu solide Englischkenntnisse.
  • Eigenständig, zuverlässig, motiviert – bereit, Verantwortung zu übernehmen und fachlich zu wachsen.

Benefits

  • Klare Entwicklung: strukturierte Aufstiegsmöglichkeiten bis hin zu Führungsverantwortung – mit Mentoring direkt von den Gründern.
  • 100 % Remote & flexibel: arbeite von überall, ohne starre Bürozeiten.
  • 30 Tage Urlaub im Jahr – zum richtig Abschalten.
  • Moderne Ausstattung: MacBook und der komplette Tool- & KI-Stack, mit dem du wirklich schnell arbeitest.
  • Extras: nach der Probezeit monatlich 50 € auf deine Sachbezugskarte
  • Echte Nähe zum Team: kurze Wege, enge Zusammenarbeit mit den Gründern und ehrliches Interesse an deiner Weiterentwicklung.

Wenn du Lust hast, Teil von etwas zu werden, das nicht nur funktioniert, sondern wirklich etwas verändert, dann freuen wir uns, dich kennenzulernen.

Schreib uns gerne, welche Brand du feierst und warum du ihr E-Mail-Marketing stark findest.

Noch besser: Erzähl uns kurz, was du daran gut findest oder was du anders machen würdest.

jobs.title: Account Manager (m/w/d) für WLAN & IT-Infrastruktur
jobs.description:
Du kennst Deine Kunden und sie kennen Dich

Unsere Kunden betreiben ihr WLAN und ihre IT-Infrastruktur nicht für ein Projekt, sondern über Jahre. Genau da setzt diese Rolle an: Du betreust unsere Bestandskunden dauerhaft, kennst ihre Standorte, Verträge und Vorhaben und erkennst frühzeitig, wo Bedarf entsteht.
Dafür suchen wir jemanden, der Kundenbeziehungen aufbaut, pflegt und technisch mitdenkt. Keine Kaltakquise am Telefon, sondern echte Betreuung mit IT-Verständnis. Die Stelle ist sowohl in Vollzeit als auch in Teilzeit zu besetzen.

Aufgaben

  • Bestandskunden betreuen und entwickeln: Du bist feste Ansprechperson für einen eigenen Kundenkreis, führst regelmäßige Gespräche, verstehst die Situation vor Ort und sorgst dafür, dass unsere Kunden zufrieden bleiben.

  • Bedarf erkennen und Chancen nutzen: Du erkennst, wo Standorte wachsen, Hardware in die Jahre kommt oder zusätzliche Leistungen sinnvoll sind. Draus entwickelst du gemeinsam mit dem Kunden und unserem Team die nächsten Schritte.

  • Technisch vorqualifizieren: Du nimmst Anforderungen auf, steckst den Rahmen ab und bereitest die Themen so vor, dass unsere Technik direkt daran weiterarbeiten kann – von der WLAN-Ausleuchtung über Netzwerkerweiterungen bis zur Infrastruktur.

  • Angebote erarbeiten und begleiten: Du erstellst Angebote gemeinsam mit unseren Technikern, erklärst sie dem Kunden verständlich und begleitest sie bis zur Entscheidung.

  • Verträge und Service im Blick behalten: Du verantwortest Laufzeiten, Verlängerungen, Hardware-Wechsel und Service-Vereinbarungen und sorgst dafür, dass keine Frist überrascht.

  • Schnittstelle zwischen Kunde und Technik sein: Du übersetzt in beide Richtungen, koordinierst bei Eskalationen und sorgst dafür, dass Zusagen eingehalten werden.

  • Kundenbeziehung planbar machen: Du pflegst Kundendaten und Vorhaben sauber im System, planst Jahresgespräche und entwickelst für Deine Kunden eine Perspektive über das aktuelle Thema hinaus.

Qualifikation

  • Erfahrung in der Betreuung von Geschäftskunden – zum Beispiel im Vertriebsinnendienst, Account Management, Kundenservice oder in der Projektkoordination eines IT-Dienstleisters.

  • Ein solides IT-Grundverständnis: Du musst kein Netzwerk konfigurieren, solltest aber wissen, worüber Du sprichst: WLAN, Netzwerk, Server und Cloud auf Konzeptebene.

  • Freude daran, Kunden über Jahre zu begleiten, statt Abschlüsse zu jagen: Zuhören, nachfassen, verbindlich bleiben.

  • Die Fähigkeit, technische Zusammenhänge verständlich zu erklären und umgekehrt Kundenanforderungen so aufzunehmen, dass unsere Technik damit arbeiten kann.

  • Eine strukturierte und eigenverantwortliche Arbeitsweise. Du dokumentierst nachvollziehbar, hältst Zusagen nach und sprichst offene Punkte früh an.

  • Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse und einen Führerschein der Klasse B für gelegentliche Kundentermine.

Benefits

  • Einen eigenen Kundenstamm mit langfristigen Beziehungen; kein Kaltakquise-Druck und keine wechselnden Gebiete.

  • Kurze Wege zur Technik: Du arbeitest direkt mit den Kolleginnen und Kollegen zusammen, die die Lösungen umsetzen.

  • Die Möglichkeit, unsere Kundenbetreuung mitzugestalten: von Gesprächsleitfäden bis zu Serviceangeboten.

  • Flexible Arbeitszeiten und die Möglichkeit, mobil zu arbeiten. Kundentermine vor Ort gibt es, sie bestimmen aber nicht Deinen Kalender.

  • Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten, die Dich fachlich und beruflich weiterbringen. Natürlich auch technische, wenn Du tiefer einsteigen möchtest.

  • Ein wertschätzendes Arbeitsumfeld mit Raum für Deine Ideen.

Klingt nach Dir?

Dann schick uns Deine Bewerbung an! Für den Anfang reicht uns ein Lebenslauf. Bei Fragen vorab kannst Du Dich gerne an unseren Personalleiter Andreas Renner wenden.

Du bist ungekündigt beschäftigt? Das erste Telefonat führen wir gerne auch nach Feierabend.

Quereinstieg ausdrücklich willkommen: Wenn Du aus der Technik kommst und stärker in die Kundenbetreuung wechseln möchtest, passt das für uns genauso.

Wir freuen uns über Bewerbungen in Voll- und Teilzeit – sprich uns gerne auf Dein gewünschtes Stundenmodell an.

Über uns

Die tilko GmbH ist ein inhabergeführtes Unternehmen. Wir unterstützen unsere Kunden bei der Planung, Modernisierung und dem zuverlässigen Betrieb ihrer IT – von Server- und Virtualisierungsumgebungen über Cloud-Dienste bis zu Netzwerk- und WLAN-Lösungen.

Dabei zählen für uns Qualität, Verlässlichkeit und Teamgeist. Wir schaffen ein Arbeitsumfeld, in dem Vertrauen und Wertschätzung im täglichen Miteinander spürbar sind und Du Verantwortung übernehmen und mitgestalten kannst.

jobs.title: Ecosystem Manager EV Charging (m/f/x)
jobs.employer: ubitricity - Gesellschaft für verteilte Energiesysteme mbH
jobs.description:
Your Mission

The transport revolution is on the horizon, presenting significant challenges and opportunities in the mobility sector.

We're focused on delivering the right charge points at the right time and place. As the UK's leading public EV charging provider, ubitricity collaborates with local authorities to install and operate charging solutions for electric vehicles in public spaces.

To rapidly expand the charging infrastructure, we operate lamppost, AC fast, and DC rapid charge points across Germany, the UK, France and the Netherlands.

This is a hands-on Technical Product Management role at the intersection of software, hardware and external platform integrations. You will work closely with engineers and partners on APIs, system integrations and the end-to-end EV charging journey.

As Ecosystem Manager in the team, you'll help advance e-mobility and build an efficient, accessible charging network for everyone.

Your Mission
Put the EV driver at the center of everything we build. You'll own and evolve the ecosystem services and integrations — connecting our teams, markets and suppliers — that make charging effortless and reliable for every driver, from the moment they plug in to the moment they pay, while keeping operations running smoothly, priorities aligned, and a complex software environment continuously improving.

Your Tasks

  • Drive development and evolution of key ecosystem components, integrations and services, ensuring they deliver value for EV drivers and the business.
  • Own the budget for development and design initiatives in your area.
  • Shapen and coordinate API and system integrations across internal teams and external suppliers and stakeholders, and facilitate alignment between Software, Hardware, Operations, Commercial and partners, ensuring a seamless experience for drivers.
  • Take ownership of product quality in your area, continuously improving how work is planned, shipped and maintained.
  • Proactively identify customer pain points, operational challenges and market opportunities, and translate them into product improvements and new initiatives.
  • Prioritise work using value-based frameworks, considering customer impact, business value and strategic goals, in a multi-stakeholder environment.
  • Translate customers’, business and technical needs into clear requirements and user stories.
  • Support iterative delivery and small pilots, and equip local markets with the tooling, documentation and support they need to move fast.
  • Work closely with engineers day to day to clarify scope, answer questions and make implementation trade-offs.
  • Run Scrum processes for the development team and coordinate work packages with internal colleagues.
  • Prototype new feature UI/UX directly in our live application using AI coding tools such as GitHub Copilot to validate ideas before engineering builds them.

Your profile

  • 3+ years as a Technical Product Manager or similar, working on platforms, APIs, integrations or internal tools — ideally in the EV industry, energy, IoT or hardware-software ecosystems.
  • Technically comfortable, well beyond spreadsheet tools — able to work with APIs, dashboards and low-/no-code platforms without needing to write production code.
  • Comfortable using AI tools such as GitHub Copilot in daily work
  • Strong stakeholder management, clear, structured communicator who can bridge engineering, operations, commercial teams, partners and customers.
  • Data-driven problem solver with strong analytical thinking and UX focus for internal Stakeholder and external customers.
  • Demonstrated ability to proactively identify opportunities, define solutions and drive initiatives from concept through delivery
  • Comfortable operating in complex, multi-stakeholder service environments.
  • Collaborative, pragmatic and adaptable in a small, fast-evolving organization.
  • English C1 required; German is a plus.

Our Offer

  • Real impact: products that move the sustainable mobility transition forward, at a company with a well-established and uniquely placed position in the sector.
  • Real ownership: short decision paths, fast execution, and room to define, evaluate and improve systems and processes across the business.
  • Close collaboration with teams in Berlin, London and Amsterdam, inside an agile company backed by a leading global energy company.
  • Genuine growth: a fast-growing environment with exciting development opportunities and the scope to shape your own challenging projects.
  • Flexible, hybrid-by-default working (3 days in the office, 2 days remote), plus up to 4 weeks a year remote work from anywhere.
  • A centrally located office in the heart of Berlin.
  • A team that genuinely loves what it does. Statement on diversity
    We take pride in being a diverse organisation with a strong diversity and inclusion culture. We believe that everyone is different, and that difference brings value. Inclusion and inclusive behaviours are at the heart of effective collaboration, be it with team members, colleagues in other parts of our company, or with our customers. Every voice is heard.

jobs.title: Senior Product Designer (UX/UI)
jobs.description:
elearnio is a learning platform for digital preboarding, onboarding and continuous training. Companies use us to combine their own content, mandatory compliance training and external courses into structured learning experiences for their employees, partners and customers. Our customers are primarily mid-sized businesses in the DACH region.

We are a small, remote-first team. Decisions get made by a handful of people who all know the product, so there is very little between having a good idea and it being agreed.

We are looking for a Senior Product Designer (UX/UI) to work remotely from anywhere within EU time zones. You will be our only designer, and you will own how elearnio looks and feels. That is a broad remit. Every screen our customers touch is your responsibility, across a platform that covers a lot of ground.

If you need a design team around you to do your best work, this is the wrong role. If you have been the design function in a small product company before and enjoyed the ownership that comes with it, let us talk.

Tasks

  • Own the visual and interaction design language of the entire platform, and hold it together across a product that keeps growing
  • Turn product concepts into wireframes, then into build-ready design files with states, edge cases, responsive behaviour and interaction detail
  • Own our design system: the component library, tokens, and keeping it honest against what is actually implemented in the frontend
  • Design to WCAG 2.1 AA. Accessibility comes up more and more in DACH procurement, and we would rather build it in than retrofit it
  • Run design QA together with our QA team, so what ships matches what was designed
  • Run customer interviews and usability tests, in support of discovery and to validate your own concepts
  • Build up genuine depth in our product and in corporate learning and development as an industry, so your decisions come from understanding the domain rather than from generic patterns
  • Write the microcopy that goes with your designs, in English and ideally German
  • Grow into driving design-led topics yourself, from proposal through to concept

How we work together

Being clear about this up front, because it is the thing candidates most often get a surprise about.

  • Product discovery and concepts sit with our Head of Product. He runs that process and writes the specs, so you will not be starting from a blank page. But what we build and why is decided as a team, and talking to customers is something several of us do.
  • You own how it gets designed. Interaction, layout, visual language, the design system, and the quality of what actually ships. Within the problem, the solution is yours, and you are expected to push back when the proposed approach is the wrong one.
  • Design-led topics become yours to drive. Not on day one. But once you know the product and the industry, we would expect you to bring your own proposals for the things design should be leading, whether that is navigation, information architecture or a visual overhaul, and to take them through the concept phase yourself rather than waiting for a spec. That is what we are looking for at senior level rather than mid.

Requirements

  • Several years designing complex, logic-heavy B2B or SaaS products, including at least one you shaped visually over a longer period
  • Strong visual craft. Typography, hierarchy, spacing and information density in data-heavy interfaces, and the judgement to make a dense admin tool feel calm
  • Deep fluency in a modern design tool, including building and maintaining component libraries
  • Comfortable designing for localisation. The interface ships in 15 languages. You will design in German and English, but layouts need to hold up when strings run considerably longer or shorter
  • Responsive and mobile design, including users who only ever access the platform on a phone
  • You can run interviews and usability tests yourself, and turn what you hear into design decisions
  • Fluent English

Nice to have

  • German good enough to run customer interviews in it
  • Experience designing within an established product, not only greenfield work
  • Experience with multi-tenant products where customers apply their own branding

Not part of this role

Brand, marketing and website design. This is a product role, full stop. If your portfolio is mainly campaigns, landing pages and visual identity, we are probably not a good match.

Benefits

  • Real ownership: you are the design function, and the product will visibly carry your decisions
  • Direct access to customers and to decision-makers, with no layers in between
  • We believe in the power of working remotely. It is your choice from where you work, anywhere within EU time zones
  • We support flexible working hours. It is your choice when you work
  • elearnio is built on the idea of life-long learning. We offer a budget for your development and training needs

Your application

Please send a portfolio. We are looking for two things: evidence of visual and interaction craft in a complex interface, and at least one case study that shows your reasoning from problem to shipped result. If you have worked on tying a growing product together, we especially want to see that.

Our Application Process

  1. One session with our product team, around 90 minutes. We get to know each other, you walk us through one project from your portfolio in depth, and we talk through how you would approach a real elearnio design problem. A discussion, not an exercise. Please pick one project to go deep on rather than a tour of several.
  2. If that goes well, a second session with our Managing Director, around 30 minutes, covering the contractual side and anything else you want to ask.
  3. Offer extended to successful applicants

elearnio is committed to diversity, equity, and inclusion. We believe our team should reflect a rich diversity, so we encourage people of all backgrounds to apply. We're an Equal Opportunity Employer and do not discriminate based on race, color, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, religion, disability, national origin, veteran status, or any other status.

jobs.title: Forward Deployed AI Engineer Energy (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
Wir bei KnowWay entwickeln KI-Agenten für kritische Infrastruktur – Energie, Telekommunikation und öffentlicher Sektor. Überall dort, wo Compliance, Nachvollziehbarkeit und Datensouveränität keine Kompromisse zulassen, automatisieren wir Geschäftsprozesse mit KI.

Die Rolle

Wir bauen eine KI-Plattform für die Energiewirtschaft. Unsere Agenten unterstützen Prozesse wie Lieferantenwechsel, Netzanschluss, Abrechnung und Messstellenbetrieb.

Als Forward Deployed AI Engineer übernimmst Du einen Use Case von Discovery bis Go-Live. Du arbeitest direkt mit Fachbereichen bei Stadtwerken und Energieversorgern, verstehst ihre Prozesse und übersetzt dieses Wissen in produktive KI-Agenten.

  • Anforderungen in Agent Blueprints und technische Lösungen übersetzen

Das Team

Du arbeitest eng mit unserem Plattform- und Delivery-Team aus AI und Software Engineering sowie Consulting zusammen. Lösungen entwickeln wir gemeinsam mit unseren Kunden – wiederverwendbare Komponenten und Erkenntnisse fließen zurück in unsere Plattform.

Qualifikation

  • Erfahrung mit LLM-Anwendungen, RAG, Prompt Engineering, Tool Use und Agenten-Orchestrierung
  • Sehr gute Python-Kenntnisse auf Produktionsniveau
  • Erfahrung mit der Evaluation von GenAI-Anwendungen, z. B. Testsets, Golden Questions oder Regressionstests
  • Verständnis von Chunking, Retrieval, Metadaten und Wissensstrukturen
  • Freude am direkten Kundenkontakt und die Fähigkeit, unklare Anforderungen selbstständig zu strukturieren
  • Hohe Ownership und pragmatischer Umgang mit wechselnden Anforderungen
  • Deutsch verhandlungssicher

Für uns zählen gebaute Anwendungen mehr als Zertifikate. Eigene Projekte, GitHub-Repositories oder andere Arbeitsproben sehen wir uns deshalb besonders gerne an.

Nice-to-have

  • Energiewirtschaftliches Know-how, z. B. Marktkommunikation, GPKE, EDIFACT, SAP IS-U oder kVASy
  • BPMN oder vergleichbare Prozessmodellierung
  • GCP, Docker und CI/CD
  • Knowledge Graphs oder strukturierte Wissensrepräsentation
  • Erfahrung aus Consulting oder anderen kundenorientierten technischen Rollen

Benefits

  • 30 Tage Urlaub
  • Erfolgsbeteiligung und Perspektive auf VSOPs
  • Flexible Arbeitszeiten und Remote-first-Arbeitsmodell
  • Standorte bzw. Smartoffice rund um Hamburg, Ruhrgebiet/NRW und München
  • Direkter Kontakt zu Fachbereichen und Entscheider
  • Frühe Verantwortung und hoher Gestaltungsspielraum
  • Modernes GenAI-Umfeld mit Fokus auf produktive AI Agents
  • Wertschätzendes Team und kurze Entscheidungswege

Wir suchen Mid-Level- und Senior-Profile.

Auf Mid-Level übernimmst Du eigene Use Cases von Discovery bis Go-Live. Auf Senior-Level entwickelst Du zusätzlich Standards und Blueprints für unser Agent Building weiter, arbeitest auf Kundenleitungsebene und hilfst uns, Forward Deployed Engineering im Team zu skalieren.

Klingt gut? Dann bewirb Dich jetzt und wir sprechen miteinander.

Das Projekt

Für einen führenden Telekommunikationskonzern in Deutschland setzen wir Daten- und KI-Projekte auf der Google Cloud um. Mehrere Anwendungsfälle laufen parallel – von Discovery und Business Analyse über PoCs und Entwicklung bis zum Live-Betrieb.

Die Prozesse, die wir automatisieren, sind oft über Jahre gewachsen. Wissen steckt in einzelnen Köpfen, Abläufe sind nur teilweise dokumentiert und Fachbereiche arbeiten mit selbst entwickelten Excel-, Access-, SharePoint- oder anderen Legacy-Lösungen.

Genau dort setzt Deine Rolle an.

Aufgaben

Die Rolle

Du verstehst, was im Fachbereich wirklich passiert – und bereitest es so auf, dass daraus ein umsetzbarer Daten- oder KI-Anwendungsfall entsteht.

Dafür arbeitest Du direkt mit Sachbearbeiter, Projektleitungen und Entscheider. Du findest heraus, wo das eigentliche Problem liegt, welche Regeln tatsächlich gelten und wie ein Prozess funktioniert. Du modellierst Abläufe und Entscheidungslogiken und machst sie für unser Delivery-Team nutzbar.

Dabei gehst Du über klassische Business Analyse hinaus: Du arbeitest heraus, auf welchen Daten ein Prozess basiert, welche Objekte und Beziehungen existieren, aus welchen Systemen die Daten stammen und was in den einzelnen Verarbeitungsschritten mit ihnen passiert.

Du arbeitest eng mit unserem Solution Architect sowie unseren Data-, AI- und Software-Engineers zusammen. Du musst keine Datenpipeline bauen und keinen produktiven Code schreiben. Du solltest aber Datenflüsse verstehen und einschätzen können, was technisch möglich ist – und was das für den Fachbereich bedeutet.

Gleichzeitig bist Du eine zentrale Ansprechperson für Deine Use Cases: Du gibst Statusupdates, bereitest Entscheidungen vor, managst Erwartungen und treibst offene Punkte voran.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Ist-Prozesse sowie fachliche Regeln und Entscheidungslogiken analysieren und modellieren, insbesondere mit BPMN
  • Datenobjekte, Beziehungen, Quellsysteme und Schlüssel hinter einem Prozess identifizieren und visualisieren
  • Datenflüsse nachvollziehen und Auswirkungen von Datenqualität und Datenverfügbarkeit auf Anforderungen erkennen

jobs.title: Kommunalsjef Helse og omsorg – samfunnsbygger for framtidens velferd
jobs.description:
Tror du at gode liv skapes i relasjoner?
Da kan dette være en av de mest spennende lederstillingene i Kommune-Norge.
Vår kommunalsjef for helse og omsorg har fått muligheten til å bli kommunedirektør i nabokommunen.
Nå søker vi hans etterfølger. Vi søker ikke bare en kommunalsjef. Vi søker en samfunnsbygger.

Vi tror framtidens velferd skapes i relasjoner
Dette bygger på verdiene våre: fellesskap, inkludering, tillit og åpenhet for å gjøre ting på nye måter.
I Gol kommune tror vi at framtidens velferd ikke først og fremst skapes i kommunale bygg eller gjennom kommunale vedtak.
Den skapes i relasjonene mellom mennesker. Mellom innbyggere, familier, frivillighet, lokalsamfunn, næringsliv og offentlige tjenester.
«Vår viktigste oppgave er ikke bare å utvikle tjenestene, men å styrke den relasjonelle kapasiteten som gjør at mennesker, familier og lokalsamfunn kan lykkes sammen.»
Vi tror at mennesker vokser når de opplever at de betyr noe. Derfor handler helse- og omsorgstjenester ikke bare om behandling, omsorg og bistand, men også om å styrke menneskers opplevelse av verdi, tilhørighet og mulighet til å bidra.

Vårt syn på velferd
I Gol kommune tror vi at mennesker trenger:

Å bli verdsatt
Å bli sett, hørt og tatt på alvor.

Å kunne bidra
Å oppleve at egne ressurser har betydning.

Å høre til
Å være en del av noe større enn seg selv.
Dette perspektivet preger hvordan vi utvikler tjenester, ledelse og lokalsamfunn.

Derfor søker vi en ny kommunalsjef
Vi vet at flere behov og knappere tilgang på arbeidskraft ikke kan møtes gjennom flere tjenester alene. Derfor må vi utvikle nye løsninger sammen med innbyggerne, lokalsamfunnet og våre medarbeidere.
Vi er allerede i gang.
Vi arbeider for en ny generasjon velferdstjenester der vi bryter ned siloer, lærer på tvers og utvikler løsninger gjennom samarbeid, innovasjon og samskaping.
Som kommunalsjef får du en nøkkelrolle i denne utviklingen og blir en sentral del av kommunedirektørens ledergruppe.

Se for deg dette
Se for deg en kommune der:

  • flere eldre opplever mestring og trygghet i egne liv
  • medarbeidere kjenner mening, tillit og arbeidsglede
  • frivillighet, pårørende og lokalsamfunn er aktive medskapere
  • tjenester henger bedre sammen rundt menneskene som trenger dem
  • innbyggerne ikke bare mottar tjenester, men deltar i å forme dem

Dette er det vi jobber mot.

Dette skal du lede
Som kommunalsjef for helse og omsorg får du ansvar for noen av kommunens viktigste tjenester og lede seks virksomhetsledere med ansvar for et samlet budsjett på om lag 230 millioner kroner.

Sektoren omfatter:

  • sykehjem
  • hjemmesykepleie og praktisk bistand
  • miljøterapitjeneste
  • helsetjenester, inkludert fysio- og ergoterapi, friskliv, helsestasjon, jordmortjeneste og legekontor
  • Hallingdal krisesenter og barnevernvakt
  • interkommunalt NAV for Hallingdal, der Gol er vertskommune

Hos oss vil du:

  • være en sentral del av kommunedirektørens ledergruppe
  • lede dyktige ledere og sterke fagmiljøer
  • bidra til tverrfaglig utvikling på tvers av hele kommunen
  • være en sentral stemme i utviklingen av framtidens velferd i Hallingdal
  • skape retning i en tid som krever både omstilling og nytenkning

Vi tror god ledelse handler om å skape retning gjennom tillit, invitere til medvirkning og gi rom for nye perspektiver og løsninger.

Hvem ser vi etter?

Vi søker en leder som forstår at resultater skapes gjennom relasjoner
Du bygger tillit. Du skaper retning. Du får mennesker til å lykkes sammen.
Du er en leder som involverer, lytter og utfordrer. Du skaper fellesskap, fremmer inkludering og er åpen for å prøve nye veier når gamle løsninger ikke lenger er nok

Vi ønsker at du:

  • har relevant høyere utdanning innen helsefag
  • har ledererfaring fra komplekse organisasjoner
  • kombinerer strategisk blikk med gjennomføringskraft
  • utvikler tjenestene i tett dialog med innbyggere, ansatte, tillitsvalgte og politiske beslutningstakere
  • har god forståelse for økonomistyring, kvalitetsarbeid og offentlig forvaltning
  • evner å bygge samarbeid på tvers av fagområder, sektorer og organisasjoner
  • ser verdien av samskaping, innbyggerdialog og tverrfaglig samarbeid
  • forstår samspillet mellom politikk, administrasjon og tjenesteutvikling
  • ønsker å styrke den relasjonelle kapasiteten i kommunen – evnen til å skape tillit, samarbeid, tilhørighet og felles ansvar mellom mennesker, tjenester og lokalsamfunn

Hvorfor Gol?
Gol er en kommune med høye ambisjoner og korte avstander mellom idé og handling. Vi tror på samspill framfor siloer, dialog framfor fasitsvar og fellesskap framfor utenforskap. Verdiene våre – fellesskap, inkludering, tillit og åpenhet for å gjøre ting på nye måter – preger hvordan vi leder, samarbeider og utvikler kommunen. Vi har den beste erfaringen gjennom å dele arbeidshverdagen vår fysisk sammen – ikke gjennom skjerm.

Drømmer du om å lede store samfunnsendringer uten å gi avkall på livskvaliteten?
I Gol kommune møter du komplekse utfordringer, høye ambisjoner og et utviklingsmiljø som tenker like offensivt som mange storbykommuner. Forskjellen er at arbeidsdagen kan avsluttes med fjelltur, langrennsski, sykkelsti eller stillheten ved et fjellvann. I Hallingdal får du det beste fra to verdener: et stort samfunnsoppdrag og rom for et rikt liv utenfor jobben.

Kanskje er det deg?
Du kan velge mellom mange lederstillinger. Men dersom du tror at framtidens velferd ikke skapes av kommunen alene, men av mennesker som lykkes sammen, håper vi du søker. Hvis dette gir gjenklang i din forståelse av ledelse og velferd, ønsker vi å høre fra deg.

Søknadsfrist: 18.oktober

Kontakt: Kommunedirektør Hege Mørk, tlf. 916 73 901, hege.mork@gol.kommune.no


Link til søknadsskjema: Søk her

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Gol ligger midt i Hallingdal og er kjent som et knutepunkt for handel og turisme. Med sitt brede spekter av butikker, restauranter og tjenester, er Gol et praktisk sted å bo. Vi har også flotte skimuligheter om vinteren og vakre turstier om sommeren. Gol er ideelt for de som ønsker en balansert livsstil med både by- og naturopplevelser Gol kommune huser nesten 5000 innbyggere. Her satser vi på innbyggerne våre gjennom utdanning, innovasjon og samskaping. Universitetet i Sørøst-Norge utgjør Campus Hallingdal og på Gol kan du ta både grunnutdanning og videreutdanning. Gol er svært inkluderende og familievennlig. Vi har flere barnehager og ny 1-10 skole. I tillegg har vi et variert studietilbud med videregående skole, folkehøyskole og voksenopplæring. Kommunen har også god barnehagedekning og løpende barnehageopptak. Vi kan tilby svært gode forhold for en aktiv fritid, enten det er friluftsliv, kultur eller sport. Her finner du endeløst med ski- og sykkelløyper i umiddelbar nærhet. Kommunen ligger sentralt til i landet med korte avstander til både Oslo og Bergen via Bergensbanen.

jobs.title: Veileder
jobs.description:
Nav Holmestrand leverer tjenester til kommunens innbyggere og arbeidsgivere. Gjennom Nav sin innsats skal flere få mulighet til å være i arbeid, delta i samfunnet og være sikret inntekt.

Ved Nav Holmestrand er vi 60 medarbeidere fordelt på 4 avdelinger. Vi har ledig en 100% fast stilling som veileder. Hos oss får du en sentral rolle i å åpne dører, bygge broer og finne løsninger som gjør det mulig for flere å komme i – og bli stående - i arbeid.

Stillingen er for tiden knyttet til avdeling Oppfølging voksen, her jobber du tett med mennesker som av helsemessige årsaker har behov for oppfølging fra Nav. Du vil følge opp brukere mot arbeid og aktivitet, samt samarbeide med interne og eksterne aktører for å finne gode løsninger for den enkelte. Stillingen innebærer også mye saksbehandling.

Vi ser etter deg som motiveres av å hjelpe mennesker videre, trives med ansvar og ønsker å utvikle deg faglig gjennom varierte oppgaver og tett samarbeid med kollegaer og samarbeidspartnere.


Arbeidsoppgaver

  • Kartlegging av ressurser, kompetanse og muligheter i arbeidsmarkedet 
  • Saksbehandling etter Folketrygdloven Kap. 11 og 12, forskrift om arbeidsmarkedstiltak og Nav-loven (§14-a)
  • Ha god kontakt med samarbeidspartnere, som leger, kursarrangører, utdannings-institusjoner og kommunale tjenester (f.eks. rus og psykisk helse)
  • Ansvar for organisering og framdrift i egen portefølje
  • Dokumentasjon og ajourhold i Navs fagsystemer 
  • Oppfølging ute i bedriftene
  • Bidra til felles oppgaveløsning i kontoret
  • Inngå i kontorets vakttelefon lag for sikkerhet, og møte opp for å håndtere situasjoner når alarm går i samtalerom/veiledningssenter.

Arbeidsoppgavene kan endres i takt med kontorets behov, og du må derfor trives med omstilling og endring.

Kvalifikasjoner
  • Relevant utdanning på bachelor nivå. Utdanning innen veiledning, sosialfag, samfunnsfag, helsefag eller velferdsfag er en fordel, men også andre utdanningsretninger kan være relevante.
  • Gode kommunikasjonsferdigheter på norsk (tilsvarende C1-nivå ved annet morsmål)
  • Kunnskap om arbeidsmarkedet
  • God lovforståelse og erfaring med forvaltning.
  • Erfaring med veiledning
  • Førerkort klasse B, da arbeidet innebærer at du vil ha møter ute i bedriftene, hos samarbeidspartnere og legekontor.

Utenlandsk utdanning må være godkjent av HK-dir (Direktoratet for høyere utdanning og kompetanse) eller NOKUT

Personlige egenskaper

  • Gjennomføringsevne: Du kan sette mål, vise til progresjon og få et godt resultat
  • Uredd: Du tør å utfordre, står støtt i motstand, møter andres følelser, innrømmer feil, men står i egne beslutninger
  • Motivator: Du har tro på den enkelte, og hjelper andre å fokusere på løsninger fremfor problemer.

Kristiansand kommune har 115 000 innbyggere og er Agders største arbeidsgiver. Vi er over 9 000 ansatte med allsidige oppgaver innen et bredt spekter av tjenesteområder. Som en av landets største kommuner trenger vi stadig nye, engasjerte og motiverte medarbeidere.

Vi legger vekt på god dialog med innbyggerne og ønsker sammen å skape stadig bedre tjenester. Vi er alltid på jakt etter effektive og bærekraftige måter å jobbe på – for fellesskapet, miljøet og fremtiden.

Vår kommune har fokus på et inkluderende arbeidsliv og er opptatt av at arbeidsstyrken skal gjenspeile mangfoldet i samfunnet. Velkommen til en veldrevet organisasjon.

Kristiansand kommune praktiserer meroffentlighet, jf. offentleglova § 11. Offentlig søkerliste vil normalt inneholde navn på samtlige søkere. Det må foreligge særskilte omstendigheter for å få innvilget unntak, jf. offentleglova § 25.

jobs.title: Avdelingsleder - hjemmebaserte tjenester
jobs.description:
Grue kommune er i en spennende utviklingsfase, og vi søker nå en engasjert og framtidsrettet avdelingsleder for Hjemmebaserte tjenester. 

Vi ser etter deg som ønsker å skape gode tjenester, utvikle medarbeidere og bidra til at innbyggerne får trygge og helhetlige helse og omsorgstilbud gjennom ny teknologi og smartere arbeidsformer. Du er en synlig leder som kombinerer nærvær og involvering med tydelig forventninger.

I 2025 ble sykehjemstjenestene og de hjemmebaserte tjenestene samlet i ny Enhet Helse og omsorg, som er samlokalisert ved Grue Helsetun. Målet er å utvikle framtidsrettede, bærekraftige og helhetlige tjenester i møte med stadig nye behov og forventninger. Som avdelingsleder blir du en sentral pådriver i denne utviklingen. Du får muligheten til å være med på å forme organisasjon, kultur og tjenestetilbud i en tid preget av endring og nytenkning.

Du vil få ansvar for en avdeling med ca 48 årsverk, fordelt på 18 årsverk innen Heldøgns omsorg (HDO) og 30 årsverk innen hjemmetjenesten som tilsvarer ca. 65 medarbeidere.

Tre teamledere som vil inngå i ditt lederteam. Sammen skal dere bidra til god og effektiv drift, faglig utvikling, kvalitet i tjenestene og et trygt og inkluderende arbeidsmiljø. Du vil rapportere til enhetsleder i Helse og omsorg, og vil inngå i enhetens ledergruppe og rammeområdets lederkollegium.

Grue kommune implementerer våren 2027 nytt pasientjournal (Aidn)- og ressursstyringssystem.


Arbeidsoppgaver
  • Overordnet og helhetlig ansvar for fag, personal, ressursstyring, teknologi og økonomi for din avdelingen
  • Gjennom en involverende og motiverende lederstil, skape retning og engasjement, og styre ressursene slik at målene nås
  • Påse og sørge for at driften skjer i samsvar med det til enhver tid gjeldende lov- og avtaleverk, prosedyrer og rutiner samt administrative vedtak som påvirker drift, økonomi og personell mm
  • Internkontroll
  • Være en aktiv bidragsyter inn i sektorens lederkollegium og enhetens ledergruppe
  • Ansvar for utvikling av teamledelse på avdeling og lederansvar for tre teamledere
  • Bidra til godt og effektivt samarbeid med andre rammeområder, enheter og avdelinger
Kvalifikasjoner

Du bør ha:

  • Fullført Bachelor i sykepleie, vernepleie eller annen relevant helsefaglig bachelorgrad
  • Ledererfaring fra helse- og omsorgstjenester, med personal-, budsjett- og fagansvar
  • Kjennskap til relevant lov- og avtaleverk
  • God norsk fremstillingsevne, muntlig og skriftlig
  • Gode IKT kunnskaper og evne til å lære aktuelle fagsystemer
  • Politiattest mindre enn 3 måneder må framvises før tiltredelse

Det er en fordel om du har:

  • Lederutdanning eller ønske om å ta lederutdanning
  • Erfaring med omstillingsprosesser og endringsledelse
  • Erfaring med hjemmebaserte tjenester

Personlig egenskaper og egnethet vil vektlegges

Personlige egenskaper
  • Engasjert, tillitsvekkende og samlende leder, med evne til å bygge gode relasjoner og skape gode samarbeidsforhold og bidra til et godt arbeidsmiljø
  • Ansvarlig, helhetstenkende og handlekraftig
  • Evne og vilje til å jobbe med endring og utvikling i en organisasjon som står i krevende omstillingsprosesser
  • Er tydelig og resultat-, utviklings- og endringsorientert
  • Analytisk og nytenkende
  • Er motivert leder med klar rolleforståelse og mål for lederrollen
  • Er motivert for en jobb som i perioder er krevende
  • Kunne identifisere seg med kommunens verdigrunnlag  - REAL
Vi tilbyr
  • En spennende stilling med mulighet for å påvirke utviklingen av morgendagens tjenester
  • En spennende arbeidsplass med komplekse, varierte og utfordrende arbeidsoppgaver
  • Muligheten til å bygge og utvikle et nytt lederteam
  • Mulighet for relevant kompetanseheving
  • Lønn etter avtale
  • Gruppelivsforsikring og pensjonsavtale

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Grue kommune med sine i overkant av 4500 innbyggere ligger i Kongsvingerregionen ca. 13 mil nordøst for Oslo. Glomma renner gjennom kommunen forbi frodige landbruksområder og innbyr til bading på flotte sandstrender. I den østre delen av kommunen kan du utforske og oppleve magiske Finnskogen. Her finnes gode muligheter for jakt, fiske og en tur i kajakken på stille sjøer. Naturen byr på gode turmuligheter langs godt oppmerkede tur- og sykkelstier. Det finnes også gode muligheter for å plukke bær i skogen eller på myrene i området.

Grue har en spennende forhistorie og nå håper vi du vil være med å skape framtidas historie sammen med oss.

Grue kommune er opptatt av mangfold. Vi ønsker derfor å oppfordre alle kvalifiserte kandidater til å søke jobb hos oss uansett alder, kjønn, funksjonsevne eller kulturell bakgrunn.

Kommunens verdier er «R E A L», som står for Raushet, Engasjement, Anerkjennelse og Likeverd.

jobs.title: Biokjemisk ingeniør (sommervikar) | FjordAlg AS
jobs.description:
Introduksjon

FjordAlg AS ble stiftet i 2016 av gründer og nåværende CEO Gabriel Ossenkamp. Etter en lengre tid i industrien dannet han et firma tuftet på en troen om at mikroalger kan bidra til bærekraftig produksjon av mat og næringsmidler. For øyeblikket fokuserer bedriften på produksjon av naturlig astaxanthin. Til dette benytter vi mikroalgen Haematococcus lacustris. Denne arten blir ofte rapportert å inneholde opp til 5% astaxanthin. Astaxanthin kan benyttes i helsekost og som fôringrediens for oppdrettsfisk. Ambisjonen vår er å gjøre det rosa i laksen grønt.

Generelt

I dag er det fire ansatte i bedriften. FjordAlg er godt etablert i Årdal Teknologipark plassert i Øvre Årdal. Vi har også gjennomført flere tester av vårt produkt i fisk og oppnådd gode resultater. Vi går mot en sommer med full aktivitet og trenger én ferieavløser til denne stillingen. Det vil ansettes totalt to ferieavløsere sommeren 2027. Nødvendig opplæring vil bli gitt.

Tidsrom

Stillingen ønskes besatt omtrent fra uke 24 til og med uke 33 2027. Vi prioriterer søkere som kan jobbe minst åtte uker denne perioden. Arbeid før og etter tidsrommet kan avtales.

Sted

Driften er for tiden i Øvre Årdal. Årdal er en industrikommune tilknyttet Jotunheimen nasjonalpark med lang industrihistorie (Hydro). Vi bistår gjerne med å finne en privat utleier.

Søknad

Kort søknad, CV og vitnemål sendes til soknad@fjordalg.com innen 25.10.2026.

Utvalgte søkere vil få tilsendt en test som skal besvares innen en uke. Kandidatene vi tror passer best til stillingen innkalles deretter til intervju. Etter intervjuet vil én kandidat bli gitt tilbud om stillingen.

Kompetansekrav

Vi leter etter deg som går nest siste eller siste år av din høyere utdanning innen kjemi og/eller biologi, trives med laboratoriearbeid, samhandling og problemløsning i høyt tempo. Personer med fullført utdanning har også anledning til å søke.

Ytterligere ønsker:

  • Kjemisk kompetanse innen organisk, analytisk, prosess, eller bioteknologi

  • God prosessforståelse

  • Teknologiforståelse

  • Kommuniserer godt på norsk og engelsk

  • Har tatt emner med bioteknologisk eller mikrobiologisk overføringsverdi

  • Fire måneder arbeidslivserfaring

  • Karaktersnitt på C eller høyere

Arbeidsoppgave

Arbeidsoppgavene er varierte. Stillingen "Biokjemisk ingeniør" kan innebære følgende oppgaver:

  • Planlegge og gjennomføre eksperimenter

  • Daglig tilsyn av PBR (Photo Bio Reactor)

  • Laboratoriearbeid

  • Praktisk arbeid og problemløsning

  • Kjemiske analyser

  • Optimalisering av prosesser

  • Dokumentasjon og databehandling


Hvorfor søke jobb hos oss?

Vi tilbyr muligheten til å arbeide i en vekstbedrift på sin ferd mot industriell produksjon. Her vil du få samarbeide med dyktige ansatte om teoretiske og praktiske problemstillinger. Vi gir alltid arbeid som er knyttet til vår forskning, utvikling og daglig drift. Det er stort rom for å lære og utvikle ferdighetene dine innenfor et bredt spekter av oppgaver.

Dersom du er interessert i friluftsliv gir en jobb hos oss i Årdal gode muligheter til å ta en topptur ettermiddager, så vel som i helgene. Vi arrangerer fellesturer i løpet av sommeren dersom det er av interesse.

Konklusjon

FjordAlg AS skal ansette en eller flere sommervikarer med mulighet for fast jobb høsten 2027. Ta kontakt dersom du er interessert eller har spørsmål om stillingen.

#sommerjobbivest

Vi tar forbehold om at denne stillingsutlysningen inneholder feil og at endringer kan forekomme.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

FjordAlg AS er en bioteknologibedrift i skjæringspunktet mellom startup og scaleup som utvikler nye løsninger for å ta mikroalger i bruk i laksefôr og som kosttilskudd. Vi skaper en ny bærekraftig industri gjennom utvikling av en bioteknologisk prosess og ny teknologi knyttet til denne.
