jobs.title: Master Thesis: AI for Real-Time Microstructure Monitoring Using Laser Ultra
jobs.description:
Project Description

Background
Laser Ultrasonics (LUS) is a powerful non-contact technique for in-situ characterization of metallic materials at elevated temperatures. In hot strip mill environments, LUS enables real-time monitoring of grain size evolution through analysis of ultrasonic wave attenuation and velocity, providing critical insight into recrystallization, grain growth, and phase transformations. This information is highly valuable for advanced process control strategies aimed at improving product quality, consistency, and resource efficiency.

The NAICE project (Non-destructive AI enhanced online grain size evaluation) addresses a key challenge in fossil free steel production: today’s steel mills lack real time information about the microstructure that governs material quality, leading to unnecessary energy use, scrap, and slow process adjustments. By upgrading the world’s only industrial laser ultrasonic grain size gauge and collecting a unique large dataset, the project will train models to enable AI enhanced measurement of the grain size and microstructure in real-time. This enables smarter process control, higher yield, and reduced emissions.

This thesis is the first of two planned master thesis works. The first will evaluate the best options using historical data sets, whereas the second will focus on using the full dataset and optimizing the model for industrial implementation.

If you want to know more about the LUS technology and the installation of the world’s only grain size gauge there is a recorded webinar here: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ZOpXUAPhEv0&t=665s  

Thesis Scope
The thesis will focus on the application of machine learning and AI techniques to Laser Ultrasonic (LUS) data acquired in a hot strip mill environment. The available dataset consists of:

    Raw LUS A-scan signals with multiple backwall echoes (20 µs duration, 1 ns resolution)
    Grain size values calculated using an established conventional algorithm (serving as reference values)
    The primary objective is to develop and evaluate AI-based approaches for:
- Grain size prediction directly from raw laser ultrasonic signals
- Microstructure state classification (e.g., recrystallized fraction, pancaking/aspect ratio)

A key part of the work will be to survey suitable AI architectures, such as time-series models, deep learning approaches, and alternative signal-processing-informed models, and assess their applicability to the LUS data.

Tasks

    Survey and critically assess relevant AI/ML architectures for ultrasonic time-series data
    Pre-process and structure high-resolution LUS A-scan datasets for model training
    Develop and implement selected AI models
    Perform benchmark comparisons between different approaches with respect to:  
    Prediction accuracy
    Robustness to signal variability
    Computational efficiency and suitability for real-time deployment
    Analyze model interpretability in relation to known physical phenomena

Expected Outcomes

The thesis should deliver:

    A structured comparison of candidate AI approaches for LUS-based grain size prediction
    Prototype models demonstrating feasibility on the historical dataset
    Recommendations for model selection in future industrial implementation

Desired Qualifications
We are looking for a motivated student with:

    A background in computer engineering, engineering physics, materials science, applied mathematics, or similar
    Strong interest in machine learning and signal processing
    Experience with Python/Matlab and ML frameworks

    Basic understanding of wave physics, ultrasonics, or materials science (meriting but not required)
    Analytical mindset and ability to work with complex datasets

Additional Information

    The work will be carried out in close collaboration with experts in Laser Ultrasonics and industrial process monitoring, providing a unique opportunity to contribute to cutting-edge development of AI-driven process control in steel manufacturing.

Project time
The project is intended for a master thesis (30hp), starting in spring 2027 or can be mutually decided through negotiations.

Further information
This project is intended to be performed at Swerim in Stockholm. Swerim rewards the student with 50 000 SEK for an approved master thesis (30hp).

Contacts
For further information please contact:  

    Mikael Malmström, mikael.malmstrom@swerim.se
    Hampus Wikmark Kreuger, hampus.wikmark@swerim.se

Application
Apply by using the application function below. The application can be written in Swedish (or English). You will receive a confirmation that Swerim has received your application. Please note that we fill the position as soon as we find a suitable applicant, which means there is no explicit deadline.

jobs.title: Extra income as CE truck driver - part-time or weekend work
jobs.description:
Are you living in Belgium and looking for some extra income? Do you have a valid CE driving licence and experience as a CE truck driver, HGV driver or lorry driver? And do you want a flexible way to earn extra money alongside your current job or during your free days?

For a well-established transport company in Oostkamp, specialized in frozen food transport and temperature-controlled logistics, we're looking for reliable CE truck drivers who want to work one or more days per week. You decide when you're available: weekdays, Saturdays, or both. And the best part is that Dutch isn't required; you can also apply if you only speak English!

Your job

As a CE driver, you will deliver frozen food products to supermarkets, distribution centres, and business customers across Belgium and neighbouring countries.

Your drives:

  • Transport of frozen goods
  • National deliveries throughout Belgium, but also to the Netherlands, Luxembourg, France and Germany
  • Up to 15h/day on the road (waiting and resting times included)
  • Varying number of stops: between 5 to 15 stops/day

Routes are prepared in advance and your trailer is already loaded, connected, fuelled, and ready to go before departure.

You'll almost never have to sleep in your truck, except for some for very exceptional cases when there's no other possibility.

We're looking for a driver who:

  • Has a valid CE driving licence, code 95 and driver card
  • Is residing in Belgium and has legal right to work in the country
  • Has a good level of English
  • Isn't afraid to start early in the morning and to tackle longer routes
  • Has their own transport to the company (no public transport nearby)

Previous experience in frozen food transport, refrigerated transport or distribution transport is an advantage but not required.

 

!! IMPORTANT ELIGIBILITY REQUIREMENTS: please read carefully before applying !!

  • You must already be living in Belgium
  • You must already have a valid legal right to work in Belgium (EU citizenship or valid work permit)

Candidates who do not meet these requirements will not be considered for the position. We do not provide visa sponsorship, work permits, relocation support or immigration assistance.

Wat verwachten we van jou?

  • je behaalde ten minste een bachelor diploma verpleegkunde; (een masterdiploma strekt tot aanbeveling);

jobs.title: Hotel Manager - Getaway Gent
jobs.description:
Getaway biedt stijlvolle en volledig uitgeruste studio’s met kitchenette aan voor kort verblijf in Leuven, Luik, Zaventem, Gent en Oostende. Onze gasten genieten van de vrijheid van een eigen studio en rekenen tegelijk op een goede service en een zorgeloos verblijf.

Getaway is geen klassiek hotel. Onze medewerkers kijken verder dan hun eigen taken en houden samen zicht op de volledige werking van de locatie. Als familiaal bedrijf met ongeveer 20 medewerkers werken we met korte communicatielijnen, veel zelfstandigheid en een directe samenwerking met het management.


Jobomschrijving

Voor Getaway Gent zoeken we een ervaren en people-minded hotel manager die de dagelijkse werking van de locatie leidt.

Hotelmanagement

Je zorgt voor een goede samenwerking tussen front office, housekeeping en maintenance en vertaalt de richtlijnen van het management naar duidelijke werkafspraken.

Je stuurt het receptieteam aan en maakt de maandelijkse personeelsplanning voor Gent op, in overleg met de managers van de andere locaties. Samen met HR sta je in voor de selectie, opleiding en evaluatie van medewerkers. Je stelt duidelijke verwachtingen, ondersteunt het team waar nodig en grijpt tijdig in wanneer afspraken of kwaliteitsnormen niet worden nageleefd.

Je waakt over een correct gebruik van het PMS-systeem, een professionele gastenservice en een goede administratieve opvolging. Je behandelt (complexe) klachten, volgt facturatie en achterstallige betalingen op en regelt groepsreservaties van A tot Z. Vanuit de dagelijkse werking rapporteer je knelpunten en werk je concrete verbetervoorstellen uit voor het management.

Housekeeping

Je bent het vaste aanspreekpunt voor onze externe schoonmaakpartner. Je controleert de kwaliteit, zorgt ervoor dat vastgestelde gebreken correct worden aangepakt en bewaakt een goede communicatie tussen de front office en housekeeping.

Maintenance en facilities

Je houdt toezicht op de algemene staat van de studio’s, gemeenschappelijke ruimtes, infrastructuur en inboedel. Je lijst technische werkzaamheden op, controleert de uitvoering ervan en rapporteert hierover aan het management. Daarnaast zie je toe op de naleving van de veiligheidsnormen.

Je hebt relevante leidinggevende ervaring binnen het hotelwezen en begrijpt wat nodig is om een locatie dagelijks goed te laten functioneren.

Je brengt structuur in de werking, stelt duidelijke prioriteiten en volgt afspraken consequent op.

Je behoudt het overzicht over verschillende taken en betrokken partijen, zonder belangrijke details uit het oog te verliezen.

Als leidinggevende ben je zichtbaar en aanspreekbaar voor medewerkers en gasten. Je communiceert duidelijk en professioneel, geeft richting aan het team en durft medewerkers aan te spreken wanneer dat nodig is.

Je werkt zelfstandig, neemt verantwoordelijkheid en betrekt het management tijdig bij belangrijke problemen of beslissingen. Je spreekt en schrijft vlot Nederlands, Frans en Engels.

jobs.title: Head of Safety
jobs.description:
Welcome to SSC Space (formerly Swedish Space Corporation), the perfect workplace for those passionate about technology in general and space in particular.

With space organizations, research institutes, institutional and commercial actors as customers, we offer specialist expertise in satellite communications, spacecraft consulting services, rocket and balloon systems, and much more.

SSC Space also has one of the world’s largest global networks of ground stations for satellite communications. We own and operate the Esrange Space Center in Kiruna, northern Sweden, with the aim of launching satellites in the near future.

Are you fueled by a passion for people and the ambition to create an awesome workplace? Are you ready to embark on an exciting journey with us to help Earth benefit from space?

If you answer yes to these questions, we invite you to seize the opportunity to make a significant impact as our Head of Safety at Esrange Space Center.

At Esrange Space Center, safety is fundamental to everything we do. Our operations include sounding rocket and balloon launches, rocket testing, and the development of orbital launch capabilities – activities that place high demands on safety, coordination and regulatory compliance.

As Head of Safety, you will lead and coordinate the overall safety work at Esrange Space Center. Your mission is to ensure a safe environment for employees, customers, contractors, visitors and the public across operations that include rocket and balloon launches, testing and future orbital launch activities.

You will set the frameworks and requirements for our safety work and lead experts within areas such as range safety, flight and campaign safety, occupational health and safety, fire protection and emergency preparedness. This is a strategic role with a strong operational focus, significant decision-making authority, and close collaboration with internal teams, authorities, and local stakeholders.

REQUIREMENTS

    A relevant degree in engineering, safety, risk management, HSE or fire protection, or equivalent experience.
    At least five years of safety or HSE experience from a regulated industrial or operational environment.
    Experience leading specialists and coordinating safety across several functions.
    Experience developing and maintaining safety management systems.
    Strong knowledge of risk management, emergency preparedness, and regulatory compliance.
    Experience working with authorities, permits, and external stakeholders.
    Fluent Swedish and English, both spoken and written.

Experience from aviation, airports, aerospace, defence or another safety-critical field is highly valued. Knowledge of flight safety, airspace coordination, Seveso, explosive materials, ADR, or systematic fire protection is an advantage.

You are an analytical and confident leader who remains calm under pressure. You combine structure and integrity with a practical approach and are comfortable making difficult decisions when safety is at stake. You also know how to build trust, challenge unsafe practices, and turn requirements into effective action.

RESPONSIBILITIES

    Lead and develop the overall safety function and Safety Management System at Esrange.
    Ensure clear safety frameworks, processes, and responsibilities.
    Coordinate the Esrange Safety Board and safety preparations for launches, tests and campaigns.
    Lead and coordinate safety specialists across range safety, flight safety, fire protection and emergency preparedness.
    Ensure compliance with relevant legislation, permits and authority requirements.
    Develop the site-wide crisis and emergency response organization, including training and exercises.
    Coordinate airspace, impact-area and public-safety matters with authorities and external stakeholders.
    Oversee incident management, safety planning, budgeting and continuous improvement.

WE OFFER YOU

    A unique opportunity to contribute to a wide range of projects and play an active role in both the Swedish and international space industry.
    An excellent opportunity for personal and career development.
    An exciting, international workplace characterized by an open atmosphere and proud employees all over the world.

Additional benefits

    In addition to vacation and traditional public holidays, we offer extra paid leave throughout the year, such as time off between Christmas and New Year, Ascension Day, amounting to 6-11 extra days depending on the calendar.
    Wellness allowance of SEK 5,000 per year.
    Health benefits such as voluntary health insurance and regular health checks for eligible employees.
    Access to a benefit bike through a tax-efficient leasing program.
    Support for employee-driven activities that promote connection, health, and culture across teams.
    Collective Agreement, including good pensions plans, parental pay and insurance.



LOCATION

This is a full-time, permanent position based at Esrange Space Center outside of Kiruna.

  

NEXT STEP

If this opportunity sparks your interest, we encourage you to apply as soon as possible! We review applications continuously and will conduct interviews throughout the process.

When applying, please include your CV. While you are welcome to include a brief personal note or letter, our evaluation will primarily focus on your skills and qualifications as outlined in your CV, ensuring a fair and unbiased recruitment process.

This position is security-sensitive and requires approved security vetting and background check in accordance with the protective security act. Additional requirements regarding citizenship may apply.

WE HELP EARTH BENEFIT FROM SPACE

SSC Space is a leading global provider of advanced space services, with more than 50 years of experience. We help space organizations, research institutes, commercial and institutional actors from all over the world to get access to space.

With local presence on all continents and about 800 committed employees, we offer specialist expertise in satellite communications and satellite control services, spacecraft operations, rocket and balloon systems, launch services and flight test services, as well as engineering, operations and consultancy services for space missions.

 We help Earth benefit from Space. Learn more at sscspace.com

jobs.title: Piping Team Leader
jobs.description:
Gemkom Engineering and Machinery Filial is a newly established branch of the Turkish company Gemkom. It is a leading engineering and manufacturing company that operates in a number of areas and in various ways within the steel industry.

We are participating in a project where Stegra AB establishes a steel mill in Norra Svartbyn in Boden where steel will be produced through an almost fossil-free process using hydrogen gas. Our mission is, among other things, to install machines used in steel production and includes work in mechanics, electronics and plumbing.

We now want to employ Piping Team Leaders. The work tasks may include but are not limited to:

Job Description

The Piping Team Leader is responsible for supervising and coordinating all piping installation and maintenance activities on site. This role involves leading a team of piping fitters and related personnel to ensure piping systems are installed, assembled, and maintained according to engineering drawings, project specifications, quality standards, and safety regulations. The Piping Team Leader ensures work is completed efficiently, safely, and within project timelines.

Key Responsibilities

· Lead and supervise piping crews, including piping fitters and support personnel, during installation and maintenance activities.

· Review and interpret engineering drawings, blueprints, piping isometrics, and technical specifications.

· Plan, organize, and assign daily work activities to ensure project schedules and deadlines are met.

· Oversee installation, alignment, and assembly of piping systems, valves, pumps, and associated equipment.

· Ensure proper pipe routing, supports, fittings, and installation methods in accordance with engineering requirements.

· Monitor work progress and ensure high standards of quality and workmanship.

· Coordinate with welding teams, mechanical crews, engineers, and supervisors to ensure smooth project execution.

· Conduct routine inspections of piping installations and ensure compliance with project specifications and industry standards.

· Ensure all work activities comply with company safety policies, site safety procedures, and regulatory requirements.

· Identify and resolve technical or installation issues that arise during project execution.

· Maintain records of work progress, manpower utilization, and materials usage.

· Provide technical guidance, training, and support to piping crew members when necessary.

Qualifications

· Experience in piping installation and maintenance in industrial, construction, or plant environments is preferred.

· Experience as a Piping Fitter or similar role, with leadership or supervisory experience preferred.

· Strong ability to read and interpret piping drawings, isometric drawings, and technical documentation.

· Knowledge of piping materials, fittings, valves, installation techniques, and industry standards.

· Understanding of safety procedures and construction site practices.

Skills and Competencies

· Leadership and team management skills

· Strong technical knowledge of piping systems

· Planning and organizational ability

· Problem-solving and decision-making skills

· Strong communication and coordination skills

· Commitment to quality and safety standards

Our headquarters are in Stockholm, and applications are received via the specified e-mail address.

jobs.title: Program Controller to premium EV brand!
jobs.description:
Are you an analytical controller with a passion for the automotive industry and product lifecycles? Do you thrive in cross-functional, international environments where your financial insights directly shape key strategic decisions? Then this might be your next opportunity!

About the position

Perido is looking for a Program Controller to join our client, a leading global premium EV brand. This positions is located in Gothenburg.

In this role, you will hold a key position supporting the development and financial steering of vehicle programs throughout key program milestones. You will work closely with Program Management and cross-functional stakeholders—including R&D, Manufacturing, Design, Procurement, Business Office, Volume Planning, and Finance—to ensure financial transparency and drive efficient program execution. The position uniquely combines program controlling across the full product lifecycle with financial controlling within a major automotive group, covering joint venture production and strategic sister-brand operations. providing broad exposure to both program and product cost controlling. You will also engage in close cooperation with international counterparts.

Your daily tasks

    Drive and communicate the financial progression of model year programs against established targets and milestones
    Serve as a key financial partner to program management, providing quality-assured financial data to support decision-making throughout the program lifecycle
    Act as the primary contact for program-related financial matters, both within Finance and towards operational stakeholders
    Secure, analyze, and deliver investment (CAPEX), cost, and profitability data for program milestones, including clear explanations of variances and underlying business drivers
    Actively participate in all financial planning processes, including Forecasts, Budget, and Business Planning (BPL), covering investment spend and vehicle profitability
    Lead financial controlling activities for manufacturing plants, ensuring robust reporting, analyses, and financial performance assessments aligned with business realities
    Perform financial analyses of transfer prices from manufacturing plants in close collaboration with transfer pricing controllers
    Drive and support business case development and investigations related to manufacturing operations, including Bill of Material (BOM) development, cost improvement initiatives, and cost reduction tracking

Your characteristics

To succeed in this role, you possess a strong analytical mindset and the ability to translate complex financial information into actionable business insights. You thrive in a fast-paced, cross-functional, and international environment, balancing strategic financial planning with operational business support. As a person, you are self-motivated, driven, and proactive when it comes to solving issues and suggesting improvements. You possess excellent communication skills and have a proven ability to build strong working relationships with multiple stakeholders.

Does this sound like an exciting challenge for you? We look forward to receiving your application—apply today!

Qualifications:

    Degree in Finance, Business Administration, Industrial Engineering, or equivalent academic background
    3–10 years of experience in financial controlling or analyst roles, including experience setting and following up targets
    Outstanding analytical capabilities
    Very strong skills in Excel and complex data handling
    Strong project management skills, acting as the key link and center for inputs from numerous internal stakeholders
    Excellent communication skills with fluency in written and spoken English

jobs.title: segretario/segretaria
jobs.description: On behalf of the Italian Entrepreneurial Holding of a growing international Group, we are looking for a Consolidation & Reporting Manager. Reporting directly to the Corporate Finance Manager, this is a stand-alone role. The successful candidate will actively contribute to building Group accounting processes and must possess comprehensive knowledge of IFRS principles. Key Responsibilities Preparation of monthly and annual consolidated financial statements, including adjusting and consolidation entries. Reconciliation of intercompany accounts and elimination entries, including the investigation and resolution of reconciliation variances. Translation of foreign subsidiaries' financial statements and management of foreign exchange differences. Management of changes in the consolidation scope, including acquisitions, mergers, takeovers, and corporate reorganizations. Support in accounting for Purchase Price Allocation (PPA), goodwill, and consolidation differences, where applicable. Preparation of reporting packages and accounting instructions for Group companies. Analysis of data submitted by subsidiaries, ensuring completeness, accuracy, and consistency, and managing detailed follow-up requests. Support in preparing the consolidated Notes to the Financial Statements and documentation for auditors and corporate governance bodies. Liaison with the Financial Planning & Analysis (FP&A) team to ensure consistency between management reporting and consolidated financial data. Liaison with the administrative teams of foreign subsidiaries, providing support for accounting and administrative activities. Requirements Degree in Economics, Accounting, Finance, or a related field. 5+ years of experience in Group Consolidation, Financial Reporting, External Audit, or Corporate Accounting. Previous experience within multinational listed companies or top-tier audit and advisory firms. Strong knowledge of IAS/IFRS Proven ability to manage complex reporting activities under tight deadlines Fluent English, both written and spoken, used regularly in a professional environment. Knowledge of USGAAP and experience with Oracle are a plus Offer Permanent employment Contract RAL between €50,000 and €60,000 1 day of remote working per week #LI-AM2

jobs.title: Fachplaner / Sachverständiger vorbeugender Brandschutz (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
Für unser mittelständiges, seit Jahrzehnten am Markt erfolgreich tätiges Architektur- und Ingenieurbüro in Berlin-Kaulsdorf suchen wir zur Verstärkung unseres Architekten- und Tragwerksplanungsteams einen interessierten Architekten oder Bauingenieur.

Unsere Projekte sind vielfältig und unterscheiden sich sowohl in Größe als auch im Hinblick auf die spätere Nutzung. So planen wir Mehrfamilienhäuser für professionelle Bauherren ebenso wie Kindergärten, Pflegeheime, Bürogebäude oder Hochbauten und Industriebauvorhaben für öffentliche Bauherren. Neben innovativen Lösungen für Neubauten bieten wir ebenso sorgsam durchdachte Planungen für die Sanierung, Aufstockung oder den Dachgeschossausbau von Altbauten.

Aufgaben

  • Erstellung von vorbeugenden Brandschutzkonzepten und prüffähigen Brandschutznachweisen für Neu- und Bestandsbauten
  • Fachliche Beratung von Bauherren, Architekten und Fachplanern in allen Fragen des Brandschutzes
  • Konstruktive brandschutztechnische Baubegleitung von der Planung bis zur Umsetzung

jobs.title: Servicetechniker (m/w/d) – Großbatteriespeicher/ EMSR-Technik
jobs.description:
Über uns

Ohne Speicher keine Energiewende.

ju:niz Energy entwickelt und betreibt seit über zehn Jahren netzdienliche Großbatteriespeicher. Unsere Anlagen stabilisieren das Stromnetz und schaffen die Flexibilität, die eine Energieversorgung mit erneuerbaren Energien braucht. Wir investieren selbst in unsere Projekte und behalten die Speicher langfristig im Bestand.

Für unser Operations-Team suchen wir dich als Servicetechniker (m/w/d). Du sorgst dafür, dass unsere Anlagen sicher und zuverlässig laufen. Du kannst überall in Deutschland wohnen: Von deinem Wohnort aus betreust du unsere Anlagen im gesamten Bundesgebiet. Je nach Einsatzplanung gehören auch mehrtägige Touren mit Übernachtung dazu. Aufgaben, die keine Anwesenheit an der Anlage erfordern, kannst du von zu Hause erledigen.

Deine Aufgaben

  • An unseren Großbatteriespeichern und elektrotechnischen Nebenanlagen führst du Wartungen, Inspektionen und Instandsetzungen durch.
  • Tritt eine Störung auf, grenzt du die Ursache systematisch ein, behebst den Fehler und tauschst bei Bedarf Komponenten aus – vor Ort oder, soweit möglich, per Fernzugriff.
  • Mithilfe von SCADA-, EMS- und Fernwirksystemen überwachst und parametrierst du unsere Anlagen.
  • Bei Inbetriebnahmen, Funktionstests, Netztests und Upgrades bringst du deine technische Erfahrung ein und führst Prüfungen im Rahmen deiner Qualifikation durch.
  • Deine Einsätze, Messergebnisse und Lösungen hältst du nachvollziehbar fest. Wiederkehrende Fehler und Verbesserungspotenziale besprichst du mit dem Operations-Team, damit unsere Anlagen langfristig zuverlässig laufen.

Dein Profil

  • Eine abgeschlossene Ausbildung im elektrotechnischen Bereich bildet deine Grundlage – zum Beispiel als Elektroniker für Betriebstechnik, Elektroniker für Automatisierungstechnik oder Mechatroniker mit elektrotechnischer Erfahrung.
  • In der Wartung oder Instandhaltung elektrischer Anlagen, industrieller Steuerungen oder Energieanlagen hast du bereits praktische Erfahrung gesammelt. Kenntnisse von Batteriespeichern sind willkommen, aber keine Voraussetzung.
  • Schaltpläne und technische Dokumentation liest du sicher; bei der Fehlersuche gehst du strukturiert vor.
  • Erfahrung mit EMSR-Technik, SCADA, EMS oder Kommunikationsprotokollen wie Modbus und IEC 61850 ist ein Plus.
  • Eigenverantwortliches Arbeiten liegt dir. Du kommunizierst sicher auf Deutsch und besitzt einen Führerschein der Klasse B.
  • Für Einsätze an unseren Anlagen reist du innerhalb Deutschlands. Auch mehrtägige Touren mit Übernachtung sind für dich grundsätzlich möglich.

Warum wir?

  • Technik mit Wirkung: Deine Arbeit trägt dazu bei, dass Großbatteriespeicher zuverlässig funktionieren und das Stromnetz stabilisieren.
  • Abwechslungsreiche Einsätze: Dich erwarten unterschiedliche Anlagen und Aufgaben – von der Fehleranalyse bis zur Inbetriebnahme.
  • Deutschlandweiter Einstieg: Dein Wohnort muss nicht in der Nähe unseres Büros in Aschheim liegen.
  • Fachliche Entwicklung: Bei uns kannst du dein Wissen in der Batterietechnik und im Anlagenbetrieb weiter ausbauen.
  • Direkte Zusammenarbeit: Du arbeitest mit einem kollegialen Team und kurzen Entscheidungswegen.

Kontakt

Bewirb dich jetzt – auch wenn dein Lebenslauf nicht alle Punkte erfüllt. Entscheidend sind Motivation, Potenzial und dein Wille, die Energiewende aktiv mitzugestalten.

Wir freuen uns ausdrücklich über Bewerbungen von Menschen mit unterschiedlichen Hintergründen, Perspektiven und Erfahrungen. Gemeinsam schaffen wir ein Umfeld, in dem jeder sein volles Potenzial entfalten kann.

Dein Ansprechpartner
Moritz Erlbeck
People Growth & Hiring Lead

Om stillinga 

Gulen kommune har ledig to i inntil 100% faste stillingar som sjukepleiar ved Sone Brekke, Byrknes og Dalsøyra (Sone BBD) frå snarast/etter avtale. Desse stillingane er for tida knytt til rullerande todelt turnus på 12 veker i Brekke. Den eine faste stillinga har arbeid med langvakter 4. kvar helg og ordinære vakter i vekedagane. Den andre faste stillinga har langvakter kvar 4. helg og kombinasjon av langvakter og ordinære vakter i vekedagane. 

Ta kontakt med kontaktperson i annonsen dersom du har spørsmål til stillingane/turnus.

Me tilbyr

  • Spanande stillingar i ei teneste i utvikling. Rom for å kunne bidra aktivt i utviklingsarbeidet  
  • Bonusordning på 100 000kr (i 100% stilling) ved binding i 2 år i desse stillingane. Bonus vert som hovudregel betalt ut på slutten av bindingstida, om ikkje anna vert avtalt
  • Løn over tariff for sjukepleiarar i turnus
  • Ekstra helgekompensasjon ved gått vakt

Arbeidsoppgåver 
  • Sjukepleiefagleg ansvar og oppgåver
  • Pasientretta oppgåver, som til dømes pleie og oppfølging av brukarane
  • Samarbeid med andre faggrupper, 2. linjeteneste m.fl.
  • Andre oppgåver som måtte kome til

I sone BBD arbeider det både nyutdanna og tilsette med lang erfaring. Det er eit tett og godt samarbeid mellom assistentar, fagarbeidarar og sjukepleiarar/vernepleiarar kvar dag. Samarbeidet er viktig for at tenestene våre skal verte best mogleg for innbyggjarane i Gulen kommune, og noko me har fokus på kontinuerleg


Kvalifikasjonskrav 
  • Autorisasjon som sjukepleiar
  • Gode norskkunnskapar - både munnleg og skriftleg
  • Gyldig politiattest 
  • Førarkort klasse B

Personlege eigenskapar 
  • Er fleksibel og kommuniserer/samhandlar godt med brukarar/pårørande og kollegaer
  • Vert motivert av å yte gode tenester til brukarane, og kan vere med å gje dei ein stabil og god kvardag
  • Kan bidra til eit godt arbeidsmiljø og har fokus på kvalitet og faglig utvikling
  • Tar initiativ, er strukturert, fleksibel og har gode samarbeidsevner
  • Å vere personleg eigna kan verte vektlagt ved tilsetjing

Anna 
  • Tenestespråket i Gulen kommune er nynorsk

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Gulen kommune ligg vakkert til ved innløpet til Sognefjorden. Kommunen består av både fjell- og kystlandskap, med 1500 øyer, holmar og skjær, som innbyr til eit aktivt friluftsliv både på land og ved sjøen.

Kommunen har 2301 innbyggjarar, ledige barnehageplassar, og er eit godt oppvekstmiljø for barn og unge. Sjå Gulen kommune for meir informasjon.

jobs.title: Gryning söker enhetschef till Bergiusgården i Ljungskile
jobs.description:
Ägs av kommuner – drivs av engagemang! I 25år har Gryning erbjudit HVB- och öppenvård för barn, ungdomar och familjer, jour- och familjehem, beroendevård, lägenheter med stöd, insatser mot hedersrelaterat våld och förtryck samt LSS-boende. Vi erbjuder rådgivning och utbildning samt hjälper till med placeringar. Gryning ägs av kommunerna i Västra Götaland via de fyra kommunalförbunden.

Bergiusgården tar emot ungdomar mellan 16-21 år med missbruksproblematik, där vi erbjuder heldygnsomsorg och kvalificerad behandling. Ungdomarna placeras enligt SOL eller LVU. Vår huvuduppgift är att tillsammans med ungdomen och hens nätverk möjliggöra ett förändringsarbete i en trygg och stabil miljö där vi strävar efter att bidra till förändrade, förbättrade och varaktiga livsvillkor för den unge.

Vi söker nu dig som enhetschef som tillsammans med Gryning vill utveckla verksamheten på Bergius!

1 plats(er).

ARBETSUPPGIFTER
Vad innebär tjänsten?

Verksamheten vilar på ett miljöterapeutiskt förhållningssätt där struktur och relation är centrala delar. Vi arbetar med lågaffektivt bemötande, där MI genomsyrar både samtal och vardagligt förhållningssätt och vi utgår från traumamedveten omsorg i allt vi gör. Som enhetschef för Bergiusgården har du det övergripande ansvaret för verksamhetens kvalitet, ekonomi, personal och arbetsmiljö. Du leder, planerar och följer upp verksamheten med fokus på hög kvalitet och hållbara arbetssätt.

I rollen ingår även ansvar för kundkontakter, samverkan med uppdragsgivare och myndigheter samt arbete med verksamhets- och metodutveckling. Du har många både interna och externa kontaktytor och samverkar nära kollegor inom Gryning.

Tjänsten ger dig chans att påverka både struktur, kultur och arbetssätt.

KVALIFIKATIONER
Vem är du?

Du är en trygg, tydlig och engagerande ledare med förmåga att skapa delaktighet och driva verksamheten mot uppsatta mål. Du arbetar strukturerat, har god planeringsförmåga och är van att följa upp och utveckla verksamhet och medarbetare. Ditt ledarskap präglas av lyhördhet, lösningsfokus och ett genuint engagemang för både personal och målgrupp.

Du har akademisk examen, exempelvis som socionom, socialpedagog, beteendevetare eller annan utbildning som arbetsgivaren bedömer likvärdig. Då du som enhetschef ansvarar för verksamhetens tillstånd behöver du uppfylla IVO:s krav på relevant högskoleutbildning samt erfarenhet från liknande verksamhet. Det är meriterande om du har arbetslivserfarenhet av aktuell målgrupp.

Du har god samarbetsförmåga, är kommunikativ och har förmågan att inspirera till engagemang och ansvarstagande. Tjänsten innebär resor och kräver därför körkort. Stor vikt kommer att läggas vid personlig lämplighet.

Anställningsform: Tillsvidareanställning.
Varaktighet: Tillsvidare.
Arbetstid: Dagtid.

Vi erbjuder

·         Engagerade chefskollegor med bred kompetens och en utvecklande ledningsgrupp

·         En kultur som präglas av kunskap, kvalitet och delaktighet

·         Handledning, chefsutveckling, kompetensutveckling och olika former av medarbetardialoger

Vi ser fram emot din ansökan!  

Urval och intervjuande sker löpande så välkommen med din ansökan redan i dag.

Innan anställning görs utdrag ur misstanke- och belastningsregistret samt fördjupad bakgrundskontroll.

Vi undanber oss alla erbjudanden om annonserings- och rekryteringshjälp i samband med denna rekrytering.

jobs.title: Sjuksköterska till geriatriken i Bromma

Verksamheten erbjuder akutgeriatrisk vård och rehabilitering med intag dygnet runt och bedriver även kognitiv mottagning. Vården bedrivs i multiprofessionella team i nära samarbete mellan personal, patient och närstående. Hos oss är delaktighet, utveckling och kvalité fokusområden.

Din roll som sjuksköterskaI samarbete med undersköterskor, läkare och paramedicinska yrkesgrupper ansvarar du för att utföra både basal och specifik omvårdnad, förebygga risker och hantera akuta situationer. I ditt arbete möter du allmängeriatriska patienter med olika diagnoser så som frakturer, stroke och/eller infektioner. Du har alltid nära stöd i dina kollegor och chef men arbetets art bygger på att du ska kunna fatta egna beslut och agera självständigt om situationen kräver, då du som sjuksköterska leder arbetet på avdelningen.

Hos oss får du

    en gedigen introduktion
    en familjär, positiv och inkluderande arbetsplats där vi lär av varandra
    kompetensutveckling med tillgång till interna och externa utbildningar
    en närvarande, lyhörd och engagerad chef
    ett grymt-roligt och professionellt team!

Är du vår nya kollega?

Krav för tjänsten är att du är legitimerad sjuksköterska, gärna med erfarenhet av sjukvård och gärna geriatrisk vård, samt har goda kunskaper i svenska tal och skrift. Stor vikt läggs vid personliga egenskaper och vi söker dig som:

    är trygg och självständig i din profession
    trivs med den variation som arbetet erbjuder i kombination med att du är lösningsorienterad i din natur
    har ett mjukt och respektfullt bemötande samt har en förmåga att på ett naturligt sätt etablera en god relation till patient och närstående

Låter detta som du? Då kommer du att trivas med oss och vi med dig! Varmt välkommen med din ansökan.

Om tjänsten och ansökan

Tjänsten är heltid dag, tillsvidare. Vi tillämpar individuell lönesättning och 6 månaders provanställning.

Urvalet hanteras löpande. Har du ytterligare frågor om tjänsten besvaras de av enhetschef geraitrik joanna.grauers@stockholmssjukhem.se eller Maryam Kahurzadeh, maryam.kahurzadeh@stockholmssjukhem.se.

Vi arbetar för en trygg och säker hälso- och sjukvård. Därför genomför vi bakgrundskontroller som en del i vår rekryteringsprocess och innan anställning. Kontrollerna kan variera beroende på roll. På vår informationssida kan du läsa mer om vilka kontroller som ingår.

Stockholms Sjukhem arbetar med kompetensbaserad rekrytering som syftar till att se till varje persons kompetens för att främja att vi är en arbetsplats för alla.  Vi har tagit ställning till annonsering, vilket gör att vi inte önskar säljsamtal för ytterligare frågor kring annonsering, rekrytering eller bemanning.

Stockholms Sjukhem är en av Sveriges största idéburna vårdgivare. Vi erbjuder ett brett vårdutbud inom geriatrik, rehabilitering, palliativ vård och äldreomsorg. Att bedriva sjukvård och äldreomsorg är ett stort samhällsansvar och som godkänd universitetssjukvårdsenhet arbetar vi ständigt med forskning, utveckling och utbildning. jobs.description:
Job Title: Senior Automation Engineer SCADA

About the Role: We are seeking a highly analytical and experienced Senior Automation Engineer SCADA to ensure the efficient, reliable, and secure operation of our SCADA networks and Substation Automation Systems (SAS). The ideal candidate will be a technical expert capable of leading projects from bay to entire substation SAS/SCADA design and commissioning.

Key Responsibilities & Core Requirements:

    HVAC Substation Automation: Core Knowledge and Hands-on experience in HVAC Substation Automation.
    System & Network Mastery: Extensive SCADA, RTU, PLC, Networking, and Protocol expertise. Familiarity with multi-vendor systems (such as ABB RTU, Schneider PACiS, or MicroSCADA) and PLC programming is highly valued.
    Design & Commissioning: Hands-on experience in design and commissioning of HVAC Substations (specifically 66/132kV). This must include IED Communication configuration, signal testing, SCADA Configuration, Data concentrator configuration, along with Protocol conversion knowledge and hands-on experience.
    Process & Risk Management: Able to follow the process, identify gaps and risks, and propose solution recommendations to ensure the operational integrity of our SAS/SCADA systems remains optimal.
    Protocol Proficiency: Competence in configuring and troubleshooting standard industry protocols, including IEC61850, IEC60870-5-101, IEC60870-5-104, DNP3, and Modbus.
    Testing & Execution: Preparation of signal lists, commissioning reports, and active participation in Factory Acceptance Testing (FAT) and Site Acceptance Testing (SAT).
    Cybersecurity & Networking: Enforcement of cybersecurity adherence, user profile management on SAS systems, and configuration of Ethernet switches, VLANs, and network redundancy.
    Why Join Us? As a Senior Automation Engineer, you will provide expert advice on SAS/SCADA best trends, taking on a crucial role in project scoping, supervision, and the management of major SCADA project works. If you have a proven track record of maintaining conducive operational environments and delivering high-quality automation engineering solutions, we encourage you to apply.

jobs.title: Produktionstekniker - FLIR!
jobs.description:
Gillar du att skruva, justera och lösa problem när en maskin inte beter sig som den ska? Då kan det här vara rätt nästa steg för dig.

WeStaff Sweden söker nu en tekniskt nyfiken och praktiskt lagd person till FLIR i Täby. Här får du en vardag där du är nära maskinerna, produktionen och människorna som arbetar med dem.

Det här är en roll för dig som hellre tar fram verktygslådan än sitter still framför ett skrivbord. Du behöver inte kunna allt från början, det viktiga är att du tycker om teknik, vill förstå hur saker fungerar och gillar att hitta lösningar.

Om FLIR

På FLIR i Täby tillverkas avancerade optiska komponenter som används i bland annat värmekameror och andra produkter inom avancerad sensorteknik.

Som Produktionstekniker blir du en del av den dagliga produktionen och arbetar med utrustningen som gör tillverkningen möjlig. Ena stunden kan du behöva undersöka varför en maskin stannat, nästa stund justera en komponent eller hjälpa en operatör att få igång utrustningen igen.

En stor del av rollen handlar om att vara nyfiken och metodisk: Vad har hänt? Varför händer det? Vad behöver justeras eller åtgärdas för att maskinen ska fungera igen?

Du arbetar både med planerat underhåll och med problem som behöver lösas här och nu. Samtidigt får du möjlighet att lära dig mer om avancerade maskiner och processer inom precisionsproduktion.

En vardag nära tekniken

I rollen kommer du bland annat att arbeta med:

    

Felsökning när produktionsutrustning inte fungerar som den ska

    

Förebyggande underhåll och enklare service

    

Justering och byte av mekaniska komponenter

    

Mekanik, pneumatik och enklare el

    

CNC-maskiner och annan precisionsutrustning

    

Slip-, poler- och rengöringsutrustning

    

Kontroller och funktionskontroller av maskiner

    

Dokumentation av underhåll och genomförda åtgärder

    

Installation och uppstart av ny utrustning

    

Förbättringar av maskiner, arbetssätt och processer

    

Teknisk support till operatörer och produktion

Du kommer alltså inte att göra samma sak varje dag. Rollen innebär variation och mycket kontakt med både utrustning och kollegor.

Vem tror vi att du är?

Vi tror att du kan ha många olika vägar in i rollen.

Kanske har du arbetat som industrimekaniker, underhållstekniker, servicetekniker, CNC-tekniker, maskinoperatör eller produktionstekniker. Kanske har du en teknisk utbildning och har upptäckt att det är när du får arbeta praktiskt som du trivs som bäst. Det vi framför allt letar efter är en person som:

    

Är praktiskt lagd och tycker om att arbeta med händerna

    

Har ett genuint tekniskt intresse

    

Gillar att felsöka och lösa problem

    

Har grundläggande kunskaper inom mekanik

    

Har erfarenhet av industri, produktion, service eller underhåll

    

Är bekväm med att använda verktyg och teknisk utrustning

    

Kan läsa och förstå tekniska instruktioner och enklare ritningar

    

Har grundläggande datorvana

    

Behärskar svenska och engelska

Du behöver inte ha erfarenhet från optikbranschen. Har du arbetat med CNC, finmekanik, precisionsmaskiner, medicinteknik eller annan tekniskt avancerad produktion är det ett stort plus, men det är din tekniska förståelse och vilja att lära som väger tyngst.

Vi erbjuder dig

    

Ett spännande uppdrag hos ett innovativt teknikföretag

    

Möjlighet att arbeta med avancerad optik- och sensorteknik

    

En modern arbetsmiljö med hög teknisk kompetens

    

Möjlighet att utvecklas inom underhåll och maskinteknik

    

Goda möjligheter till ett långsiktigt uppdrag för rätt person

    

Anställning hos WeStaff Sweden med kollektivavtal och trygga anställningsvillkor

Praktisk information

Tjänst: Produktionstekniker Omfattning: Heltid Arbetstid: Dagtid, mån-fre Plats: Täby/Arninge Start: Omgående eller enligt överenskommelse

Om WeStaff Sweden AB

WeStaff Sweden AB är ett växande konsult- och rekryteringsföretag inom Produktion & Tillverkning. Våra värderingar bygger på personlig relation, trygghet och långsiktighet.

Vi är ett kunskapsdrivet team med över 30 års samlad erfarenhet från branschen. Vårt arbete kännetecknas av kvalitet, nytänkande och ett personligt engagemang. Läs mer om oss på www.westaff.se

Vill du bli en del av oss? Ansök redan idag och bli vår nästa medarbetare!

jobs.title: Transport and Handling Specialist - Switzerland
jobs.description:
What you'll do:
The Engineering Department (EN) provides CERN with the Engineering expertise, Infrastructure Systems and Technical Coordination necessary for the design, installation, operation, maintenance and dismantling phases of the CERN accelerator complex and its experimental facilities.

The position is within the Transport and Handling Engineering Group (EN-THE), responsible for preparing, organizing and coordinating all transport and handling operations for the CERN accelerators and experiments. The Group also manages the transport of thousands of conventional and unconventional items, chemical and radioactive products each year. As a Transport and Handling Specialist in EN-THE, you will be part of the Heavy Handling (EN-HE-HH) Section, which is in charge for organising and supervising transport, handling and lifting operations at CERNs accelerators complex, experimental areas and industrial buildings both underground and in surface premises.

Your responsibilities:
- Coordinating transport and handling operations for the Accelerator complex, Experiments, and surface premises.
- Coordinating and planning meetings to evaluate technical and resource needs.
- Assessing and proposing possible handling and transport solutions.
- Defining technical and safety requirements for the transport of dangerous goods and ensuring compliance with ADR principles and applicable regulations.
- Specific operations by using customized equipment, analysing related working procedures and Safety assessments.
- Developing technical specifications, work procedures and contract documentation for transport and handling activities.
- Supervising contractor activities on site, ensuring Safety during the operations in both conventional and radioactive environments.
- Collaborating with the EN-THE design office to develop custom handling tools and conduct logistic studies.
- Collaborating with Radiation Protection Services to establish/redact the Work Dose Planning and Radiological work permit (DIMR).
- Performing handling operations in specific situations.

Your profile:
- Extensive experience in heavy handling and transport operations.
- Proven experience in worksite logistics.
- Proven experience in technical contract supervision.

jobs.title: Director, Business Development Data Centers
jobs.description:
Company description:

NKT connects a greener world with high-quality power cable technology and takes centre stage as the world moves towards green energy. NKT designs, manufactures and installs low-, medium- and high-voltage power cable solutions enabling sustainable energy transmission. Since 1891, NKT has innovated the power cable technology building the infrastructure for the first light bulbs to the megawatts created by renewable energy today. NKT is headquartered in Denmark and employs 6,500 people. NKT is listed on Nasdaq Copenhagen and realised a revenue of EUR 3.6 billion in 2025. We connect a greener world.

Job description:

Build early commercial partnerships across the data centre marketWould you like to shape how NKT engages with customers across the growing data centre segment? As Director, Business Development Data Centers, you will establish early commercial relationships, develop qualified opportunities and coordinate a OneNKT approach across business lines. This international role offers the opportunity to support NKT’s growth journey while contributing to the infrastructure needed for the green transition.

Develop strategic data centre opportunities across selected marketsYou will manage front-end business development across the data centre ecosystem, engaging customers and partners before formal tendering begins. By understanding customer priorities and coordinating internal stakeholders, you will help shape commercial positioning and prepare qualified opportunities for handover to the relevant business line. You will also contribute to NKT’s data centre go-to-market strategy and provide structured insights into market dynamics, customer needs, competitors and portfolio gaps.Your responsibility will be to:


    Map and prioritise target customers, projects and decision-makers
    Build relationships with developers, operators, EPC contractors, integrators and OEMs
    Develop and manage qualified opportunities through early customer engagement
    Coordinate customer activities across NKT business lines and functions
    Support partnership discussions, market analysis and management updates

The position may be based in London, Runcorn, Teesside, Cologne, Berlin, Malmö, Karlskrona or Copenhagen. Planned travel of more than 50 days per year is expected, including customer meetings, industry forums and partner discussions.

Profile description:

Commercial relationship builder with a collaborative working styleYou communicate clearly with people at different organisational levels and create trust through a consistent and considered approach. You are comfortable working across functions, balancing several stakeholder perspectives and maintaining structure as opportunities develop. Curiosity, sound judgement and an ability to translate discussions into practical next steps will help you work effectively in an international and matrix-based organisation.You also have:




    A Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Business, Engineering, Economics or a related field
    Experience in business development, strategic sales, key account management or go-to-market roles within electrical infrastructure, electrical components or power solutions
    Experience with complex solution selling
    Established network and experience within the data centre ecosystem, including developers, operators, EPC contractors, integrators or OEMs
    A record of developing senior external and internal relationships and early-stage commercial opportunities
    Fluent English



Connect data centre growth with the green transitionWe aim to create a workplace where people of all backgrounds are valued, supported, and able to do their best work. We are dedicated to increasing gender diversity at NKT and welcome applications from a wide range of candidates. We welcome varied backgrounds and career paths, even if you don’t meet every single requirement. We believe inclusive teams contribute to positive results and create a better everyday work environment.



This role offers opportunities for professional development in a collaborative, international setting. You will expand your knowledge of the data centre value chain, work with colleagues across several business lines and develop your commercial and strategic capabilities. You will also contribute to NKT’s market approach within a growing infrastructure segment connected to the green transition.“As a leader, I believe in giving you the freedom to manage tasks while being available to support you when needed. I appreciate work-life balance and aim to build an environment that supports it", says Hiring Manager, Simone Pagliuca

jobs.title: Administrative Assistant
jobs.description:
The CERN Staff Association (SA) is committed to promoting the welfare of CERN personnel through a wide range of services and initiatives. Among these is the Jardin des Particules (JDP), an early childhood education and childcare facility located at CERN, welcoming children from 4 months to 10 years old.

We are looking for an experienced Administrative Assistant to play a central role in the day-to-day administration and management of the Jardin des Particules. This is a varied position combining human resources administration, financial management and operational coordination within a Swiss employment framework.

If you enjoy taking ownership of diverse administrative responsibilities, have solid knowledge of Swiss employment administration and thrive in an international environment, then join the CERN Staff Association and contribute to an essential service for the CERN community.

Your responsibilities
-Managing the full administrative lifecycle of JDP employees, including recruitment administration, employment contracts, amendments, onboarding and departures.
-Coordinating payroll administration with the external fiduciary and ensuring the accuracy of salary-related information.
-Managing personnel administration in accordance with Swiss employment legislation, including social insurance, pension schemes (LPP), employment contracts, leave management and other statutory obligations.
-Acting as the main administrative contact for JDP staff on employment-related matters.
-Monitoring the JDP budget, processing invoices and payments, maintaining accounting records and supporting financial reporting.
-Performing financial monitoring and analysis to support sound budget management.
-Liaising with external partners including the fiduciary, insurance providers and public authorities when required.
-Preparing communication and promotional material for the Jardin des Particules and supporting its visibility within the CERN community.
-Contributing to the continuous improvement of administrative and financial processes.
-In addition, you will provide occasional support to the Staff Association Secretariat by welcoming visitors and responding to general enquiries.

Your profile
-Demonstrated experience managing employment administration under Swiss labour legislation, including employment contracts, payroll administration, social insurance, occupational pension schemes (LPP) and other statutory employment obligations.
-Proven experience in administrative, HR and financial administration within a small or medium-sized enterprise (SME) in Switzerland.
-Experience working with external fiduciaries or payroll providers would be an asset.
-Experience in an international or multicultural environment would be an advantage.
-Technical Certificate or General Secondary Education or equivalent relevant experience in the field of Administration, Human Resources, Accounting, Finance or a related field.

Your skills
Secretarial work.
Use of office software packages.
Knowledge of accounting software, such as Crésus, would be an asset.
Accounting, budget monitoring and financial control.

jobs.title: PhD Candidate in Risk-Based Power System Operation and Utilisation of Transformer Capacity
jobs.description:
This is NTNU

NTNU is a broad-based university with a technical-scientific profile and a focus in professional education. The university is located in three cities with headquarters in Trondheim.

At NTNU, 9,000 employees and 43,000 students work to create knowledge for a better world.

You will find more information about working at NTNU and the application process here.

   

Video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=_KHQjc4ndas&t=41sAbout the position

Are you motivated to take a step towards a doctorate and open up exciting career opportunities? Do you have a background in electric power systems and are you interested in risk-based power system operation? As a PhD Candidate with us, you will work to achieve your doctorate, and at the same time gain valuable experience that qualifies you for a further career in higher education and research, in and outside academia. 

The Department of Electric Energy (IEL) at NTNU is seeking a highly motivated candidate for a full-time (100%) PhD position for 3 years in “Risk-Based Power System Operation and Utilisation of Transformer Capacity”. You will join the research group Power System Operation and Analysis (PSOA) at IEL, where we foster an open, inclusive, and collaborative working environment.

Our working environment is characterized by a friendly, supportive atmosphere, with regular gatherings such as professional meetings within the research group, weekly research colloquia, shared lunches, and “Friday coffee” sessions to wrap up the week. Formal and informal gatherings provide opportunities to exchange ideas, celebrate milestones, and strengthen connections. PhD Candidates also arrange social activities, open to everyone who wishes to join, creating a welcoming and inclusive community.

Your immediate Line Manager will be the Head of Department.


About the project

The PhD position is a part of the Knowledge-building Project “Increasing Emergency Load Limits for Transformers” (KSP UPLOAD) that is starting up in 2027. SINTEF Energy Research is the project owner.  NTNU is a participating partner, together with leading industry partners. Hiring for the PhD position is subject to the final confirmation of funding availability from KSP UPLOAD.

Liquid-immersed power transformers are critical power grid assets. Due to an ageing power grid, growing demand for electricity, and very long lead times on installing new transformers, there is a need to both increase the utilization of existing infrastructure of transformers and to maximise the value of new investments. Increasing the short-term load limits for transformers will free up capacity to accommodate new load and generation, reduce the need for reinvestments, and provide back-up capacity in case of emergency. Improved methods for condition monitoring and prediction, along with better risk criteria can reduce uncertainties and offer a possibility for increasing the transformer loading. KSP UPLOAD will investigate key failure mechanisms for transformers, map the benefits and risks of increasing the load and temperature limits, and pilot new concepts for risk control. 

The PhD Position belongs to Work Package 1 of KSP UPLOAD: ‘System-level Benefits and Risks in from Increased Loading’. It addresses the question of how to quantify the socio-economic benefits, as well as the risk with respect to reliability of supply, when operating transformers beyond nameplate limits. 

The tasks meant for the PhD work are related to:  

  • Quantifying how higher loading limits affect the socio-economic trade-off between reliability of supply and making additional capacity available to power markets with flow-based market coupling.
  • Developing methods for optimally allocating the additional transfer capability enabled by increased transformer loading limits across day-ahead, intraday, and balancing markets to maximize socio-economic value while respecting system security and reliability constraints.

Different approaches can be explored, such as integrating probabilistic and deterministic reliability criteria with market operation in a single security-constrained optimal power flow model, and combining optimal power flow analysis with reliability analysis methods.

The main supervisor of the PhD Candidate will be Associate Professor Vijay Venu Vadlamudi (IEL). Co-supervisors will be Professor Hossein Farahmand (IEL) and Senior Research Scientist Iver Bakken Sperstad (SINTEF Energy Research). 


Duties of the position
  • Conduct high-quality research within the framework described above.
  • Participate in activities of the research group Power System Operation and Analysis (PSOA).
  • Complete academic training consisting of coursework corresponding to a minimum of 30 ECTS.
  • Contribute to publications in relevant journals and to popular science dissemination.
  • Participate in international activities such as conferences and/or research stays at foreign educational institutions.

Career-enhancing work, which is in addition to the research project and doctoral education, may be offered to a candidate who demonstrates clear motivation and ability for such work, and if the Department determines there is a need. Examples of career-enhancing work include, but are not limited to, contributing to teaching, laboratory and exercise teaching, supervision, and examination work within the employee's areas of competence. 

Be prepared for changes to your work duties after employment.


Required selection criteria
  • You must hold a Master’s degree within Electric Power Engineering, with specialization in electric power and/or energy systems. 
  • Your course of study must correspond to a five-year Norwegian course, where 120 credits have been obtained at the Master's level. Master's students can apply, but the Master's degree must be obtained and documented before starting the position, and no later than autumn 2026.
  • You must have proficient programming skills in Python.
  • Employment is contingent upon the candidate’s ability to obtain the required security clearance.
  • You must have a strong academic background from your previous studies and have an average grade from your Master's degree study, or equivalent education, which is equal to B or better compared to NTNU's grading scale. If you do not have letter grades from previous studies, you must have an equally good academic foundation. If you have a weaker grade background, you may be considered if you can document that you are particularly suitable for a PhD education, i.e., by having relevant work experience and/or published/publishable scientific papers.
  • You must meet the requirements for admission to the Faculty's Doctoral Programme.
  • You must have English language skills, both written and spoken, corresponding to the scale B2 in the Common European Framework of Reference for Languages (CEFR). Applicants who are not native English speakers are encouraged to document their English language proficiency. One of the following test scores could be documented for this purpose: 
    • TOEFL internet-based test (iBT) - Score equivalent to the B2 level: 79 - 101. 
    • IELTS - Score equivalent to the B2 level: 5.5 - 6.0 
    • Cambridge English - Score equivalent to the B2 level: 160 - 179.

Further assessment of both written and oral English language skills and the ability to communicate fluently will be conducted in the continued selection process and during any interviews for all applicants.

PLEASE NOTE: For detailed information about what the application must contain, see paragraph “About the application”.

The appointment is to be made in accordance with NTNUs guidelines for recruitment positions for general criteria for the position.


Preferred selection criteria
  • Master’s thesis relevant to the announced position.
  • English language skills, both written and spoken, corresponding to the scale C1 in the Common European Framework of Reference for Languages (CEFR). See which scores are equivalent to the C1 level here.
  • Proficiency in a Scandinavian language (Norwegian, Swedish, or Danish), both written and spoken, at B2 level or higher is considered an advantage. The candidate is expected to collaborate with stakeholders in the Norwegian industry and utility sectors, where Norwegian is the working language.

Personal characteristics

To complete a doctoral degree (PhD), it is important that you are able to: 

  • demonstrate strong motivation, curiosity, and a learning-oriented mindset
  • work independently, take initiative, and maintain good structure and discipline in their work
  • communicate effectively and collaborate well with supervisors and peers
  • show resilience and work constructively when facing challenges or setbacks
  • demonstrate integrity and a strong sense of responsibility in their research conduct

Emphasis will be placed on personal qualities.


We offer
  • An exciting job with an important mission in society
  • Developing tasks in a strong and international professional environment
  • Career guidance and follow-up during the PhD period
  • Open and inclusive working environment with committed colleagues
  • Social activities organized by PhD Students
  • Weekly social gathering on Fridays (Friday coffee)
  • Working capital that can be used to implement the project
  • Mentor programme as a new employee at NTNU
  • Favorable terms as a member of the Norwegian Public Service Pension Fund (SPK)  
  • Free Norwegian language training at a basic level (A2)

As a PhD Candidate at NTNU, you will have access to employee benefits.


Diversity

Diversity is a strength, and at NTNU we aim to be an employer that reflects the diversity in society and that makes use of the potential of the population's collective skills. Our vision is Knowledge for a better world and our values ​​are creative, critical, constructive and respectful. We believe that an organization that is equal, diverse and gender-balanced is essential for us to achieve our goals.  

We strive to attract employees with different skills, life experiences and perspectives to contribute to even better problem solving of our societal mission in research and education. 

If you think this position is relevant and interesting, we encourage you to apply, regardless of gender, functional ability and cultural background, or whether you have been out of work for a period of time.

At NTNU we want to increase the proportion of women in scientific positions. We have a number of measures to promote equality. 


Salary and conditions

In the position of PhD Candidate, code 1017, your gross salary will normally be NOK 580 000,-per annum depending on qualifications and seniority. A 2% statutory contribution to the State Pension Fund is deducted from the salary. 

The employment period is 3 years, with the possibility of an additional 3 to 12 months of employment related to career-enhancing activities. 

The option for career-enhancing work may be offered to a candidate who has clear motivation and ability for such work, and if the Department deems it necessary. This will be clarified with the candidate during and after any interview.  

For employment as a PhD Candidate, it is a prerequisite that you gain admission to the PhD programme in Electric Power Engineering within three months of your employment contract start date, and that you participate in an organized doctoral programme throughout the period of employment.

The position is conditional on external funding.

As an employee at NTNU, it is important that you keep yourself up to date with academic and organizational changes and adapt to them.

For the necessary professional and social interaction, it is a prerequisite that you are physically present and available to the institution on a daily basis.

The appointment is carried out in accordance with the principles of the State Employees Act.


About the application

The attachments (including a description of your scientific work) must accompany the application as these documents form the basis of the application assessment. The documents must be in Norwegian/a Scandinavian language or English. 

Please note: the application will only be assessed on the basis of the information we have received by the application deadline. Therefore, make sure that your application clearly shows how your skills and experience meet the criteria described above. The application and all attachments must be sent electronically via Jobbnorge.no. If you are invited to an interview, you must bring certified copies of certificates and diplomas upon request.

The application must include:

  • A cover letter where the applicant describes personal motivation, summarizes scientific work, and explains how the applicant sees her/his background as suitable (400 words/1 page).
  • Project outline containing proposals for an overall description of research questions, theoretical perspectives, methodological design for the project, and progress plan (maximum 1500 words/4 pages, including references). This proposal will be neither final nor binding for the project.
  • CV.
  • If you have testimonials of work experience, submit them.
  • Transcripts and diplomas for Bachelor's and Master's degrees. If you have not yet completed your Master's thesis, you must provide confirmation on your estimated date for the submission of the Master's thesis, or confirmation that your Master's thesis has been submitted.
    • Applicants from universities outside Norway are requested to send a diploma supplement or a similar document, which describes in detail the study programme and grading system.
  • A copy of the Master's thesis. If you recently submitted your Master's thesis, you are encouraged to attach a draft of the thesis. Documentation of a completed Master's degree must be presented before taking up the position. 
  • If you have publications or other relevant research work, submit them.
  • You are encouraged to include documentation of English language proficiency if you are not a native speaker of English. 
  • Name and contact information of three referees.


If all, or parts, of your education has been taken abroad, we also ask you to attach documentation of the scope and quality of your entire education, both Bachelor's and Master's education, in addition to other higher education. If your institution uses “diploma supplement” (normal for most European institutions), you must attach this. A description of the documentation required can also be found here. If you already have a statement from Norwegian Directorate for Higher Education and Skills (HK-dir), please attach this as well.


Joint work will be considered. If it is difficult to identify your contribution to joint work, you must attach a brief description of your participation.

When assessing the best qualified, we emphasize necessary qualifications such as education, experience and personal suitability. Motivation for the position, ambitions, and potential for research will also count when assessing the candidates.

NTNU recognizes a wide range of academic contributions and has committed itself to The San Francisco Declaration on Research Assessment and CoARA (responsible assessment of research and recognition of a greater breadth of academic contributions in accordance with NTNU's social mission).


General information

A public list of applicants with name, age, job title and municipality of residence is prepared after the application deadline. If you wish to be exempt from entry on the public applicant list, this must be justified. Assessment will be made in accordance with current legislation. You will be notified if the exemption is not granted.

If you think this position looks interesting and in line with your qualifications, you are welcome to apply.

If you have any questions about the position, please contact Associate Professor Vijay Venu Vadlamudi by email at vijay.vadlamudi@ntnu.no. 

If you have any questions about the recruitment process, please contact Head of Office Bodil Wold by e-mail at bodil.wold@ntnu.no.  

Application deadline: 19.10.2026

Our Crew

jobs.title: Project Coordinator – Business Analysis & Green Technology
jobs.description:
Project Coordinator – Business Analysis & Green Technology

About the Role:

We are seeking a structured and commercially minded Project Coordinator – Business Analysis & Green Technology to join our team.

In this role, you will support company management and ongoing green technology projects by combining project coordination, business analysis, quantitative modelling, technical research, and operational administration.

Working closely with management and project stakeholders, you will organize project information, maintain yield and cost models, evaluate scenarios, support financial and commercial analysis, and translate operational data into structured business information and decision-support material.

Key Responsibilities:

Project Coordination

Support company management with ongoing commercial and technical projects, including tracking deliverables, action points, schedules, project information and administrative follow-ups.

Quantitative Excel Modelling

Develop and maintain Excel-based calculation models and prototypes for process yields, quantities, volumes, pricing, costs, revenues and other project-related calculations.

Scenario & Sensitivity Analysis

Prepare scenario, sensitivity and comparative calculations to assess how changes in operational assumptions may affect commercial outcomes, costs, risks and project viability.

Process & Technical Data Analysis

Research and analyze information relating to thermolysis/pyrolysis processes, feedstocks, process outputs and relevant by-products, and incorporate relevant data into commercial and financial models.

Commercial Data Translation

Translate technical and operational assumptions into practical commercial models, business cases, analyses and presentations suitable for both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

Documentation & Content Development

Prepare and maintain technical, commercial and administrative documentation, reports, presentations, visual materials and other project-related content.

Financial Administration

Support general financial administration, preliminary bookkeeping, invoice verification, cost tracking and project budget follow-ups.

Digital & Information Management

Maintain and organize project information through SharePoint and other digital systems, and assist with maintaining the company's website and LinkedIn presence.

Operational & Management Support

Provide direct administrative and operational support to company management and act as a coordination point for information flow between management, project teams and external contacts.

Qualifications & Experience

    Relevant professional experience in project coordination, business analysis, business administration, operations, financial administration or a related field.
    Demonstrated experience working with Microsoft Excel, including developing and maintaining quantitative calculation models.
    Strong analytical and quantitative skills, with the ability to work with operational, commercial and financial data.
    Ability to translate operational and process data into structured commercial and financial analysis.
    Strong organizational, administrative and project coordination skills.
    Ability to work independently, manage multiple priorities and follow up on details.
    Strong written and verbal communication skills in English.
    Ability to prepare clear professional documentation, presentations and visual materials.
    Experience with SharePoint, digital content management, website administration and LinkedIn/social media is an advantage.
    Familiarity with or interest in green technology, circular economy, thermolysis/pyrolysis processes and their products and by-products is an advantage.

The position requires a versatile and technically curious professional who can combine administrative, analytical, technical and communication responsibilities and work closely with company management.

jobs.description:
About Beyond Gravity

Beyond Gravity, headquartered in Zurich, Switzerland, is the first space company to combine a startup mindset, agility, speed and innovation with decades of experience and proven quality. Approximately 1800 employees at 12 locations in six countries (Switzerland, Sweden, Austria, USA, Finland and Portugal) develop and manufacture products for satellites and launch vehicles with the goal of advancing humankind and enabling the exploration of the world and beyond.
