jobs.title: Manager, Account Management, SME & Growth, France
jobs.description:
About Airwallex

Airwallex is the only unified payments and financial platform for global businesses. Powered by our unique combination of proprietary infrastructure and software, we empower over 250,000 businesses worldwide – including Brex, Navan, Qantas, SHEIN and many more – with fully integrated solutions to manage everything from business accounts, payments, spend management and treasury, to embedded finance at a global scale.

Proudly founded in Melbourne, we have a team of over 2,300 of the brightest and most innovative people in tech across 27 offices around the globe. Valued at US$11 billion and backed by world-leading investors including T. Rowe Price, Visa, Mastercard, Robinhood Ventures, Sequoia, Salesforce Ventures, DST Global, and Lone Pine Capital, Airwallex is leading the charge in building the global payments and financial platform of the future. If you’re ready to do the most ambitious work of your career, join us.

 

Attributes We Value

We hire successful builders with founder-like energy who want real impact, accelerated learning, and true ownership. You bring strong role-related expertise and sharp thinking, and you’re motivated by our mission and operating principles. You move fast with good judgment, dig deep with curiosity, and make decisions from first principles, balancing speed and rigor.

You're humble and collaborative; turn zero‑to‑one ideas into real products, and you “get stuff done” end-to-end. You use AI to work smarter and solve problems faster. Here, you’ll tackle complex, high‑visibility problems with exceptional teammates and grow your career as we build the future of global banking. If that sounds like you, let’s build what’s next.

 

The opportunity

We are looking for a Manager, Account Management, France to lead and develop a team of four Account Managers responsible for retaining, supporting and expanding Airwallex’s French customer base.

This is a highly hands-on player-coach role. You will own the team’s post-sale operating model across Onboard, Adopt, Prove Value and Expand, while remaining directly involved in strategic accounts, customer escalations, onboarding quality and expansion opportunities.

You will work closely with Sales, Onboarding, Support, KYC, Risk, Product and Operations to improve customer outcomes and make Airwallex easier to adopt and grow in France.

What you’ll do

Lead and coach the team

  • Manage and develop four Account Managers through focused 1:1s, account reviews, call coaching and development plans.

  • Set clear standards for account planning, stakeholder coverage, customer communication, CRM hygiene and commercial execution.

  • Improve individual performance through real customer situations, not activity reporting alone.

  • Build a team that can operate with increasing autonomy and consistent judgement.

Own customer outcomes and portfolio strategy

  • Segment the portfolio by customer value, complexity, risk and expansion potential.

  • Define the right coverage model: high-touch for strategic and high-potential accounts, more scaled motions for lower-complexity accounts.

  • Ensure priority customers have clear success outcomes, stakeholder maps, adoption plans and expansion hypotheses.

  • Improve the leading indicators of NRR: onboarding progress, time-to-value, product adoption, stakeholder coverage, customer health and expansion pipeline.

  • Improve the lagging outcomes: retention, GRR, NRR, satisfaction and advocacy.

Drive expansion and account growth

  • Build a repeatable, customer-led expansion motion across accounts, payments, FX, cards, Spend, payouts and related products.

  • Ensure expansion is based on validated customer needs, business triggers and demonstrated value—not product pitching alone.

  • Personally support strategic renewals, upsells, cross-sells and executive customer conversations.

  • Partner with Sales on handovers, pre-sales support and opportunities requiring specialist or new-business involvement.

Build the operating system

  • Create practical playbooks for onboarding, adoption, customer health, level 2 support, renewal and expansion.

  • Establish weekly reviews for risks, strategic accounts, escalations and expansion opportunities.

  • Improve visibility and predictability through clear CRM standards, account plans, health reviews and forecasting.

  • Build a closed-loop Voice of Customer process with Product, Operations, KYC, Risk and Support.

  • Turn recurring customer friction into process improvements rather than repeated individual escalations.

Orchestrate complex customer issues

  • Own the customer-facing coordination of important level 2 issues involving Support, KYC, Risk, Product or Operations.

  • Structure escalations with clear context, business impact, owner, next step and customer communication.

  • Influence internal teams to find workable solutions without bypassing controls or making unsupported commitments.

This role owns customer outcomes and orchestration. It is not a support queue-management role, and it does not replace the specialised ownership of Support, KYC, Risk or Compliance.

What success looks like

Within 90 days, you have mapped the portfolios, priority accounts, risks and expansion opportunities; established the team cadence; and created visibility on the main customer and operational issues.

Within 6–12 months:

  • priority accounts have clear plans, stakeholder coverage and next-best actions;

  • onboarding, adoption, escalation and expansion playbooks are consistently used;

  • leading indicators such as time-to-value, adoption, health coverage and expansion pipeline improve;

  • GRR, NRR, customer satisfaction and retention improve against an agreed baseline;

  • recurring customer issues are reduced through better processes and cross-functional ownership;

  • the four Account Managers show stronger autonomy, commercial judgement and consistency.

Who you are

  • 5+ years in Account Management, Customer Success, Sales, Expansion or a related B2B commercial role.

  • 2+ years of direct people management, ideally leading a team of 3–8.

  • Proven ownership of retention, renewals, expansion, adoption, customer health or comparable outcomes.

  • Experience working with NRR, GRR, churn, expansion, adoption, time-to-value or customer satisfaction metrics.

  • Experience in B2B SaaS, fintech, payments, banking, FX, spend management, ERP or another complex operational environment.

  • Strong customer-facing experience with Finance, Operations, Treasury, Procurement, E-commerce, founders or senior executives.

  • Evidence of building or improving customer processes, playbooks, account segmentation, health reviews, handovers or escalation routines.

  • Ability to influence Support, KYC, Risk, Product and Operations without direct authority.

  • Fluent French and professional English.

  • Strong commercial judgement, ownership and comfort working in ambiguity.

Preferred experience

  • Payments, fintech, banking, FX, cards, spend management or financial infrastructure.

  • KYC, AML, Risk, Compliance or regulated customer operations.

  • Strategic or multi-entity customers across France and international markets.

  • Pre-sales, onboarding design or solution development.

  • Travel, E-commerce, SaaS, Technology or Professional Services.

The profile we are looking for

You are a hands-on manager who enjoys customer conversations, coaches through real situations and creates structure where processes are not yet mature. You combine customer empathy with commercial discipline, solve root causes rather than simply escalating issues, and turn customer insight into better team performance and repeatable growth.

This is not a pure support-management role, a purely strategic Customer Success role or a passive relationship-management position.

To protect you from recruitment scams, please be aware that Airwallex will not ask for bank details, sensitive ID numbers (i.e. passport), or any form of payment during the application or interview process. All official communication will come from an @airwallex.com email address. Please apply only through careers.airwallex.com or our official LinkedIn page.

Equal opportunity

Airwallex is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We value diversity and anyone seeking employment at Airwallex is considered based on merit, qualifications, competence and talent. We don’t regard color, religion, race, national origin, sexual orientation, ancestry, citizenship, sex, marital or family status, disability, gender, or any other legally protected status when making our hiring decisions. Account Management Lead - Editions France
jobs.description:
Our Global Structure


Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we're unlocking new possibilities as one global team.

Editions, our network of delivery-only kitchens, is a key differentiator in France commercial ambition. The Account Management Lead – Editions France role is created as part of a wider reorganisation of the Editions business as part of our regional strategy. The role reports to Paris regional leadership and is designed to combine strategic partner leadership, P&L ownership and organisation building across the Editions network.

The Role

As Account Management Lead – Editions France, you will lead the Editions commercial team for France constituted of Senior Account Managers, Account Managers and Sales Managers. You will be the guardian of the Editions strategy for France, accountable for its coordination and its execution on the ground, growing the performance and profitability of our sites while driving occupancy and the differentiation Editions brings to the French market.

You will own a portion of the Editions P&L. That means holding the commercial scorecard for new kitchens, making financial decisions with a clear view of both partner and Deliveroo profitability, and steering your team's portfolio towards sustainable growth rather than volume alone.

You will be accountable for the development plan for your team, their success and learning curve at Deliveroo; setting the right KPIs and OKRs to monitor the business. Your role will be commercially focused, however Editions is as much a project management discipline as a commercial one: you will work hand in hand with Food Safety, Compliance, Site Construction, Kitchen Layout, Site Operations, Marketing and the International Editions team to bring kitchens live and keep them performing.

What You'll Be Doing

  • Editions Strategy & Growth

jobs.title: Enterprise Sales Lead (French market)
jobs.description:
Health can’t wait.

Not for symptoms to get worse. Not for a six‑month appointment. Not for a system to catch up. But that’s exactly how healthcare works today. You wait, until you can’t.

Alan exists to end the wait.

Health is a universal right, and we believe this right can only become real when it’s coupled with prevention. We need to stop treating health as something we repair and start treating it as something we build, every day. It’s not solely a question of willpower. It’s the healthcare system itself that needs to work for everyone, in a sustainable way.

So we are building the new standard in prevention insurance. Alan is the first company that integrates insurance, prevention, and care into a single, acclaimed user experience.

We are on an incredible journey to build a global leading company, with a unique culture. We already partner with 40K+ companies of all sizes, serving more than 1M+ members, and have reached €800M+ in ARR.

Prevention as the new norm. That's what we're building with our team of 800+ people. If it speaks to you: we're hiring across France, Spain, Belgium, and Canada. And beyond.

We’re opening an Enterprise Sales Team Lead role in France to lead a growing team of 4 Senior Account Executives, who are in charge of acquiring customers with more than 3,000 employees, including all CAC40 companies.

In this role, you will own acquisition on the Enterprise segment in France and run the business end‑to‑end: you will be hands-on on the field while coaching and scaling a team of Account Executives to win this market.

This position sits at the heart of our growth ambition: We have just passed the one million member milestone – and this is only the beginning! We’re accelerating acquisition in France and doubling down on our portfolio — and the Enterprise segment is one of the core pillars of that plan.

About the Enterprise segment

  • Perimeter: companies of 3000+ employees

  • Verticals: all Verticals (Tech, Retail, Industrial Companies etc)

  • Total Addressable Market: ~7M members in France

Why Enterprise Sales is exciting at Alan

  • Diverse workforce: Mix of 60% cadres / 40% non-cadres, often with subsidiaries or multi-site operations, ranging from highly tech-savvy employees to those requiring digital adoption support.

  • Critical challenges: Multi-stakeholder decision processes involving HRD, CFO, CEO, Payroll, CSE, Legal, Purchasing, Comp & Ben, Accounting, Brokers, Unions, long sales cycles (multi-year conversations), RFP processes requiring deep audits and product customization, and strong influence from unions/CSE who can co-manage health insurance topics;

  • Company profiles: Flagship companies (widely known brands), groups with standalone entities or subsidiaries, often with focus on employee wellbeing (QVT programs, Great Place to Work), modern company culture, and strategic communication about digitization or employer brand attractiveness;

  • HR priorities: Increasing productivity, obtaining fair and competitive pricing, contributing to employee well-being through customized health plans, simplifying HR processes with digital platforms, and managing change management concerns when implementing new health insurance (biggest fear for large companies)

  • Critical business characteristics: This segment requires breadth & depth of expertise to navigate complex organizations, account-based strategies with Key Account Management approach, early engagement in company roadmaps, face-to-face meetings, co-creation of insurance and digital products (tailored offers considering past results, specific regimes, demographics, payroll system integration), and ability to work through RFPs and with brokers. Sales cycles are volatile with high stakes: 1 deal = 50% of annual target for Enterprise Account Executives.

Our approach for Enterprise companies positions Alan as a strategic partner in health rather than just an insurance provider, emphasizing our digital platform for fluid UX, customized health plans at fair pricing, and health/well-being services. Success requires leveraging high-level connections, building professional materials, and potentially creating exclusive "Health Clubs" or labels for early adopters.

⭐ What you will do ⭐

You will be the Sales leader of the Enterprise Sales team in France, responsible for both hitting the numbers and scaling the machine.

More precisely, you will:

  • Own the Enterprise acquisition plan in France. Design and execute the go‑to‑market strategy for 3000 employee customers, from targeting to closing, to reach ambitious acquisition targets and scale the segment.

  • Lead & coach a team of 4 Account Executives (and likely more to come)

    • Drive hiring, onboarding, and career development as we scale the crew and the segment.

    • Help each team member reach their targets with clear expectations, rigorous follow‑up, and ongoing coaching on methodology, deal execution, and pipeline management.

    • Be on the field with the team: prospecting, joining key meetings, supporting tough negotiations, and owning strategic opportunities to maximize win rates.

  • Empower every member of the team: Create the conditions for everyone to reach and exceed their goals: strong feedback culture, coaching, clear ownership, and autonomy.

  • Ensure market fit and remove blockers: Surface customer expectations, patterns, and blockers, and ensure they’re addressed through the right strategic and execution plans (product, pricing, ops, marketing, etc.).

⭐ Is it what you are looking for? You may be a great fit at Alan if you... ⭐

  • Have at least 10 years experience in B2B sales, with a proven track record of hitting and exceeding targets as an Account Executive and Sales Leader

  • Have experience leading and coaching sales teams, with the ability to set a high bar, give clear direction, and help people grow

  • Have full working proficiency in French, and advanced level in English for internal communication

  • Have a very hands‑on mentality: you love being on the field with your team, joining customer meetings, helping on tough negotiations, and sharing what works

  • Have experience selling to Enterprise level companies (3000+ employees and above) in multi‑stakeholder deals

  • Are comfortable operating in fast‑paced, ambiguous environments, and can prioritize ruthlessly

  • Are data‑driven and analytical: you know how to leverage KPIs to drive performance, run analyses, and make decisions

  • Have strong cross‑functional collaboration skills and appetite for building things with others (sales ops, marketing, etc.)

  • Are based (or willing to relocate to) the Paris area

Nice-to-have:

  • Experience selling to HR or Finance

.

🙌   Perks & Benefits

At Alan, we believe that being in good health is a basic need, and it starts with our employees. This is why Alaners are provided with a stimulating environment and perks ensuring they are happy, efficient and spend only high-quality time with co-workers. 

Therefore, we offer:

  • Fair rewards. Generous equity packages complement your base salary, for permanent contracts only.

  • Flexible Office. Amazing office space at our Paris HQ

  • All the tools you need. Top of the range equipment: Macbook Pro, keyboard, laptop stand, monitor, and Bose noise-canceling headphones.

  • Flexible vacation policy and flexible working hours. Organize your time as you wish.

  • Delightful healthcare insurance. Extremely comprehensive health insurance - 100% of the contribution covered by Alan for you and your family, for permanent contracts only.

  • Transport. Country-specific commuter benefits.

  • Learning & Training opportunities. A highly flexible Training policy free books and budget to attend and speak at conferences if the opportunity arises.

  • Parental leave. Extended parental leave for all new parents, for permanent contracts only.

Important note: we hire people not roles. 

After reading this job description, if you feel like you don’t have all the necessary prerequisites but that it matches where you are now or what you'd like to grow into in your next position, we encourage you to apply!

Not everybody will enter our recruitment process, but all, no matter how underrepresented, should feel free to apply as it can only bring learnings or success.

🔖 Check out our About Alan and Career pages, as well as our Medium, blog and Glassdoor page for more info.

Our mission and customers: We are creating the freedom for SMEs to succeed by delivering Europe's leading finance workspace with banking at its core, augmented by financial tools. We are proud to be rated 4.8 on Trustpilot, based on 55,000+ reviews. Our culture puts customer satisfaction at the core of what we do, as proven by our Net Promoter Score of 75 (more about our culture here).

Our journey: Founded in 2017 by Alexandre and Steve, Qonto has grown to 1,600+ Qontoers serving over 600,000+ customers across 8 European countries. We have been profitable since 2023, and we are just getting started.

Our beliefs: We hire for skills and potential. With 80+ nationalities, 45% women, of which 56% of women in our leadership team, diversity isn't a program; It's who we are. We've built a discrimination-free hiring process because the best teams are built on merit.

AI at Qonto: AI is deeply embedded in how we work (here) - Every Qontoer gets unlimited access to the best AI tools. We want people who experiment without waiting for permission, push AI beyond the obvious, know when to trust it, and when to question it.

------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------


Join us as a Staff Data Analyst - Compliance to build the analytics foundations that power Qonto's compliance execution. You'll own a brand-new scope — monitoring KYC/KYB funnels, remediation campaigns, and financial exposure — working cross-functionally with Product, Ops, Risk & Compliance, and Internal Control, under the guidance of Alma, our Lead Data Analyst.

👩‍💻🧑‍💻 As a Data Analyst at Qonto, you will

  • Build compliance process monitoring from scratch: You'll build and own the data infrastructure that powers compliance monitoring at Qonto — from onboarding funnel analytics to remediation financial exposure — giving product, operations and compliance teams the self-service tools they need to make decisions without waiting on a data request.
  • Model and transform data with dbt: With the collaboration of Analytics Engineer Team, you'll build end-to-end transformation pipelines from source to consumption layer, keeping metric definitions clean and trusted by non-technical stakeholders.
  • Turn regulatory questions into self-service assets: You'll partner with Product, Ops, Risk & Compliance, and Internal Control to scope and ship analytical tools
  • Own the KYC/KYB funnel analytics end-to-end: You'll deliver insights from CS initiation through KYB validation — refusal reasons, document gaps, lead-time distributions — so teams can act on friction fast.
  • Track remediation campaigns and financial exposure: You'll measure MRR secured, at risk, or lost across active campaigns, with peak intensity in Q4 (budget season) and May–June (reforecast).

🤔 What you can expect

  • A greenfield, strategically critical scope: Qonto is under close regulatory scrutiny — you'll build analytics foundations that matter company-wide, not just for your team.
  • Senior, cross-functional exposure from day one: Product, Ops, Risk & Compliance, Internal Control — few DA roles give you this breadth of senior stakeholder access at this level.
  • Real ownership in the Modern Data Stack: You'll build in Omni and dbt with a high degree of autonomy — no legacy to untangle, just foundations to create.
  • A team where AI is a first-class tool: Unlimited access to AI tools (Claude, Cursor, and more) to evolve how you work, not just output more.

➡️ Your future manager

Your manager will be Alma, our Lead Data Analyst for Ops & Finance. Alma knows exactly what it takes to build an analytics function that actually changes decisions, and she'll push you to do the same.

Alma reports to Erwan, Director of Business Analytics who oversees the entire Analytics function and ensures alignment across teams.

🏅 About You

  • Compliance or regulated environment experience: You've worked analytically on KYC/KYB, AML, remediation, or similar regulatory/operational processes — and you know how to get credible with those stakeholders fast.
  • Self-service product mindset: You've designed dashboards and models for end-users to explore autonomously, adapting the same dataset from ops-level (daily SLA tracking) to exec-level (budget readouts).
  • Cross-functional stakeholder management: You've juggled competing analytical priorities across multiple teams — and you know how to scope clearly, push back when needed, and drive adoption.
  • Strong SQL and data modelling skills: You've built end-to-end transformation pipelines, enforced data quality, and made non-technical stakeholders trust your numbers.
  • AI-native workflow: You actively use AI tools to accelerate your analytics work — from data modelling to stakeholder communication — and you're genuinely curious about going further.
  • Language: Fluent in English.

jobs.title: Site Reliability Engineer (Storage) - remote friendly
jobs.description:
Our mission and customers: We are creating the freedom for SMEs to succeed by delivering Europe's leading finance workspace with banking at its core, augmented by financial tools. We are proud to be rated 4.8 on Trustpilot, based on 55,000+ reviews. Our culture puts customer satisfaction at the core of what we do, as proven by our Net Promoter Score of 75 (more about our culture here).

Our journey: Founded in 2017 by Alexandre and Steve, Qonto has grown to 1,600+ Qontoers serving over 600,000+ customers across 8 European countries. We have been profitable since 2023, and we are just getting started.

Our beliefs: We hire for skills and potential. With 80+ nationalities, 45% women, of which 56% of women in our leadership team, diversity isn't a program; It's who we are. We've built a discrimination-free hiring process because the best teams are built on merit.

AI at Qonto: AI is deeply embedded in how we work (here) - Every Qontoer gets unlimited access to the best AI tools. We want people who experiment without waiting for permission, push AI beyond the obvious, know when to trust it, and when to question it.

------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------


Join us as a Site Reliability Engineer on our Storage team to keep the databases Qonto runs on resilient, safe, and always available. You'll operate and improve our banking-grade storage infrastructure — PostgreSQL, Redis, Kafka and Elasticsearch — and help make it self-serve for backend teams, under the guidance of Damien, our Storage Engineering Manager.

➡️ What you'll do

  • Operate and safeguard critical storage infrastructure: You'll run PostgreSQL, Redis, Kafka and Elasticsearch in production, keeping banking-grade data safe and available.
  • Own incident response and root-cause analysis: You'll be the last line of defense when a hard query or performance problem needs solving.
  • Build our banking-license compliance roadmap: You'll define and prioritize backup and disaster-recovery scenarios with our Risk & Compliance team.
  • Ship code for our internal platform APIs: You'll build self-service tooling that lets backend teams spin up storage resources in minutes, not days.
  • Help shape how AI agents access sensitive systems: You'll contribute to making our storage APIs safe and traceable for autonomous agents, not just humans.

➡️ What we're looking for

  • Solid PostgreSQL production experience: You've operated PostgreSQL in production and know how to investigate performance issues, reason about backups/restores, and make safe changes. Deep mastery is a strong plus, but we don't expect you to be a dedicated PostgreSQL expert from day one.
  • Comfortable across the storage stack: You have working knowledge of Redis, Kafka or Elasticsearch, and you pick up new systems fast.
  • Practical AI usage in your daily workflow: You already use AI to speed up debugging, coding, documentation or operational work — not as a buzzword, but as a real productivity habit. You're also curious about how AI agents can safely and traceably interact with sensitive production systems.
  • You write code: You're comfortable shipping features, not just scripts, for the internal platform tools your team builds.
  • Calm, rigorous incident response: You've handled production incidents on stateful systems and stay composed when the pressure is on.

➡️ What we can offer you

  • A team about to raise the bar on resilience: With Qonto's banking-license roadmap underway, you'll help define how a regulated fintech operates its data.
  • Real ownership from day one: You'll drive your own reliability and disaster-recovery roadmap, not just execute someone else's backlog.
  • A growing team: Storage is scaling toward 5-6 engineers, so there's real room to shape how the team works, not just join it.
  • A fully remote-first team: Your teammates are spread across Europe.

➡️ Your future manager

You'll report to Damien Cupif, our Storage Engineering Manager — but don't expect micro-management. Damien started out as a data engineer and naturally pivoted into infrastructure after building the tooling his own data pipelines needed. He sets a clear direction, stays hands-on with his team, and is genuinely invested in how each new hire ramps up and grows.

If this sounds like you — even if you don't check every box — we'd love to hear from you.

współpraca z zespołami developerskimi, sieciowymi, bezpieczeństwa, przy wdrożeniach i zmianach;
tworzenie i aktualizacja dokumentacji technicznej oraz procedur operacyjnych.

- wykształcenie: wyższe (w tym licencjat) - konieczne

podstawowa znajomość systemów Linux (praca w konsoli, administracja usługami w stopniu umożliwiającym współpracę z zespołem);
znajomość zagadnień związanych z normami i regulacjami bezpieczeństwa informacji (ISO 27001, NIS2, RODO  aspekt praktyczny w IT);
znajomość technologii firmy Fortinet (w szczególności FortiGate, FortiAnalyzer, FortiMail);
wiedza z zakresu sieci komputerowych (TCP/IP, VLAN, routing, VPN, podstawowe mechanizmy bezpieczeństwa sieciowego);
doświadczenie w pracy z systemami monitoringu (preferowany Zabbix);
doświadczenie w pracy w środowisku uczelni wyższej lub jednostek sektora publicznego.

Permanent (CDI) Full time Marketing & Sales Senior / Expert ( 7+ years experience) Bachelor's Degree

Our client is a major actor in international tourism. As an Airline Sales Manager (m/f), you will be responsible for developing and managing strategic B2B partnerships, driving commercial performance, and contributing to the company's growth across Luxembourg and international markets. • At least 5 years of experience in a similar B2B Sales or Account Management role within the aviation or air travel industry (airlines, tour operators, business aviation, helicopter operators, or related sectors).

• Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret data and transform insights into commercial actions.
• Excellent negotiation, presentation and relationship-building skills.
• A proactive mindset with the ability to identify business opportunities and take ownership of projects.
• The flexibility to travel regularly for customer visits, workshops and industry events.
• Excellent communication skills in English together with a good command of French and/or German.

• Conduct research to identify business opportunities with new customers

jobs.title: Depositary Services Senior Representative - Alternative Funds (Fixed-term) (m/f)
jobs.description:
At BBH, Partnership is more than a form of ownership-it's our approach to business and relationships.  We know that supporting your professional and personal goals is the best way to help our clients and advance our business. We take that responsibility seriously. With a 200-year legacy and a shared passion for what's next, this is the right place to build a fulfilling career.

Depositary Services Senior Representative - Alternative Funds (Fixed-term)

BBH is currently recruiting a Depositary Services Senior Representative to join our dynamic Depositary Services team. In this key role you will be responsible for the coordination and performance of tasks relating to the supervision of assets of Real Estate, Private Debt and Private Equity funds. In addition, you will assess, analyze, and monitor risks and control issues for the products and services falling under the scope of the Depositary obligations.  You will have a high level of technical acumen and analytical skills in order to foster a solution orientated and consultative approach to performing our Depositary obligations

Key Responsibilities:

• Gather and review documentation received in relation to recordkeeping and verification of ownership of real assets (real estate, private debt, private equity, fund of funds) and proactively monitor the status and completion of those tasks and follow up to obtain required client documentation
• Build Strong relationships with Clients and have the knowledge and ability to explain the regulatory drivers behind these requirements
• Review and/or execute daily cash flow monitoring activities by gathering information and reviewing exceptions
• Support team in determining appropriate resolutions to new regulatory obligations.
• Monitor, report, define and document critical internal control processes.
• Formulate corrective actions, where applicable, to resolve identified exceptions.
• Coordinate internal and external projects in an efficient and thorough manner.
• Prepare and review documentation for regulators and external auditors
• Support Team on questions from clients, regulators, external auditors and/or BBH internal departments. Communicate clearly with business area contacts as well as other areas of the Bank
• Maintain effective working relationships at relevant levels with other departments
• Escalate within the team significant audit issues, set direction/communicate proposed manner of resolution of audit issues and concerns that have a significant impact
• Develop and maintain peer relationships to share best practices

Qualifications:

1. Education level and/ or experience

• Bachelor's degree in finance, Accounting
• 2 to 4 years' experience working within the alternative funds industry or relevant business line experience
• Proficient Business level German skills are considered as an advantage

2. Knowledge and skills

• Excellent analytical, communication and interpersonal skills with ability to present complex and sensitive issues
• Technical skills in alternatives and regulation
• Good knowledge in European and local regulatory requirements
• Demonstrates Microsoft Office skills (with emphasis placed on Excel proficiency).
• Ability to learn and adapt to new technologies and systems
• Ability to identify, escalate and resolve a problem.
• Ability to communicate professionally through effective verbal and written skills.
• Ability to manage time efficiently and effectively.
• Organizational skills and detail-oriented.
• Ability to work in a team environment.
• Ability to meet deadlines and work under pressure.
• Ability to manage and inspire people

We value diverse experiences. We value diverse experiences and transferrable skillsets. If your career hasn't followed a traditional path, includes alternative experiences, or doesn't meet every qualification or skill listed in the job description, please do go ahead and apply.

About BBH:

Brown Brothers Harriman (BBH) is a premier global financial services firm, known for premium service, specialist expertise, technology solutions and partnership approach to client management. Across Investor Services and Capital Partners, we work with an enviable roster of sophisticated clients who make BBH their first call when they are tackling their hardest challenges. Delivering for our clients and each other energizes us.

We believe that how we do our work is just as important as what we do. We are relentless problem solvers who know our best ideas come from collective debate and development-so we are never possessive about our ideas. Every day we come together as a diverse community of smart and caring people to deliver exceptional service and expert advice-creating success that lasts. No matter where you sit in the organization, everyone is empowered to contribute their ideas. BBHers can pick up the phone and call any colleague, and they are happy to help. Expanding your impact beyond your daily role is part of how we operate as trusted partners to one another.

We believe stability is a competitive advantage, but being stable means having the knowledge, skill, and discipline to evolve, often-pushing the boundaries of innovation.  As a private partnership, every investment we make is in the relationships, technologies, products and development we believe are in the long-term interests of our clients and our people. Our long-tenured leaders are experts in their areas and are actively involved in the day-to day business, taking the time to provide guidance and mentoring to build the next generation of BBHers. Because we know, our success begins with yours.

Go to BBH.com to learn more about our rewards and benefits, philanthropy, approach to sustainability or how we support you to thrive personally, physically and financially.

Elle propose à ses clients particuliers, professionnels, entreprises et de banque privée une gamme particulièrement large de produits financiers et de solutions de bancassurance.

En 2024, BGL BNP Paribas a été désignée « Best Bank in Luxembourg » par Euromoney et a obtenu en 2025, pour la 10è année consécutive, la certification « Top Employer Luxembourg », saluant l'excellence des conditions de travail offertes à ses collaborateurs.

Senior Tax advisor (H/F)
  
CONTEXTE ET ENJEUX

Vous rejoindrez, en tant que « Senior Tax advisor », la Fonction des « Affaires fiscales » de BGL BNP Paribas.  

Vous participez ainsi activement à la réalisation des missions des Affaires Fiscales qui consistent notamment

• à assurer la maitrise du risque fiscal pour l'ensemble des opérations réalisées par le groupe BNP sur le territoire de Luxembourg et
• à contribuer à la maitrise de la charge fiscale du groupe BNP sur le même territoire.
  
CONCRÈTEMENT, VOTRE MISSION ET VOTRE QUOTIDIEN ?

Dans le cadre de vos fonctions, vous êtes amené à exercer les activités suivantes :

• Analyser et sécuriser, sur le plan fiscal, les opérations et produits mis en place par les métiers et entités du Groupe au Luxembourg et proposer des solutions alternatives pour répondre aux risques et contraintes identifiés.
• Apporter son expertise fiscale pour toutes opérations à dimension transfrontière de la banque ou des entités du Groupe au Luxembourg.
• Contribuer à la maitrise de la charge fiscale de la banque et des entités du Groupe au Luxembourg et revoir leurs déclarations fiscales.
• Assurer la liaison entre les métiers ou entités et les conseillers fiscaux externes (avocats, cabinets d'audit).
• Suivre les évolutions réglementaires fiscales en matière de fiscalité luxembourgeoise, européenne et internationale (OCDE) et analyser les implications pour la banque et les entités du Groupe au Luxembourg.
• Assurer une formation régulière sur les sujets fiscaux d'actualités.
• Assurer le suivi et participer à la validation des procédures internes de la banque comportant des aspects fiscaux.
  
LES MISSIONS C'EST IMPORTANT, L'ÉQUIPE ET L'ENVIRONNEMENT DE TRAVAIL AUSSI !

Votre environnement de travail

- Vous ferez partie d'une équipe de 10 personnes avec laquelle vous travaillerez de manière rapprochée.
- Vous serez également amené(e) à interagir avec de nombreux interlocuteurs au sein de la Banque et des autres entités du territoire.
- Le poste est éligible au télétravail et au travail sur sites distants suivant les règles habituelles observées dans la Banque.
- Sur ce poste, le souhait premier est de recruter un collaborateur à temps plein mais des aménagements pourront être envisagés en fonction des besoins spécifiques de la personne recrutée.

Les apports de ce poste ?

Vous disposerez d'un large panel d'intervention dans les divers domaines d'activités de la banque au Luxembourg et ceci notamment en accompagnant les métiers/ fonctions/ entités du groupe dans leurs transactions locales ou transfrontières.
Votre rôle vous emmènera également sur des projets de plus grande envergure comme des fusions-acquisitions, opérations de leasing financier, accompagnement des entreprises en local ou encore des projets de développement durable.
  
ÊTES-VOUS NOTRE FUTUR(E) Senior Tax Advisor

Expérience professionnelle et/ou diplôme
Etude:  Diplôme de Master à orientation Droit / Economie / Ecole de commerce
Expérience Professionnelle : Vous avez une première expérience de 7 ans minimum en fiscalité luxembourgeoise et internationale des sociétés et vous souhaitez mettre à disposition vos connaissances acquises au service des métiers de la banque.

Compétences comportementales

• Capacité à collaborer / travail d'équipe
• Capacité à communiquer - à l'oral et par écrit
• Créativité & Innovation / Capacité à résoudre des problèmes
• Capacité à synthétiser / simplifier

Compétences transversales

• Capacité à élaborer et à adapter un processus
• Capacité à comprendre, expliquer et conduire le changement
• Capacité à établir et activer des réseaux
• Capacité d'analyse
• Capacité à anticiper les évolutions métiers / stratégiques
• Capacité à animer une réunion, un séminaire, un comité, une formation…

Compétences techniques

Vous disposez de compétences en fiscalité luxembourgeoise et internationale des sociétés et en comptabilité.

Connaissances linguistiques

Vous maitrisez couramment le français et l'anglais.  La pratique d'une autre langue comme le luxembourgeois ou l'allemand est considérée comme un atout supplémentaire.

La diversité, l'équité et l'inclusion sont des valeurs clés pour le bien-être et la performance des équipes. Nous souhaitons accueillir et fidéliser tous nos collaborateurs sans distinction : c'est ainsi que nous construirons, ensemble, la finance de demain, innovante, responsable et durable.

Luxembourg

Founded in 1856, Banque Internationale à Luxembourg is the oldest multi-business bank in the Grand Duchy. From its foundation, the BIL has always played an active role in the development of the Luxembourg economy. It currently operates in retail, private and corporate banking, as well as on major capital markets. Employing more than 2 000 people, BIL is present in the financial hotspots that are Luxembourg, Switzerland, and China.

As a major player in Luxembourg's finance industry and as a signatory of the UN Principles of Responsible Banking, BIL is committed to handing over a responsible and sustainable bank to future generations.

We are looking for an experienced and results-driven Relationship Manager & Business Developer to support our growth and further develop our business relationships and client network with professional intermediaries (fiduciaries, family office, etc.) looking for a strong partner that is offering account management, investment and credit's solutions for domiciliation business activities run by holding companies.

This is a unique opportunity to join a dynamic and entrepreneurial working environment, a great team of experts sharing a clear vision and business strategy, and to get the chance to evolve in universal bank at human size, at the headquarters.    
The position is based in Luxembourg, you will join a team of ~6 Relationship Managers focusing on those specific activities, within the Wealth Management division of BIL.

Your next challenge:

• Develop your book of clients, with a defined growth strategy, fostering on building both long-term and trustworthy relationships with professional intermediaries, leveraging our full wealth management service's offering
• Manage and consolidate client relationships (B to B) with professional intermediaries, including fiduciaries, law firms, (Multi) Family Offices, economic advisors, etc., and be the primary point of contact for intermediaries as well as for end clients (B to C relationship).

• Maintain an extensive knowledge of the current market conditions to detect and/or anticipate possible commercial opportunities for the customers
• Attend internal and external events to develop your network and client's portfolio
• Analyze and/or reanalyze client files (mostly financial companies in the broad sense) to ensure that all regulatory aspects are duly fulfilled/compliant and, if necessary, collect and analyze all elements that enable a thorough remediation of our clients' files (KYC).
• Present (after thorough and meticulous analysis) the files that require it to the relevant committees.
• Collect, document, and understand the transactions carried out by clients (KYT).
• Manage more complex files (and/or wealthier clients, more complex investment products). Handle credit requests and present files to the relevant committees (CDC/CDE, etc.).

Your deliverables:

• Organize appointments and points of contact (regular client calls and visits).
• Provide advice to clients regarding the existing offerings (on all products offered by the bank). Help clients navigate financial offerings. Provide guidance on the existing offerings.
• Document all client information in CRM, including details about upcoming client events (e.g., contract signings, new investments).
• Master and comply with banking processes and regulatory obligations (KYC, AML, KYT, FIDLEG) and stay informed of all regulatory changes.
• Update the client's risk profile.
• Keep client records up to date (KYC, AML, etc.).
• Ensure consistency in the level of service provided by all CST members.
• Coordinate client events (conferences and sponsored activities, etc.) and organize key actions to acquire new clients.

Your skills:

• A strong existing network and client base
• Excellent command of French and English

• Good commercial sense / client and results orientation
• Good knowledge of the economic, legal, tax, and regulatory environment.
Basic knowledge of Wealth Planning / Credit Structuring, etc.
• Computer skills: T24, Salesforce, MS Office
• High analytical capacity, especially regarding KYC/AML, etc.
• Strong team spirit
• Organizational autonomy

Transport manager (2 years contract)

Job Description

The Transport Manager acts as the operational backbone and system Subject Matter Expert (SME) for outbound transportation execution across the EMENA network at Avery Dennison. Reporting to the Head of Transportation, this role bridges strategic regional transport objectives with daily execution—overseeing both direct customer deliveries and internal site movements.
The position combines technical system ownership (TRAX TMS & QAD ERP), master data governance, order/lead-time investigations, carrier integration management, and operational standardization across all regional manufacturing plants and distribution centers.

Key Responsibilities & Accountabilities

1. Transport System Governance & Network Master Data

• Lead-Time & Schedule Administration: Configure, validate, and maintain transport lead-time matrices per shipping site, destination country, and individual ship-to customer location across EMENA.
• Order Cut-Off & Departure Execution: Establish and maintain order entry cut-off times and daily departure schedules to align plant dispatch capabilities with carrier collection slots.
• Routing & Execution Logic: Maintain and optimize TRAX routing rules, logic parameters, and ship-via assignment rules per ship-to destination.
• Carrier & Partner Onboarding: Manage system setup and integration parameters for new logistics service providers following carrier tender allocation or carrier switches; maintain manual partner addresses as required.
• Documentation & Carrier EDI: Setup specific delivery instructions per ship-to to ensure dynamic printing on Weight-Lists and seamless EDI transmission to carriers; configure specialized invoicing setups (e.g., single weight-list per order rule).
• Network Availability & Calendars: Update and govern site and customer holiday closures to prevent system tendering errors and inaccurate delivery commitments.

2. ERP Integration & Analytical Investigations

• Custom Shipping Setup: Configure specialized shipping requirements in QAD, including the setup of "special pallet packlist" rules per ship-to upon request from Customer Service Representatives (CSRs).
• Lead-Time Root Cause Analysis: Conduct structured investigations into lead-time performance and anomalies (segmented by site, country, and ship-to) to resolve bottlenecks.
• Order Diagnostics: Lead end-to-end technical and operational investigations on delayed or stuck orders to identify system vs. operational execution root causes.

3. Outbound Network Governance & Service Excellence

• Oversee daily outbound freight flows, ensuring compliance with defined SLAs for customer deliveries and inter-site transfers.
• Track and report operational performance metrics (OTIF, OTD, weight-list compliance).
• Serve as the primary regional escalation contact for complex transport system failures, carrier delivery exceptions, and site logistics disruptions.
• Collaborate cross-functionally with Customer Experience (CSR), Manufacturing Operations, Warehouse Logistics, and Carriers.
Please note it's a 24 month contract.

Qualifications

• Education: Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain Management, Logistics, Business Administration, or Systems Engineering.
• Experience: 5+ years of operational transportation management or logistics systems experience within a complex, multi-site European/EMENA environment.
• Systems Expertise: Hands-on experience with TRAX TMS and QAD ERP transport modules (or equivalent enterprise TMS/ERP combinations); solid understanding of carrier EDI integrations and weight-list/invoicing documentation.
• Skills: Strong analytical capabilities (root-cause analysis on orders and lead-times), continuous improvement mindset, cross-functional communication.
• Languages: Professional fluency in English; additional European languages (German, French, Dutch, Polish) are an advantage.

Additional Information

Here's a glimpse of the great benefits you can expect:

• Compensation & Benefits: Benefit from a labor agreement with salary increases, a qualified social minimum wage, and automatic salary indexation to inflation. Enjoy a seniority incentive, profit sharing, and a 13th-month salary (with the option to convert it into additional leave).
• Continuous Development: Access extensive training and certification opportunities, local mentorship programs, and leadership development initiatives (including development discussions and Talent Management programs).
• Flexibility & On-site Perks: Embrace flexible work arrangements for white-collar roles. Enjoy a subsidized canteen, an annual gift for employees and children, and a mobile app that centralizes services, benefits, vouchers, and discounts.

The University of Luxembourg is an international research university with a distinctly multilingual and interdisciplinary character.
The University's main Library, the Luxembourg Learning Centre (LLC), located in the heart of the Belval campus, is much more than a library: it is a hub of innovation and knowledge designed to foster research, learning, collaboration and outreach. Its building, a true architectural masterpiece, combines the restructuring of an old industrial hall with bold contemporary design, and spans 14,000 m², 10.7 km of shelving and more a thousand working spaces. It stands as a prestigious façade for Luxembourg and for the University of Luxembourg, reflecting the ambition and academic excellence of both the country and the institution. Equipped with modern infrastructure and advanced technologies, the LLC offers a unique environment where students, researchers, and professionals come together to create, share and innovate. Complementing the central role of the LLC in Belval, a library hub specialising in European law research is located in the Weicker building, benefiting from its proximity to European institutions and Luxembourg's financial district.

Your role
We are looking for a specialist in the Library's strategic growth area of research support and information skills training. Based in Belval, with the opportunity to offer support and training at our other campus locations in Luxembourg, the person will be involved in developing new innovative research support services around research data management, in collaboration with colleagues and senior managers. You will also contribute to developing the information skills training programmes in partnership with the learning and teaching centres of the University. You will help to promote the development of the Library's emerging research support services.
Key Responsibilities:
• Contribute to the development and implementation of research support services, policies, and future service planning
• Provide specialist support for the University's research activities, with a priority on research data management, and additional support around open science, open access, bibliometrics, and scholarly communication
• Assist with the development and management of institutional data and publishing repositories, e.g. contributing to efforts in data quality, compliance with funder requirements, and timely deposit of research outputs
• Support day to day operations of the Library's Research Support team, including responding to enquiries and maintaining service documentation
• Develop and deliver training, workshops, and one to one consultations for researchers, students - bachelor, master and doctoral, and academic research support staff
• Establish and maintain strong working relationships with researchers and students, as well as across the Library and research support services, to establish requirements and inform service delivery
• Promote all research support services of the Library
• Contribute to the development of Library policies and practices
It is anticipated that 80% of the role involves outreach and development of research support services, and 20% of the role involves developing and providing training in information skills topics, e.g. research data management, information literacy and use of digital tools.

Your profile
• Master's degree or equivalent professional experience in an academic, research, digital, or information-intensive environment
• 3+ years' experience in research support environments with a focus on research data management
• In depth knowledge in research data management and related trends
• Library and/or teaching experience is an asset
• Excellent interpersonal and communication skills to engage diverse stakeholders and promote services
• A PhD is considered an asset
• Full proficiency in English; good knowledge of French or German would be an asset

We offer
• A modern, dynamic university with a personal and inclusive atmosphere. Multilingual and international character. Staff coming from more than 90 countries. Member of The Guild of European Research Intensive Universities
• An exceptional research environment, supported by skilled staff and high-quality equipment. Strong links to professional sectors and the Luxembourg labour market. A unique urban campus with excellent infrastructure
• A partner for society and industry. Cooperation with European institutions, innovative companies, the Financial Centre and a wide range of non-academic partners including ministries, local governments, associations, and NGOs

How to apply

jobs.title: Service Level Manager & Performance Data/IA (m/f)
jobs.description:
Service Level Manager & Performance Data/IA

Sur un marché de plus en plus exigeant et concurrentiel, notre organisation place l'excellence opérationnelle, l'innovation et l'amélioration continue au cœur de sa stratégie. Dans le cadre du renforcement de notre Direction des Systèmes d'Information, nous recherchons un(e) : Service Level Manager & Data/IA (h/f)

Vos missions

Au sein de l'équipe Service Delivery Management de la DSI Production, vous jouez un rôle clé dans la construction et l'industrialisation du pilotage de la performance opérationnelle. Vous transformez les données issues du monitoring, des outils ITSM et des fournisseurs en indicateurs pertinents, tableaux de bord décisionnels et analyses à forte valeur ajoutée.

Votre mission consiste également à faire évoluer le Service Level Management vers un pilotage proactif, prédictif et automatisé grâce à l'exploitation de la donnée et de l'intelligence artificielle.

Concevoir le dispositif de pilotage de la Production

• Recueillir et formaliser les besoins de pilotage des équipes Production, des Service Delivery Managers, des métiers et des fournisseurs.
• Définir et maintenir un référentiel cohérent de KPI, KRI, SLA, SLO et OLA.
• Concevoir et développer des tableaux de bord opérationnels, managériaux et exécutifs.
• Mettre en place des dispositifs de reporting adaptés aux différents publics : équipes techniques, management DSI, métiers et partenaires externes.

Industrialiser la collecte et la qualité des données

• Cartographier les différentes sources de données : monitoring, observabilité, ITSM, CMDB, infrastructures, cloud et fournisseurs.
• Définir et implémenter une stratégie d'alerting basée sur des seuils de performance et de criticité.
• Automatiser les flux de collecte, d'analyse et de publication des indicateurs.
• Garantir la qualité, la cohérence et la traçabilité des données.
• Documenter les modèles de données, les règles de gestion et le catalogue des indicateurs.
• Superviser le cycle de vie des environnements IT et assurer leur stabilité opérationnelle.

Développer un Service Level Management augmenté par l'IA

• Identifier et prioriser les cas d'usage IA à forte valeur ajoutée.
• Mettre en œuvre des solutions d'analyse prédictive, de détection d'anomalies et de corrélation d'événements.
• Automatiser la production des synthèses de performance, des reportings et des recommandations d'actions.
• Développer des capacités de requêtage en langage naturel sur les données de Production.
• Définir les règles de gouvernance et les garde-fous nécessaires à l'usage responsable de l'IA.
• Mesurer les bénéfices apportés par les solutions d'intelligence artificielle.

Animer la performance et l'amélioration continue

• Préparer et animer les revues de services, comités de performance et comités SLA.
• Analyser les écarts de performance et piloter les plans d'amélioration.
• Challenger les niveaux de service afin d'optimiser l'équilibre entre qualité, coûts et besoins métiers.
• Accompagner les équipes dans l'adoption d'une culture orientée données et résultats.

Votre profil

• Vous êtes titulaire d'un diplôme supérieur de niveau Bac+5 en informatique, data, ingénierie, management des systèmes d'information ou domaine équivalent.
• Vous disposez d'une expérience professionnelle d'au moins 5 ans dans les domaines de la Production IT, du Service Delivery Management, du Service Level Management, de la Data/BI ou de l'observabilité.
• Vous possédez une excellente connaissance des bonnes pratiques ITIL, notamment en gestion des niveaux de service, incidents, problèmes, changements et capacités.
• Vous maîtrisez les outils de Business Intelligence (Power BI, Tableau ou équivalent), SQL et les principes de modélisation de données.
• Vous avez une bonne connaissance des API, mécanismes ETL/ELT et des outils d'automatisation ; la maîtrise de Python constitue un atout.
• Vous comprenez les concepts et usages de l'IA générative et du machine learning appliqués aux opérations IT.
• Vous êtes sensibilisé(e) aux enjeux de sécurité, confidentialité, gouvernance et auditabilité des données.
• Reconnu(e) pour votre esprit d'analyse et votre rigueur, vous savez transformer des données complexes en informations claires et exploitables.
• Vous faites preuve d'un excellent sens du service, d'une forte orientation résultats et d'une capacité à fédérer des interlocuteurs variés.
• Curieux(se) et innovant(e), vous êtes force de proposition et appréciez les environnements en transformation.
• Vous disposez d'excellentes capacités de communication en français, à l'écrit comme à l'oral. La maîtrise de l'anglais professionnel constitue un avantage.

Nous offrons

• Un environnement de travail innovant et orienté transformation digitale.
• La possibilité de contribuer à des projets stratégiques mêlant Data, IA et performance des services IT.
• Une collaboration étroite avec des équipes multidisciplinaires et des partenaires de premier plan.
• Des opportunités de développement professionnel et de montée en compétences sur les technologies émergentes.
• Un cadre favorisant l'autonomie, l'innovation et l'amélioration continue.
• Un équilibre entre performance, qualité de vie au travail et flexibilité organisationnelle.

Meet your future team

Join our Audit practice and play a key role in serving Industry and Services (I&S) clients. You will work closely with engagement teams and specialists across PwC to deliver coordinated, high-quality audit services and build trusted client relationships.
What your role will look like

In this role, you will combine technical excellence, effective team leadership, and strong client relationship management to deliver high-quality audit outcomes and create lasting value for our clients. Key responsibilities include:

• Lead audit engagements from planning through completion, setting clear priorities and maintaining quality across each stage.
• Act as the lead coordinator on group audits, overseeing planning, execution, and reporting across multiple components and jurisdictions.
• Manage a portfolio of clients, ensuring effective delivery, adherence to timelines, and clear communication across engagement teams.

• Build trusted client relationships by understanding stakeholder needs, communicating effectively, and consistently delivering on commitments.
• Lead, coach and develop team members through ongoing guidance, constructive feedback, and the communication of clear expectations and development goals .
• Support business development initiatives by identifying opportunities within existing client relationships and contributing to proposals and market activities.

Your growth and opportunities

Deepen your technical expertise by leading diverse audit engagements across I&S sector. Broaden your leadership experience through client portfolio management, team coaching, and exposure to a broad range of stakeholders, while benefiting from support for professional qualifications and opportunities for internal and international mobility.

The skills you bring

• At least five years of audit experience in an international audit firm including relevant exposure to operational, commercial or public sector organizations.
• Strong knowledge of International Standards on Auditing (ISA), with the ability to lead audit engagements, assess complex audit matters, and provide technical guidance to engagement teams.
• Knowledge of PCAOB auditing standards would be beneficial, particularly in the context of group audits and SEC reporting environments but is not a mandatory requirement.

• Relevant experience in group audits with consolidation requirements, including the review of consolidation processes and coordination of component auditors, would be considered an advantage.
• Fluent in English and either French or Spanish.

Ways of working

• You apply critical thinking to complex issues, anticipate risks and coach others to reach sound, independent judgments.
• You build strong teams, set clear expectations and address tensions proactively to sustain high-quality delivery.
• You own client relationships, lead delivery teams and create value through consistent service excellence.
• You act with integrity, handle confidential information with care, and uphold high ethical standards in every situation

In this role, you will contribute to the risk oversight of EMEA P&C Market Units, working on a broad range of underwriting and business risks.

As Risk Manager EMEA, you will gain broad exposure to Swiss Re's global risk landscape, with a focus on P&C Re underwriting across EMEA. You'll ensure that risks arising from strategic, operational, and market developments are proactively identified and addressed. This role is part of Swiss Re's NEXT journey, offering access to high-impact initiatives, senior stakeholders, and opportunities to shape the future of risk management. Your P&C reinsurance expertise, strong communication skills, and adaptive mindset will allow you to influence key decisions and drive meaningful change.

Key responsibilities

Strategic & Portfolio Oversight

•    Evaluate the P&C Re EMEA underwriting strategy at portfolio level and contribute to the global risk view on business strategy.
•    Review the execution of strategic plans across EMEA, considering regulatory, geopolitical, and market trends.

Transaction & Risk Reviews

•    Assess large and complex P&C transactions in EMEA from both quantitative and qualitative risk angles, influencing decisions at business unit and legal entity levels.
•    Lead or contribute to insurance risk reviews for specific EMEA markets or cross-cutting topics in collaboration with other risk teams.
•    Contribute to the review of material L&H transactions underwritten by Swiss Re Europe and its branches.

Operational risk focus

•    Support identification and mitigation of operational risks related to underwriting activities.

Risk communication

•    Drive impactful internal and external risk communication at Swiss Re Europe and P&C Re Risk Management level.
•    Bring forward new risk insights based on market developments and ongoing interactions with internal partners.

Collaboration is a key to our success.

•    You will work in close co-operation with colleagues across Risk Management to ensure consistency, efficiency and to leverage the full available expertise.
•    You will closely interact with underwriters, client underwriters and develop and maintain trusted relationships with Key Risk Takers in the P&C Re EMEA (e.g. Market Heads).
•    You will contribute to and drive risk management activities, strategic initiatives and projects globally.

About You

We are looking for a motivated professional with a strong risk or underwriting background and the following qualities:

•    Technical background: Experience in underwriting or pricing within P&C (re)insurance.
•    Analytical skills: Ability to simplify complex issues and identify prioritise material risks.
•    Challenge mindset: Comfortable giving constructive feedback and acting as a respected challenger.
•    Emotional intelligence: Strong interpersonal skills, cultural awareness, and the ability to navigate across styles and geographies.
•    Execution & resilience: Self-starter with strong organizational skills and the ability to manage shifting priorities under pressure.
•    Team orientation: Energized by teamwork, with a focus on outcomes and creating value.
•    Strong written and verbal communication skills, with high attention to detail

For Luxembourg, the base salary range for this position is between 71,000 EUR  and EUR 119,000  for a full-time role.

The specific salary offered considers:

•    the requirements, scope, complexity and responsibilities of the role,
•    the applicant's own profile including education/qualifications, expertise, specialisation, skills and experience. In the situation where you do not meet all the requirements or you significantly exceed these, the offered salary may be below or above the advertised range.
•    In addition to your base salary, you may be eligible for additional rewards and benefits including an attractive performance-based annual bonus.

About Risk Management and the Team

This is an exciting opportunity to be part of a growing Risk Management hub in Luxembourg, bringing together colleagues from different risk disciplines across Swiss Re's global footprint — including EMEA, APAC, and the Americas. We are a highly motivated and diverse team that values collaboration, inclusion, and integrity. Our variety of backgrounds and skill sets enables us to provide broad, high-impact support to our stakeholders.We embrace change as an opportunity, enjoy learning from each other, and believe that a good sense of humour and open feedback culture are essential to success.

Looking forward to you application!

BNP Paribas S.A. Luxembourg Branch is one of Europe's leading providers of custody services for securities.
Ranked as the second largest global fund center, Luxembourg is a preferred jurisdiction for institutional and private investors. The Luxembourg Fund Sector is very dynamic, innovative, and well established thanks to its robust regulatory framework.

To support its current growth, BNP Paribas S.A. Luxembourg Branch is looking for:

OPERATIONS PERMANENT CONTROLER – SUBJECT MATTER EXPERT (M/F)

Permanent Contract

Your mission

To support the Operational Permanent Control (OPC) - Subject Matter Expert (SME) team in ensuring that best practices combined with a homogenous and transversal permanent control framework are in place across the OPC community, specifically in the controls and risk mapping (RCSA) matters.

Your tasks and your daily life?

• Be one ot the local OPC SMEs for controls and Risk Control Self-Assessment (RCSA) matters
• Act as Single Point of Contact (SPOC) for global and LoD2 teams on controls and RCSA matters.
• Be the operating link between the CIB central framework and the local 1LoD stakeholders (Business OPC and businesses/functions), cascading RCSA and controls guidelines and information.
• Ensure a consistent approach, monitoring and reporting/dashboard is in place across the business OPC community. Ensure the principles are embedded in the BAU.
• Share best practises amongst the OPC community.

Missions are important, what about the team and work environment?
  
What can this job bring you?

• The candidate will be part of the OPC SME team reporting to the Chief Conduct and Control Officer (CCCO). The function enables the development of a transversal knowledge and expertise in Risk management, Fund Industry and regulatory matters but also leadership and communication skills.

Are you our future OPC SME?

Die Pädagogische Hochschule Freiburg ist eine bildungswissenschaftliche Hochschule universitären Profils mit Promotions- und Habilitationsrecht. An ihr werden ca. 5.000 Studierende in Studiengängen für alle Lehrämter und Schulstufen und in weiteren bildungswissenschaftlichen Bachelor- und Masterstudiengängen ausgebildet.

Leiter/in des Studierendensekretariats (m/w/d)

(bis E 13 TV-L, soweit tarifl. Voraussetzungen erfüllt)

Kennziffer 1123

zu besetzen.

Der Studierendenservice ist für Studierende und Studieninteressierte Ansprechpartner für die verschiedensten Fragestellungen (u.a. Bewerbung, Beratung, Rückmeldung, Leistungsverbuchung). Das Studierendensekretariat ist innerhalb des Studierendenservice für das Bewerbungs- und Zulassungsverfahren zuständig. Ferner zählt das Rückmeldeverfahren, die Immatrikulation und Exmatrikulation Studierender als auch das Ausstellen von Bescheinigungen für Studierende zu seinem Aufgabenspektrum.

Aufgaben:

- Leitung des Geschäftsbereichs Studierendensekretariat mit aktuell 5 Beschäftigten (Personalführung- und Entwicklung)
- Verantwortung für die Planung, Organisation und Durchführung der Arbeitsabläufe zur Zulassung im grundständigen Bereich sowie in den Masterstudiengängen
- Planung, Weiterentwicklung, Organisation und Umsetzung der Prozesse sowie Grundsatzangelegenheiten der Studierendenverwaltung (Immatrikulation, Rückmeldung, Beurlaubung, Parallelstudium, Studiengangswechsel)
- Bearbeitung von verwaltungsrechtlichen Vorgängen (bspw. Zulassungsverfahren, Widersprüche)
- Erstellung der Hochschulstatistik für das Statistische Landesamt
- Leitung von Projekten innerhalb des Bereichs und des Studierendenservice (StS), insbes. Konzeption und Etablierung einer digitalen Studierendenakte
- Kommunikation und Zusammenarbeit mit den anderen StS-Bereichen, mit den Instituten und relevanten Stellen der zentralen Hochschulverwaltung
- Betreuung der Website des Studierendensekretariats (TYPO 3)

Voraussetzungen:

- abgeschlossenes wissenschaftliches Hochschulstudium
- mehrjährige berufliche Erfahrung, nach Möglichkeit in der Hochschulverwaltung
- hervorragende Kenntnisse der deutschen Sprache in Wort und Schrift
- Ausgeprägte Kommunikationsstärke und Entscheidungsfähigkeit
- Prozessmanagementkenntnisse, Erfahrung mit der Gestaltung von Verwaltungs- und Organisationsabläufen sowie Erfahrungen im Projektmanagement, vorzugsweise im Hochschulbereich
- Ausgeprägte Serviceorientierung gegenüber Studieninteressierten und Studierenden sowie Fakultätsvertreter/innen
- Erfahrung in der Erstellung der Hochschulstatistik
-  Kenntnisse im Verwaltungs- und Hochschulrecht sind erwünscht
- Kenntnisse der Campusmanagementsoftware HISinOne sind von Vorteil
- Erfahrungen in der Personalführung sind von Vorteil

Wir bieten:

- Eine vielseitige Stelle mit viel Raum für Eigeninitiative und Eigenverantwortung inmitten eines tollen, freundlichen und kollegialen Teams
- Vorteile wie die Förderung von Fort- und Weiterbildung, Angebote im Rahmen des beruflichen Gesundheitsmanagements, Hansefit, Job-Ticket, flexible Arbeitszeiten inkl. der Möglichkeit des mobilen Arbeitens

Die Pädagogische Hochschule Freiburg versteht sich als familienfreundliche Hochschule. Sie strebt eine Erhöhung des Anteils von qualifizierten Frauen im ausgeschriebenen Bereich an und fordert daher Frauen ausdrücklich zur Bewerbung auf.

Schwerbehinderte Bewerberinnen und Bewerber werden bei gleicher Eignung besonders berücksichtigt. Ein Nachweis ist beizufügen.

Wir freuen uns auf Ihre Online-Bewerbung bis spätestens 11.10.2026 über unser Bewerbungsportal unter https://stellenangebote.ph-freiburg.de.

Die Vorstellungsgespräche finden voraussichtlich in Kalenderwoche 43 statt.

Für Rückfragen steht Ihnen der Leiter des Studierendenservice, Herr Papencordt (0761/682-615), gerne zur Verfügung.

Als selbstständiger Finanzberater begleite ich vor allem Menschen, Eltern und Familien dabei, ihre Finanzen neu zu ordnen. Bei Absicherung, Vorsorge, Vermögensaufbau, Baufinanzierung, Energiethemen und Bankprodukten. Mein Leitsatz: "Ehrlich beraten, nicht verkauft." - Du triffst Menschen gerne auf Augenhöhe – Vertrauen ist dir wichtiger als der schnelle Abschluss.

Besonders willkommen sind Quereinsteiger, die selbst Eltern sind oder ein gutes Gespür für die Themen von Familien mitbringen. Selbstständigkeit mit dem eigenen Team. Als Führungskraft wird der Praxisweg aber auch der Unternehmerweg angeboten.

jobs.description:
Fachberater/-in für Finanzdienstleistungen: hochwertiger Abschluss

Einen hochwertiger IHK-Abschluss , wie geht das? Das funktioniert! Und zwar dann, wenn Praxis und Theorie wirklich ineinandergreifen. In der Ausbildung liegt der Fokus auf der Berufspraxis, die du bei deinem Coach vor Ort in einer Geschäftsstelle der Deutschen Vermögensberatung erlangst. Gepaart mit einer fundierten theoretischen Ausbildung sowie exklusiven Seminaren wirst du innerhalb von 2,5 Jahren zum Finanzprofi. Dank unserer internen Qualifizierung ist kein separater IHK-Ausbildungsvertrag erforderlich. Mit dem Abschluss als Fachberater/-in für Finanzdienstleistungen (IHK) erwirbst Du nach 2,5 Jahren einen anerkannten öffentlich-rechtlichen Abschluss,der gemäß dem Deutschen Qualifikationsrahmen (DQR) dem Niveau 5 entspricht.

Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten

Nach dem Abschluss Fachberater/-in für Finanzdienstleistungen hast du die Möglichkeit, den AbschlussFachwirt/-in für Finanzberatung (IHK) zu erlangen. Die Zeit hierfür beträgt noch einmal 12 Monate. Danach darfst du dich Bachelor Professional of Financial Consulting (CCI) nennen.

Schon gewusst?

Nach dem Deutschen Qualifikationsrahmen (DQR) liegt der Abschluss Fachberater/-in für Finanzdienstleistungen (Niveau 5) über dem klassischen kaufmännischen Abschluss Kaufmann/-frau für Versicherungen und Finanzanlagen

Starten Sie jetzt erfolgreich bei uns als Maschinenbediener - Transformatorenbau (m/w/d) im Rahmen der Arbeitnehmerüberlassung durch!

Ihr neuer Job ist in Vollzeit in Dresden im Bereich Produktion & Fertigung.

Ihre Vorteile in diesem Job

- Arbeitsplatz in einem modernen Unternehmen
- Personalrabatte
- Sehr gute Übernahmechancen

Diese Aufgaben erwarten Sie

- Manuelles Wickeln von Transformatorenspulen nach Fertigungsunterlagen unter Einhaltung von Qualitäts- und Sicherheitsstandards
- Rüsten, Bedienen und Überwachen moderner Wickelmaschinen, inklusive Werkzeug- und Vorrichtungseinrichtung
- Kontrolle der gefertigten Wicklungen auf Maßhaltigkeit, Qualität und Übereinstimmung mit technischen Zeichnungen
- Durchführung von Wartungs- und Pflegearbeiten an Wickelmaschinen und Fertigungsanlagen im Transformatorenbau
- Dokumentation von Fertigungsabläufen und Prüfergebnissen zur Sicherstellung einer lückenlosen Produktionskontrolle
- Unterstützung in der Montage von Transformatorenbauteilen, inklusive Materialvorbereitung und -bereitstellung
- Einrichtung und Anpassung von Wickelparametern zur Herstellung unterschiedlicher Spulentypen im Transformatorenbau
- Einhaltung von Produktionsplänen und Terminvorgaben zur Sicherstellung eines effizienten Fertigungsprozesses

Sie bringen diese Kenntnisse und Fähigkeiten mit

- Mit Berufserfahrung
- Auffassungsfähigkeit/-gabe
- Belastbarkeit
- Motivation/Leistungsbereitschaft
- Selbständiges Arbeiten
- Zuverlässigkeit

Freuen Sie sich auf eine attraktive Vergütung von 16,08 € pro Stunde!

Sie haben noch Fragen zum Job?
Kontaktieren Sie uns unter 03 51 / 4 49 05 - 0 oder per E-Mail an dresden@arwa.de von Montag bis Donnerstag zwischen 08:00 und 17:00 Uhr und am Freitag zwischen 08:00 und 15:00 Uhr, oder besuchen Sie uns persönlich in der Niederlassung.

Mit Ihrer Bewerbung erklären Sie sich mit den Datenschutzrichtlinien der Firma ARWA Personaldienstleistungen GmbH einverstanden. Diese finden Sie auf unserer Homepage www.arwa.de unter dem Punkt “Datenschutz”.
