jobs.title: Assistant Professor in High Frequency Switch-Mode Power Supplies
jobs.description:
The Digital and High-Frequency Electronics (DHFE) section at the Institute of Mechanical and Electrical Engineering, based at the university campus in Odense, seeks outstanding individuals for full-time Assistant Professor positions in Power Electronics, focusing on power management for electronic and computing devices and systems. Successful applicants are expected to contribute to the development of academic programs and the research community. Applicants should have a PhD in Power Electronics or a closely related field. 

The DHFE section focuses on conducting research in digital and high-frequency electronics, embedded systems, control, and communication, utilizing cutting-edge reconfigurable computing and sensors. The aim is to develop next-generation electronics and computing solutions that solve technology-related challenges in fields such as autonomous robots, drones, IoT, smart grid, and healthcare.

Applicants are expected to establish and maintain a research program in high-frequency power electronics and power management for computation, along with low-voltage electronic systems. The position emphasizes converter and power-management for computing platforms and resource-constrained applications, including battery-operated, energy-harvesting, mobile, autonomous, embedded, and sensor-based systems.

The section is a vital component of our Bachelor of Engineering, Bachelor of Science, and Master of Science programs in Electrical and Electronics Engineering in Odense. Currently, the section focuses on three research fields: 1) Drones for Infrastructure Inspections and Interactions, 2) High-Frequency SMPS and power management for low-power electronic systems, and 3) Telecommunication Systems. The section has 15 academics, including professors, postdoctoral fellows, PhD students, and engineers, to support research, industrial collaboration, and educational activities, and is growing steadily.

The SDU campus in Odense contains six faculties and soon a large university hospital, creating a great concentration of academics and students facilitating interdisciplinary research and rich student life. The city of Odense is culturally rich, surrounded by a vibrant and growing robotics community, and highly livable with a green-banked meandering river cutting through the centre and attractive residential areas.

 

Job Description

The position focuses on power management for resource-constrained autonomous, mobile, and embedded electronic systems. Relevant research areas include high-frequency power conversion, battery-operated systems, energy harvesting, power management architectures, embedded control, and analog/digital control of converters. The application domain spans from ultra-low-power electronics and sensors to mobile platforms, robotics, drones, IoT devices, and power management for embedded, compact, and high-performance computing systems.

The role strengthens DHFE’s research profile at the interface between power electronics, microelectronics, embedded systems, and intelligent electronic devices. It is expected to support shared research themes across SDU, including energy-efficient electronics, autonomous systems, battery-powered platforms, sensor networks, health technology, and miniaturized or distributed devices.

The successful candidate should work constructively both with colleagues within DHFE and also with colleagues from other research units, such as SDU Microelectronics, SDU Centre for Industrial Electronics, the Maersk Mc-Kinney Moller Institute, Faculty of Health (specifically Health Tech), Mechanical Engineering, and other relevant environments, translating power electronics competence into system-level contributions for electronic devices and platforms.

 

Duties

As a faculty member, you will be responsible for developing and delivering undergraduate and graduate teaching in Electronic and Electrical Engineering, with particular attention to strengthening control and power electronics within the BSc portfolio. This includes supervising students at Bachelor and Master’s level, mentoring students, integrating with the student body, and participating in education and outreach activities. Research duties include establishing an externally funded research agenda, publishing in leading journals and conferences, supervising early-career researchers, and contributing to the development of DHFE’s research environment. The candidate is also expected to contribute to external collaboration and perform service at the section, department, university, and professional levels.

 

Qualifications Required

  • The applicant should hold a doctoral degree (PhD) in Power Electronics, Electronics, or a related subject area. 

  • Demonstrated potential for teaching undergraduate and graduate courses at the university level. 

  • The applicant must have relevant research expertise in areas related to efficient and high-frequency power converters, converter control, and power management for computing or embedded electronic systems.

  • The applicant must have teaching skills that align with the content and responsibilities of the position. This includes possessing both pedagogical and professional skills essential for carrying out the tasks associated with the role. 

  • A strong track record for research fundraising is required. 

 

For further information about the position, please contact Associate Professor Tim McRae (mcrae@sdu.dk)  or the Head of the Digital and High-frequency Electronics Section, Professor Emad Samuel Malki Ebeid, e-mail: esme@sdu.dk.  

If you experience technical problems, please contact our email support.

 

Application

Applicants are advised to read the SDU information on how to apply.

  • Assessment of candidates is based on the application material, and the application must be in English and include:

  • A motivation letter that clearly explains the applicant's interest, qualifications, and motivation for the position (max. 2 pages). 

  • Detailed Curriculum Vitae, including personal contact information, describing the research, along with any other relevant information, e.g. teaching experience, computational skills, etc.

  • A research plan with a focus on the development of your research line and research team. 

  • List of funded projects. 

  • Teaching Portfolio documenting teaching, learning, and supervision qualifications and approach. Any format is acceptable; see the Faculty's teaching portfolio page for inspiration.

  • Master’s and PhD degree certificates or equivalent (original and an official English translation).

  • List of publications with the most relevant publications highlighted. 

  • Publications most relevant to the position.

  • Up to three names and emails of researchers can provide an informed reference letter at short notice. (Reference letters and other relevant qualifications may also be included.) 

All documents must be in English and PDF format. CPR number (civil registration number) must be crossed out. All PDF-files must be unlocked, allow binding and may not be password protected.

SUBMISSION GUIDE: Motivated application must be uploaded under ‘Cover letter’ (max. 5 MB), Curriculum Vitae must be uploaded under ‘Resume’ (max 5 MB). All other documents must be uploaded under ‘Miscellaneous documents’ (max 10 files with a maximum 50 MB per file).

 

The application deadline is November 1, 2026, at 11:59 PM/23:59 (CET/CEST)

 

Assessment and selection process

Applications will be assessed by an assessment committee. Shortlisting may be applied, and only shortlisted candidates will receive a written assessment. Read about shortlisting at SDU.  Interviews and tests may be part of the overall evaluation. Read about the Assessment and selection process.  

  

Employment terms

Appointment as an assistant professor is temporary and for an initial 3-year period, and the preferred start date is from January 1, 2027. The final start date will be agreed with the successful applicant.

During employment, the assistant professor will complete the Lecturer Training Programme. 

Employment as an assistant professor requires academic qualifications at a minimum of PhD level at the time of employment. Employment will be in accordance with the collective agreement between the Ministry of Finance and the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations for academics in the state including the associated circular on the protocol for the job structure for academic staff at Danish universities and the provisions for assistant professor as described therein. 

Salary is determined in accordance with the applicable collective agreement and based on objective and gender-neutral criteria, including the content of the position, responsibilities, and qualification requirements. As an applicant, you are entitled to information about the starting salary and salary range for the position. This information will be provided during the recruitment process. SDU does not collect information on applicants’ previous salary. Further information on salary and taxation.

Persons employed in the position may, based on a specific individual managerial assessment, be exempted from time registration, also known as a “self-organizer”.

-

The University of Southern Denmark wishes its staff to reflect the surrounding community and therefore encourages everyone, regardless of personal background, to apply for the position. SDU conducts research in critical technologies, which, due to the risk of unwanted knowledge transfer, is subject to a number of security measures. Therefore, based on information from open sources, background checks may be conducted on candidates for the position(s).

Further information for international applicants about entering and working in Denmark. You may also visit WorkinDenmark for additional information.

Further information about The Faculty of Engineering.

Pääasiallisena tehtävänäsi on toimia asentajana hydrauliikkaan liittyvissä huolto- ja korjaustehtävissä esim. letkujen valmistus sekä huolto. Tehtäviä voi olla aika ajoin myös sylinterityöt, öljyjen vaihto tai vaativammatkin korjaustyöt. Töitä tehdään kokoaikaisesti 37,5h/viikko ja odotamme hakijalta reissuvalmiutta, sillä töitä tehdään asiakasyrityksen toimipisteellä, telakoilla ja aluksilla. Reissujen pituudet vaihtelevat aina muutamasta päivästä pariin viikkoon riippuen telakasta/aluksesta ja tämän sijainnista, mutta useimmiten nämä sijaitsevat Suomessa tai muualla Euroopassa. Ajoittaisen ulkomaanreissaamisen vuoksi edellytämme sinulta vähintään kohtalaista englannin kielen osaamista.

Mitä toivomme sinulta?

\- Aikaisempi tehtävään soveltuva koulutus esim. raskaan kaluston koulutus, hydrauliikka ja/tai työkokemus vastaavista tehtävistä on eduksi tehtävässä menestymisen kannalta.

\- Oman ajoneuvon käyttömahdollisuutta asiakasyrityksen sijainnin vuoksi ja lisäksi C-ajokortti lasketaan eduksi.

\- Reissuvalmiutta aina muutamasta päivästä muutamaan viikkoon asti ajoittain.

\- Arvostamme myös kiinnostusta tekniikkaa ja koneita kohtaan, kyvykkyyttä sitoutua tehtävään, halua oppia ja omaksua uusia asioita, kykyä omatoimiseen ja tiimityöskentelyyn, joustavuutta sekä rehtiä ja reipasta työskentelyotetta.

Työt alkavat sopimuksen mukaan ja paikka täytetään sopivan henkilön löydyttyä. In English:

About Lomac A/S
Lomac A/S is a Danish manufacturing company specializing in steel constructions, working within areas such as marine, offshore, construction, and wind turbines. We currently have 50–60 employees, and due to a strong order intake and exciting customer projects, we need more skilled welders for our production.
We already have international employees on our team, so we know what it takes to give new international colleagues a good start — both professionally and socially.

We offer

  • Permanent position in a well-established and solid company
  • Modern machinery and good working conditions
  • Training and hands-on onboarding at the start
  • Free accommodation in a single room during your work periods in Denmark.
  • A working environment with experienced and dedicated colleagues
  • Opportunities for professional and personal development


Job content

  • MIG/MAG welding of steel constructions for marine, offshore, construction, and wind turbine projects, among others
  • Reading technical drawings and working according to work instructions
  • Quality control of your own work
  • Collaborating with other production staff to meet delivery deadlines


We expect that you

  • Are a qualified welder or have documented experience as a welder
  • Hold a valid welding certificate 136/138 H-LO45 D168, or equivalent documented qualification
  • Are reliable, punctual, and take a professional approach to the work
  • Can work independently and as part of a team
  • Are quality-conscious and detail-oriented


Requirements for applicants

  • Are a citizen of an EU/EEA country, or already hold a valid Danish work permit
  • Can communicate in English and/or German
  • Are willing to work in Denmark for set periods at a time (rotation scheme – see Terms of Employment below)

  • Working hours: 6–7 days a week x 10.5 hours – day and night shifts
  • Hourly pay: DKK 180/200 (approximately EUR 24/27) per hour

jobs.title: Manager, Solutions Consultants, UKI
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.



Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.




ABOUT THE ROLE:

The Solutions Consultant Manager is the person who makes our GTM motion real on the ground. As an in-region leader directly managing a team of Solutions Consultants, you'll own your team's full commercial output—new logo, expansion, and renewals—and be accountable for both the results and the quality of execution that produces them.

This isn't a traditional pipeline-management role. The best SC Managers are coaches first: they know what a great first meeting looks like, can watch a live build and tell a rep exactly what to change, and build the operating rhythm and inspection cadence that makes consistent execution possible across the team. If you're a builder who loves developing people as much as winning deals—and you want to lead a regional team in a go-to-market model that's genuinely new—this is the role.

jobs.title: Kundskapsledningsexpert (Borgå)
jobs.description:
**Östra Nylands välfärdsområde söker en KUNSKAPSLEDNINGSEXPERT för en visstidsanställning för tiden 1.10.2026 – 31.12.2027. Arbetet placerar sig i början vid enheten för digitala tjänster inom koncern- och strategitjänsterna, i teamet för kunskapsbaserad ledning och analytik.**

Enheten för digitala tjänster erbjuder ICTtjänster och ansvarar för utvecklingen av digitala tjänster inom hela välfärdsområdet. Du arbetar i teamet för kunskapsbaserad ledning och analytik tillsammans med andra experter inom digitala tjänster och verksamheten.

Vårt team ansvarar för välfärdsområdets kunskapsbaserade ledning, datalagret och rapporteringslösningarna. Datalagret tar emot data från flera olika patient och kunddatasystem samt bl.a. från ekonomi och personaladministrativa system.

Som kunskapsledningsexpert fungerar du som huvudanvändare för datalagret samt för andra teknologier för kunskapsbaserad ledning. Du säkerställer att datalagerlösningen betjänar välfärdsområdets behov, är nationellt kompatibel och leverantörsoberoende. Du deltar i modelleringen av datalagrets data samt i att producera, utveckla och upprätthålla rapportering. Datalagret är ett Azure Databricks-datalager och rapporteringen genomförs med Power BI. Modelleringen görs med SQL- och Pythonspråk.

Datagrunden består av kund- och patientuppgifter, ekonomiförvaltningens uppgifter, personalförvaltningens uppgifter samt andra uppgifter som är väsentliga med tanke på välfärdsområdets verksamhet. Huvuddelen av uppgifterna har modellerats enligt medaljongarkitekturen. Som expert inom kunskapsbaserad ledning förstår du data och hur data kan utnyttjas för att uppnå organisationens mål. Du är med och definierar informationsbehov tillsammans med ledningen och genomför dem via datalagret till rapporterna.

Din centrala uppgift är att utveckla utnyttjandet av datalagerlösningen och produktiviteten tillsammans med vårt team. Datagrunden ska framöver möjliggöra utvecklingen av analytik, maskininlärning och artificiell intelligens samt förbättra produktiviteten och kvaliteten i välfärdsområdets tjänster. Den exakta arbetsbeskrivningen formas enligt den valda personens kompetensområden.

Företagshälsovården handhas av Mehiläinen. Vi erbjuder också möjlighet att arbeta på distans enligt överenskommelse.

**Behörighetskrav:**

- En högskoleexamen som lämpar sig för uppgiften

- Som språkkrav krävs utmärkta muntliga och skriftliga kunskaper i det ena inhemska språket och goda muntliga kunskaper i det andra


**Vi förväntar oss dessutom:**

- Arbetserfarenhet av datalagerlösningar och/eller av att utnyttja stora datamängder i arbetet

- God samarbetsförmåga och erfarenhet av självständigt arbete inom kunskapsbaserat ledning, rapportering eller ICTutveckling och underhåll


**Vi uppskattar:**

- arbetserfarenhet och kunskaper av kunskapsbaserade ledningens uppgifter

- förmåga att lära sig snabbt

- kännedom om nationella riktlinjer för kund och patientdata inom social och hälsovården

- kunskaper i Azure Databricks, Power BI, SQL- och Pythonspråk


Anställningsvillkoren följer VÄLKA. Arbetet är dagarbete och veckoarbetstiden är 36 h 15 min. Den uppgiftsrelaterade lönen är 4290,9 euro/mån samt eventuella tillägg. Prövotiden är sex månader. Sökanden måste ge sitt samtycke till att en säkerhetsutredning genomförs.

Skicka in din ansökan senast 4.10.2026 kl. 23:59. Mer information ges av kunskapsledningschef Mervi Makkonen, tfn 040 152 8109 tai mervi.makkonen@itauusimaa.fi

Vid tillsättandet av uppgiften beaktas i första hand de anställda som sagts upp av produktionsmässiga och ekonomiska skäl inom Östra Nylands välfärdsområde, förutsatt att de uppfyller behörighetskraven för uppgiften.

jobs.title: Distance Technologies: Data Collection Driver
jobs.description:
**Type:** Part-time, fixed term

**Location:** John Stenbergin ranta 2, Helsinki

**Application deadline:** 1.10.2026

Drive, collect real-world data and help develop next-generation technology designed to make vehicles safer and smarter.

**What will you be doing?**

Distance Technologies is looking for a part-time Data Collection Driver to support the development of its next-generation display technologies. Your main responsibility is to drive a Distance-provided car and collect camera and sensor data in different environments around the capital area. The data is used by Distances R&D teams to develop technologies such as depth estimation, positioning, and latency compensation, so your drives might take you from city streets and highways to forest roads in varying conditions.

Based on requests from the engineering team, you will plan suitable routes, operate pre-made data collection scripts from a laptop, and verify that the cameras and sensors are working properly. During the drive, you will troubleshoot basic technical issues independently, such as Wi-Fi, cable, USB device or storage problems. After each drive, you will check and upload the recordings and document the driving conditions and any unexpected events.

**What makes you a great fit?**

This role suits you if you are looking for a flexible part-time role, where you can combine driving with an interest in technology and gain experience in a real R&D environment. The role can fit well alongside technical studies, but relevant skills and curiosity may just as well come from work experience, projects or hobbies.

You are comfortable with computers, enjoy solving practical problems and can work independently based on technical instructions. What matters is a reliable approach to driving, technical curiosity, and willingness to learn.

**We expect you to have:**

- A valid Category B driving license and responsible driving skills

- Recent and regular driving experience in both urban environments and varying road conditions in Finland

- Good computer skills and confidence following technical instructions

- Ability to troubleshoot basic issues with Wi-Fi, USB devices, cables, storage and similar equipment

- Reliable and independent approach to your work

- Good English skills


**We consider as an asset:**

- Familiarity with Linux

- Experience with cameras, lenses, focusing, sensors, or similar equipment

- Basic scripting skills, such as automating a file transfer

- Familiarity with computer vision or related technologies


**We can offer you:**

- Chance to build valuable technical experience in a flexible entry-level role that can fit alongside your studies or other commitments

- Opportunity to join a growing deep tech company developing new technology for global automotive and defense applications

- Environment to improve vehicle safety, seeing how the data you collect contributes directly to its development

- Hands-on experience with advanced cameras, sensors, and test equipment while learning how deep tech products are developed

- Opportunity to work closely with experienced engineers, giving you practical exposure to computer vision and sensor development


**Practicalities:**

This is a part-time (16-32,5h/month) and fixed term position until 31.1.2027. Working hours are flexible and agreed based on data collection needs. As data collection depends on suitable weather conditions, scheduled shifts may occasionally need to be rescheduled at short notice due to weather. We therefore hope that you are flexible regarding working days and hours. In this role you will be employed directly as a aTalent employee at Distance Technologies. Start time is as soon as possible. The role will be located in Helsinki. Salary in this position is 18,00-22,00 €/hour depending on the level of your experience, and will be negotiated individually.

- Interview rounds with Distance Technologies: week 42

jobs.title: Digital Marketing Manager
jobs.description:
We are looking for a Digital Marketing Manager to join our Marketing & Communications team in Helsinki and shape how customers discover, engage with, and experience Bluefors across digital channels. In this role, you will combine strategic thinking with hands-on execution to strengthen our digital presence, develop demand generation, and turn marketing activities into measurable commercial impact. Interested? Keep reading!

You will take ownership of Bluefors' digital marketing activities, channels, technologies, and performance. As a member of the Marketing & Communications team, you will help ensure that customers can easily discover and engage with Bluefors through a connected digital ecosystem. Working closely with Sales, other customer-facing teams, and IT, you will plan and optimize campaigns, develop our website and social media presence, and use analytics to continuously improve engagement, conversion, and marketing effectiveness.

We are looking for a data-driven digital marketing professional who can translate business and commercial priorities into clear actions. You combine a strong understanding of digital channels with experience in marketing automation, lead management, campaign execution, and performance measurement. You are comfortable working across teams and systems, can move between strategic planning and practical implementation, and communicate clearly with technical and non-technical stakeholders. Success in this role requires curiosity, collaboration, and a strong continuous improvement mindset. You actively seek opportunities to improve ways of working, enhance digital performance, and create better customer experiences.

Experience from technology, engineering, scientific, industrial, or other highly technical B2B environments is considered an advantage. Familiarity with Salesforce, CRM integrations, SEO, generative engine optimization, account-based marketing, AI-enabled marketing tools, and agency or technology partner management would be an additional asset. This experience can help you accelerate the impact of our digital marketing activities and contribute to the continued development of our digital ecosystem.

We offer you an interesting, challenging, and responsible position with the support of a highly skilled growth organization. This is an excellent opportunity to build a scalable digital marketing ecosystem and grow professionally in a dynamic and collaborative team. Our multicultural work environment gives you room to develop your skills and make a visible impact on Bluefors commercial growth.

Main responsibilities:

* Develop and execute Bluefors digital marketing strategy in line with business, marketing, and commercial objectives.

* Plan, manage, and optimize campaigns across owned, earned, and paid channels.

* Own and develop marketing automation, lead nurturing, lifecycle communications, and related processes.

* Act as Marketings key user and primary business stakeholder for Salesforce CRM and related commercial systems.

* Oversee website performance, social media channels, SEO, generative engine optimization, analytics, conversion, and user experience.

* Establish KPIs and reporting processes, turning performance data into actionable recommendations.

* Develop digital marketing systems, integrations, data flows, platform governance, and AI-enabled capabilities.

* Collaborate with internal stakeholders and manage relevant agencies, technology partners, and service providers.

What we expect from you

* Minimum 10 years of experience in digital marketing, with a strong track record in areas such as marketing automation, campaign execution, and digital performance measurement, supported by relevant education

* Experience with CRM platforms, marketing technologies, campaign automation, lead management, and customer engagement processes.

* Strong analytical skills and the ability to translate data and insights into actions that support commercial objectives.

* Strong understanding of digital channels, website management, SEO, performance marketing, and digital campaign execution.

* Ability to work effectively across teams and systems and communicate clearly with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

* Ability to balance strategic planning with hands-on execution and drive initiatives from concept to implementation.

* A curious and collaborative mindset combined with a strong focus on continuous improvement and optimizing performance, processes, and customer experiences.

* Excellent command of English, both written and spoken.

We also appreciate

* Experience from technology, engineering, scientific, industrial, or other highly technical B2B environments.

* Familiarity with Salesforce, CRM integrations, SEO, generative engine optimization, account-based marketing, and AI-enabled marketing tools.

* Experience managing agencies, technology partners, or external service providers.

Please apply as soon as possible, on October 18, 2026 at the latest, through our recruitment system at BLUEFORS.COM [http://BLUEFORS.COM]. We will review applications on an ongoing basis, and the position will be filled as soon as a suitable candidate is found.

For more information, please contact our Director, Marketing & Communications, Ingela Waismaa, ingela.waismaa@bluefors.com [ingela.waismaa@bluefors.com]. Ingela can also be reached at +358 50 5306603 during the following times: Sept. 28, 08:00-09:00, Sept. 29, 17:00-18:00 and Oct. 13, 09:00-10:00.

jobs.title: Telecom Core Network Expert (PS Core / CS Core)
jobs.description:
This is a temporary, project-based assignment supporting a leading telecom consultancy in a mobile core network performance audit. The role is ideal for an experienced consultant, freelancer, or senior telecom professional looking for an interesting short-term engagement with high-impact work.

We are looking for a Senior Telecom Core Network Expert to join a demanding international network audit project through Barona IT Talent.

About the Assignment

You will support a team conducting a comprehensive audit of a mobile operator's core network environment. Your role is to act as a senior subject matter expert, helping identify bottlenecks, analyze root causes, and provide concrete technical recommendations.

The project is expected to start during October and run for approximately two months. The work can be performed primarily remotely, with potential limited travel if required.

We are open to finding:

- One expert with both PS Core and CS Core expertise,
- or Two specialists covering the respective domains separately.

Responsibilities

Depending on your area of expertise, your work may include:

PS Core Network Audit

- Auditing GPRS/EPC core network architecture and performance Analyzing SGSN, MME, GGSN, SGW and PGW performance
- Assessing interfaces, capacity, redundancy and security
- Evaluating DNS and IP backbone implementations
- Reviewing legacy and cloud-native core deployments
- Investigating alarms, faults, logs and performance KPIs
- Analyzing user mobility and session management performance

CS Core Network Audit

- Auditing Circuit Switched Core architecture and topology
- Assessing MSC, MGW, HLR, HSS and related core elements
- Reviewing traffic routing principles and signalling performance
- Analyzing capacity, utilization and service quality KPIs
- Evaluating virtualized and legacy core implementation
- Supporting fault analysis and network optimization recommendations

You will work closely with experienced audit professionals while providing expert guidance throughout the analysis and reporting phases.

What We Are Looking For

We expect you to have:

Extensive experience with mobile core networks (2G/3G/4G/5G environments)

- Strong expertise in either PS Core, CS Core, or both
- Knowledge of both legacy and virtualized/cloud-based core network architectures
- Proven ability to identify network issues, bottlenecks and performance challenges
- Strong analytical and troubleshooting capabilities
- Previous experience in telecom consulting, auditing, or operator network assessments
- Ability to work independently and provide actionable recommendations
- Professional-level English communication skills
Experience working directly with mobile operators is considered a strong advantage.

What We Offer

- Flexible remote working model
- Collaboration with leading telecom experts
- An interesting, specialist-level project assignment
- Possibility to participate in similar future assignments based on project needs and performance

Submit your CV and wanted information to our candidate database as soon as possible. We review candidates continuously and aim to identify suitable specialists quickly.

jobs.title: Chief Specialist, Physical activity and functional capacity
jobs.description:
Are you passionate about advancing research and innovation that improves physical activity, functional capacity, and human performance across the lifespan? LAB University of Applied Sciences is seeking an internationally recognized researcher with expertise in physical activity, functional capacity, rehabilitation, or related fields to strengthen its Physical Activity and Functional Capacity Research Group.

We welcome applicants with expertise in areas such as physical activity promotion, prevention of functional decline, neurofunctional health, rehabilitation, digital health solutions, and data-driven assessment and monitoring of human function and performance.

What your work will be like

In this position, you will contribute to the scientific development of LAB's Physical Activity and Functional Capacity Research Group and strengthen its national and international profile. You will participate in high-quality research, build multidisciplinary collaborations, and support the development of impactful research, development, and innovation activities.

You will work closely with academic, healthcare, industry, and societal partners in Finland and internationally. You will be expected to actively acquire competitive research funding from Finnish, European, and international funding programmes, publish in leading peer-reviewed journals, and strengthen cooperation between LAB University of Applied Sciences and LUT University.

Key research tasks include:

- conducting and leading high-quality research in physical activity, functional capacity, rehabilitation, or related fields.
- acquiring competitive research funding from national and international funding instruments.
- leading and contributing to multidisciplinary research, development, and innovation projects.
- publishing scientific results in internationally recognized peer-reviewed journals.
- building and maintaining strategic partnerships with industry, healthcare organizations, public-sector actors, and academic institutions.
- strengthening research collaboration between LAB University of Applied Sciences and LUT University.
- Depending on the selected candidates experience and expertise, the role may also include leadership of the Physical Activity and Functional Capacity Research Group and responsibility for developing its strategic research agenda and scientific activities.

What we expect from you

You have a doctoral degree in a relevant field, such as health sciences, rehabilitation sciences, sport and exercise sciences, physiotherapy, public health, biomedical sciences, human movement sciences, neuroscience, health technology, digital health, or another relevant discipline. Qualifications corresponding to the Finnish title of Docent (Adjunct Professor) are considered an advantage.

To succeed in this role, you should demonstrate:

- a strong track record of internationally recognized research and scientific publications.
- demonstrated success in securing competitive research funding.
- experience in leading multidisciplinary research and development projects.
- experience in collaboration with industry, healthcare, public sector, and academic partners.
- strong communication, networking, and scientific leadership skills.
- The ability to lead and develop a multidisciplinary research team; previous research group leadership experience is considered an advantage.
- excellent English language skills (CEFR C1) and good working knowledge of Finnish (CEFR B2), or a willingness to develop Finnish language proficiency. Additional language skills are considered an asset.

What we offer

The position offers a unique opportunity to contribute to the future of physical activity, functional capacity, rehabilitation, and digital health research within a rapidly developing university research environment.

You will join an innovation-driven university of applied sciences with strong regional, national, and international networks. LAB provides access to a growing ecosystem of companies, research institutes, healthcare organizations, and public-sector partners that support collaboration and the development of new solutions. You will work in an increasingly international, highly skilled, and collaborative community that values openness, curiosity, and teamwork. You will also benefit from LAB's developing research infrastructure.

Your primary workplace can be either the Lahti or Lappeenranta campus. LAB follows a modern hybrid work model that combines flexibility with regular collaboration on campus.

The position is permanent and full-time, starting on 1 November 2026 or as agreed. A six-month probationary period applies.

Employment conditions follow the collective agreement for universities of applied sciences (Sivistysala ry). The position falls under the working-time system for experts and support staff, with a regular working time of 36.25 hours per week.

The monthly salary ranges from approximately EUR 5,200 to EUR 6,100 depending on the successful candidates qualifications, experience, and demonstrated expertise.

Interested? Please submit your application and CV through the recruitment system by 25 September 2026 at 23:59 (Finnish local time, UTC+2). We will review applications on a rolling basis. Only applications submitted through the recruitment system will be considered.

For further information about the position, please contact RDI Director Kati Peltonen (kati.peltonen@lab.fi, +358 44 708 1041). She is available for enquiries on Friday, 18 September 2026, from 13:00 to 14:00 and on Tuesday, 22 September 2026, from 09:00 to 10:00 (Finnish time).

Read more about the LAB University of Applied Sciences [here](https://www.lab.fi/en/info/about-us).

The best of both worlds: studies and work. The LAB University of Applied Sciences is a higher education institution specialising in innovation, business and industry. It operates in Lahti and Lappeenranta, Finland, and also online. We offer education in five fields: health care and social services, technology, business, hospitality, and design, fine arts and visual communication. We focus on supporting responsible, regenerative growth through intangible value creation, multipurpose materials, and human well-being. We have 10 900 students and 650 teachers and RDI experts.

Miltä kuulostaisi merkityksellinen ja arvokas työ sinulle sopivilla työajoilla? Haluaisitko saada työkokemusta hoitoalasta näköalapaikalta, tai kaipaatko tekemistä eläkepäivien ratoksi rauhallisissa olosuhteissa yksi asiakas kerrallaan? Tule mukaan! Henkilökohtaisena avustajana meillä pääset osaksi asiakkaidemme arvokkaita tarinoita.

Validialla henkilökohtaisen avun asiakkaat ovat vammaispalvelujen piiriin kuuluvia henkilöitä. Henkilökohtainen apu on kotona tai kodin ulkopuolella tapahtuvaa avustamista niissä asioissa, joihin henkilö ei itse kykene sairauden tai vamman vuoksi. Avustaminen voi olla harrastuksissa tai opiskelussa tukemista, kodinhoidollisia askareita tai vapaa-ajan tapahtumien mahdollistamista. Toisinaan avustajan tärkeimpänä tehtävänä on olla juttukaverina ja seurana: olla se kiireetön ihminen ihmiselle. Henkilökohtaisen avustajan rooli asiakkaan arjessa on merkittävä, sillä pyrkimyksenä on tukea ja mahdollistaa kotona asuminen mahdollisimman pitkään, sekä tarjota mahdollisuus aktiiviseen ja mielekkääseen arkeen toteuttaen asiakkaan itsemääräämisoikeutta.

Työ sopii sinulle, joka kaipaat vaihtelevuutta ja satunnaisuutta työhösi työtä tehdään asiakkaan tarpeiden ja toiveiden mukaisesti. Sinulla on myös mahdollisuus vaikuttaa vuorojesi ajankohtiin yhdessä asiakkaan kanssa sopien. Työskentelet itsenäisesti ja sitoudut sovittuihin käytäntöihin. Avoimella asenteella ja omalla persoonalla pääsee pitkälle! Joustavuuden ansiosta työmme sopii niin opiskelijalle kuin eläkeläisellekin lisäansioksi. Emme edellytä sinulta alan koulutusta tai työkokemusta, mutta nämä luetaan eduksi.

**Tarjoamme sinulle**

- Työehtosopimuksen mukaisen palkkauksen: Yksityisen sosiaalipalvelualan TES, palkkaluokka G16A

- Joustavan työajan

- Mahdollisuuden tutustua vammaistyöhön ja hoitoalaan

- Perehdytyksen osaamisesi mukaan

- Ammattitaitoisen huumorilla höystetyn työyhteisön tuen

- Mahdollisuuden lisäopintojen kautta työllistyä myös muihin sosiaali- ja terveysalan työtehtäviin


**Toivomme sinulta**

- Aitoa kiinnostusta avustamistyötä kohtaan

- Positiivista ja iloista asennetta

- Halua oppia uutta ja kehittyä työssäsi

- Riittävää suomen kielen taitoa, muu kielitaito katsotaan eduksi


Edellytämme sinulta Tartuntatautilain **48 §:n mukaista rokotussuojaa** sekä **55 §:n mukaista tuberkuloosiselvitystä**. Lisäksi tarkistamme rikosrekisteriotteensosiaali- ja terveydenhuollon valvonnasta annetun lain mukaisesti.

Jätäthän tietosi hakulomakkeen kautta. Henkilökohtaisen avun tehtäviin tarvitaan uusia työntekijöitä sitä mukaa, kun asiakaskuntamme kasvaa. Olemme hakijoihin yhteydessä, kun hakijan ja asiakkaan tarpeet ja toiveet kohtaavat. Täytäthän hakemuksesi siis huolellisesti! Lisätietoja tehtävästä kaivatessasi voit olla yhteydessä meihin sähköpostitse hkapuhr@validia.fi

**Rekrytoinnin eteneminen**

Panostamme siihen, että rekrytointi on reilua ja että juuri sinun osaamisesi pääsee esiin. Tässä rekrytoinnissa hyödynnämme **Hubert.ai -tekoälyhaastattelua.**

Hakemuksen jättämisen jälkeen sinut kutsutaan chat-pohjaiseen haastatteluun virtuaalisen rekrytointiassistenttimme Hubertin kanssa. Haastattelu kestää noin 15-20 minuuttia, ja voit tehdä sen sinulle sopivana aikana. Suosittelemme kuitenkin aloittamaan sen pian, jotta rekrytointi etenee sujuvasti. Tekoälypohjainen haastattelu toimii vain tukityökaluna, kaikki lopulliset arviot ja päätökset tekee ihminen.

jobs.title: Henkilökohtainen avustaja 33-40h/vko, Loimaa
jobs.employer: Lounais-Suomen Lihastautiyhdistys ry, ruotsiksi Sydvästra Finlands Muskelhandikappförening rf
jobs.description:
Etsimme avustajarinkiimme vähintään yhtä (1) vakituista henkilökohtaista avustajaa avioparille.

Minä ja vaimoni sairastamme neurologisia sairauksia, jotka heikentävät toimintakykyämme etenevästi. Tarvitsemme avustajaa kaikissa päivittäisissä asioissa kuten syöminen, hygienia, liikkuminen ja asioilla käymisessä. Apuvälineitä ovat mm. Kattonosturi, manuaali pyörätuolit ja suihkutuoli. Työpäivät ovat pääsääntöisesti ma-su klo 8-21 välillä kahdessa vuorossa (8-15/ 14-21). Työvuorojen pituudesta voidaan neuvotella, ei ole kiveen kirjoitettuja. Työt alkavat heti sopivan henkilön löydyttyä.

Avustajan työnkuvaan sisältyy:

\- lääkehoito

\- hygienian hoito myös intiimihygienia

\- hoitotyöt

\- ruuanlaitto ja syömisessä avustaminen

\- pyörätuolin työntämistä

\- vapaa-ajan riennoissa mukana olemista

\- kodinhoidolliset askareet

Opastan itse kaikissa työtehtävissä ja työhön perehdytetään.

Paikka sijaitsee Loimaan keskustassa. Palkkaus Heta-TESin mukaan, (palkkaluokka B2). Vakituinen paikka täytetään heti sopivan työntekijän löytyessä. Hoitotyön kokemuksesta on hyötyä.

Pääsääntöisesti uusiin työsuhteisiin kuuluu koeaika.

Katso tarkemmat hakuohjeet sivun alalaidasta.

Lounais-Suomen Avustajakeskus/LSLY ry (avustajakeskus.fi) välittää henkilökohtaisia avustajia vammaisille työnantajille. Avustajan valinnasta päättää työnantaja itse.

jobs.title: Process Expert, Supplier Master Data
jobs.description:
About the role

In this role, you will lead the documentation, design, and harmonization of Supplier Master Data processes. You will collaborate closely with Procurement and Finance GPOs to bridge technical and business requirements, ensuring a seamless transition to SAP S/4HANA.

Work tasks

This role focuses on leading the design, documentation, and harmonization of Supplier Master Data processes to support a major ERP transformati
- Lead the documentation and design of Supplier Master Data processes in alignment with Procurement and Finance GPOs
- Conduct gap analyses between current processes and SAP standard processes to facilitate a standard end state
- Drive data harmonization and preparation activities for the upcoming ERP transformation
- Define training and change management needs, acting as the Subject Matter Expert for training inputs
- Act as the Global Process Owner (GPO) for the Supplier Master Data process area
- Collaborate with diverse, geographically divided teams to align technical and business requirements

We are looking for

- Good understanding of SAP S/4HANA standard processes and the SAP Business Partner model
- Good understanding of Vendor Master Data (VMD) best-in-class processes
- Ability to combine technical and business requirements and challenge end-user assumptions
- Excellent collaboration and communication skills to work effectively with diverse, global teams

Other information:

Start: October

Employment period: 12 months, possibility to extension

Location: Mostly remote work, occasional visits to Helsinki

Our recruitment process

This recruitment process is handled by Academic Work and it is our clients wish that all questions regarding the position is directed to Academic Work.

Our selection process is continuous and the advert may close before the recruitment process is completed if we have moved forward to the next phase. The process includes two tests: one personality test and one cognitive test. The tests are tools to find the right talent for the right position, to enable equality, diversity, and a fair process.

jobs.title: Process Expert, Strategic Sourcing & Category Management
jobs.description:
About the role

In this role, you will lead the process design and documentation for direct sourcing, category management, and supplier management. You will work closely with geographically dispersed teams and act as a critical bridge between business stakeholders and technical SAP templates. Your assertiveness and expertise will drive the alignment towards SAP standard solutions.

Work tasks

This role involves leading the documentation, design, and harmonization of sourcing and category management processes to prepare for a major SAP S/4HANA ERP transformation.

 
- Lead the documentation and design of Core Category Management, Supplier Management, and Sourcing processes
- Conduct gap analyses between current processes and SAP standard processes
- Facilitate alignment to achieve an end-state as close to SAP standard as possible
- Lead data harmonization and preparation efforts for the upcoming ERP transformation
- Define tool requirements to support the transition and change of sourcing systems
- Define training and change management needs, acting as a Subject Matter Expert
- Support current Global Process Owner (GPO) resources throughout the project

We are looking for

- Advanced knowledge of SAP S/4HANA standard processes in Source-to-Pay (STP)
- Good experience in STP process transformation and process documentation
- Ability to bridge technical requirements with business needs
- Strong communication skills in English, with the assertiveness to challenge stakeholders

Other information:

jobs.title: Team Leader - Night Shift Operations
jobs.description:
Team Leader - Night Shift Operations

Transport 24 Danmark ApS

Are you ready to lead a dynamic transport and distribution team in a fast-paced logistics environment?

At Transport 24 Danmark ApS, we are looking for three experienced and motivated Team Leaders - Night Shift Operations to ensure the efficient execution of our transportation and delivery services in association with DAO.

You will be responsible for leading employees, maintaining operational excellence, and ensuring high service quality while creating a positive and productive working environment.

Reporting directly to the Operations Manager, you will play a key role in achieving operational goals, customer satisfaction, and continuous improvement across our night shift operations.

About the Role

As Team Leader, you will oversee the daily operation of our night shift transport and distribution activities. You will manage a team of postmen and operational staffconsisting of 15 persons, ensuring that deliveries are completed safely, efficiently, and on time.

You will work closely with management and operational support functions to optimize productivity, maintain service standards, and ensure effective resource planning.

Key Responsibilities

Your responsibilities will include:

  • Overall responsibility for the daily execution of night shift post operations

  • Planning and coordinating staffing, routes, and operational resources

  • Conducting onboarding and training of new employees

  • Monitoring and controlling delivery route quality, efficiency, and compliance with company standards

  • Ensuring adequate staffing by coordinating replacements during employee sickness, holidays, and other absences

  • Supporting recruitment and employee development in collaboration with HR

  • Investigating operational incidents and implementing corrective actions

  • Driving continuous improvement initiatives and process optimization

  • Collaborating closely with dispatch, customer service, and management teams

  • Participating in operational tasks when required and leading by example

Your Profile

We are looking for a hands-on leader who enjoys creating results through people.

You:

  • Have previous  experience within transportation, logistics, distribution, warehousing, or a similar operational environment

  • Are confident managing diverse teams and multicultural workplaces

  • Have strong organizational and planning skills

  • Can work independently and make decisions under pressure

  • Possess good communication and interpersonal skills

  • Are comfortable using IT systems and operational software

  • Have a proactive mindset focused on continuous improvement

  • Are fluent in English , both written and spoken

  • Hold a valid driving license

Experience within courier, delivery operations will be considered an advantage.

What We Offer

  • A key leadership position with significant responsibility

  • Opportunities for professional and personal development

  • Salary, pension, and employment conditions in accordance with the applicable 3F collective agreement

  • A diverse and inclusive workplace culture

Working Hours

This is a full-time position of 37 hours per week.

The role primarily covers night shift operations, with working hours scheduled according to a fixed roster. Flexibility is expected during periods of high operational demand, employee absences, holidays, and operational changes.

Location

Greve, Denmark

Interested?

Would you like to become part of a growing transport company where service quality, reliability, and teamwork are at the heart of everything we do?

We would love to hear from you.

Send your application and CV to:
abi@lagerhotel.dk

jobs.title: Laboratory Test Engineer
jobs.description:
For our client we are looking for a Laboratory Test Engineer to strengthen the project engineering team on automation and protection testing including real time simulations. 

The ideal candidate will have a strong background in power systems, testing and real time simulations. The role focuses on designing and implementing automation, protection and secondary injection tests according to customer specifications. Ideally, the candidate has a vision on how to productize simulation and testing offering. 

You will be mainly accountable for:
· Designing and implementing automation and protection testing including hardware-in-the-loop testing for power systems according to customer specifications
· Leading customer approvals and factory testing of distribution protection relays
· Maintaining the customer approval test laboratory in Vaasa
· Productizing the simulation and test offering

Qualifications For The Role:
· A B.Sc. or M.Sc. degree in electrical or electrical power system engineering or equivalent
· Several years of experience working with power systems and prior experience with electrical installations or a commissioning background
· Prior experience of leading customer approvals or FATs (Factory Acceptance Testing)
· Experience with real time simulators such as RTDS, Typhoon Hil or Opal RT and relay test devices and amplifiers such as Omicron
· Experience with PSCAD or a similar software is seen as a strong benefit
· Good communication and presentation skills, including fluency in English (written and spoken), Finnish and Swedish language skills are seen as benefits

Answer these questions separately in a few sentences and attach them to your application! (Mandatory!)
- Do you have a B.Sc. or M.Sc. degree in Electrical Engineering, Power Systems Engineering, or a related field?*
- Do you have at least 3 years of experience working with power systems, electrical installations, or commissioning activities?*
- Have you previously led or participated in Factory Acceptance Testing (FAT) or customer approval testing for protection or automation systems?*
- Do you have hands-on experience with real-time simulation tools such as RTDS, Typhoon HIL, or OPAL-RT?*
- Do you have experience using relay testing equipment such as Omicron test sets or similar protection testing devices?*
- Do you have experience with PSCAD or similar power system simulation software?*

Please apply with your updated CV in English, that clearly demonstrates your skills and experience relevant to this role. We offer continuously, which means that we sometimes remove the assignments before deadline. If you are interested, we recommend that you apply immediately.

Location: Vaasa, Finland (four days on-site)
Allocation: 100 %
Start date: Around October-November
End date: Initial 12-month contract
Language: Fluent in English

We offer you: We offer a versatile assignment where every day is different and interesting. We also offer a very competitive salary and good employee benefits.

Are you interested in becoming a part of our dynamic team? The position will be filled as soon as a suitable person is found, so please be quick and submit your application! 

Please include your salary expectation in your application. For more information, contact Kimmo Kärsämä, tel. 050 412 7500, kimmo.karsama@lokki.fi

jobs.title: HR-asiantuntija, Keliber-litiumhanke
jobs.description:
Sibanye-Stillwaterin Keliber-litiumhanke on aloittanut Euroopan ensimmäisen omaan malmiin perustuvan akkulaatuisen litiumhydroksidin tuotannon vaiheittaisen käynnistämisen. Toiminta kattaa koko arvoketjun malminetsinnästä litiumhydroksidin jalostukseen ja vahvistaa Euroopan akkuarvoketjua. Rikastamo sijaitsee Kaustisen Päivänevalla ja litiumjalostamo Kokkolan suurteollisuusalueella (KIP).
Litiumhydroksidi on keskeinen raaka-aine litiumioniakuissa, jotka mahdollistavat sähköautot, energian varastoinnin ja monet digitaalisen arjen ratkaisut.
Keliber on kansainvälisen kaivos- ja metallinjalostusyhtiön Sibanye-Stillwaterin tytäryhtiö, ja sen toiseksi suurin omistaja on kotimaista akkuarvoketjua kehittävä Finnish Minerals Group.

hyvän työilmapiirin rakentaminen ja ylläpitäminen, työhyvinvoinnin tukeminen ja yrityskulttuurin kehittäminen

soveltuvaa korkeakoulututkintoa
vähintään 3–5 vuoden kokemusta palkka- ja henkilöstöhallinnon tehtävistä teollisuusympäristössä sekä vahvaa työehtosopimusten tuntemusta

käytännönläheistä työskentelyotetta sekä kykyä ja halua oma-aloitteiseen ja itsenäiseen työskentelyyn
sujuvaa suomen ja englannin kielen taitoa, ruotsin osaaminen on etu

Meillä turvallisuus on aina etusijalla, ja teollisuusyrityksenä kiinnitämme erityistä huomiota ympäristöasioiden kestävään hoitamiseen. Ymmärrämme työn ja muun elämän yhteensovittamisen merkityksen hyvinvoinnille, jota tuemme mm. liukuvalla työajalla ja mahdollistamalla etätyö työtehtävien salliessa.

HUMAN RESOURCES SPECIALIST

to participate in the management and development of the company's human resources across the entire HR function, particularly in matters relate to employment relationships, payroll and reporting. You will report to the Head of Human Resources.

Monitoring, advising, and training on employment matters, as well as collaborating with employee representatives and participating in cooperative activities

Building and maintaining a positive work environment, supporting employee well-being, and developing the company culture

Have a customer-oriented and solution-focused approach to work and strong communication and collaboration skills

jobs.title: Postdoctoral Position in Animal Welfare Risks of Feeding Red Seaweed to Dairy Cows
jobs.description:
The Department of Animal and Veterinary Sciences, Aarhus University, calls for applications for a full-time postdoctoral position. The two-year position is available from 1 February 2027, or soon thereafter. The position will be in the research unit Behaviour, stress and welfare (BSW).

Dairy cattle contribute substantially to agricultural greenhouse gas emissions, primarily through enteric methane production, making the identification of effective nutritional mitigation strategies an important area of research. While the feed additive Bovaer has received considerable attention for its methane-reducing effects, concerns regarding animal health and welfare have led to increasing interest in alternative solutions, including seaweed-based feed additives. The seaweed Asparagopsis spp. has shown significant methane-mitigating potential; however, its use has also raised animal welfare concerns. Consequently, there is a need to evaluate the animal welfare effects of seaweed-based feed additives.

Research tasks
  • Evaluating the effects of seaweed-based feed additives on the behaviour and welfare of dairy cattle.
  • Investigating behavioural indicators of discomfort and pain associated with feed management.
  • Validating welfare assessment measures through experimental approaches, including pharmacological interventions.
  • Contributing to scientific publications and dissemination of research results.
  • Participating in knowledge exchange activities with public authorities and industry stakeholders.
  • Contributing to teaching and supervision of students at the bachelor's, master's, and PhD levels.


Qualifications
We are seeking a candidate who has:
  • A PhD degree or equivalent in biology, animal science, veterinary science, or a related field, and research experience in animal behaviour and welfare.
  • A strong interest in strategies aimed at reducing the climate impact of dairy production through feeding management.
  • At least a basic understanding of feeding management.
  • Strong interpersonal and communication skills, with a demonstrated ability to communicate scientific research results effectively.
  • The ability to work independently as well as collaboratively in a research environment.
  • For non-Scandinavian candidates, a commitment to learning Danish, including reading, writing, and speaking, is expected during the employment period.


Contact
Further information on the position may be obtained from Professor Margit Bak Jensen, phone: +4522365482, email: margitbak.jensen@anivet.au.dk

What we offer
  • A well-developed research infrastructure, laboratories and access to shared equipment and animal experimental facilities
  • An informal and multicultural research environment with high professionalism and close collaboration and networking activities
  • A workplace characterized by equality and a good work-life balance, and an open discussion across different fields of research.


The candidate will have the opportunity to be trained and gain experience in:
  • Teaching and supervision of students at the BSc and MSc level through active involvement in teaching in animal science and in the veterinary science programme.
  • Research-based consultancy to authorities, where it is relevant.


Who we are
Department of Animal and Veterinary Sciences is well-known for its skilled and very innovative interdisciplinary research environments with high international impact. We perform world-class research, which contributes with solutions to solve essential societal challenges within the green transition: food production and veterinary medicine – nationally and globally.

The department generates novel research at the highest international level within sustainable food production, environment, climate, health and welfare for animals and humans. The activities form the basis for the research-based public sector consultancy and degree programs covering bachelor’s, master’s and PhD degree programs within animal science and veterinary medicine. We offer a lively, engaged and innovative learning and study environment, which is closely integrated in the research environment.

Our department has unique and advanced animal experimental research facilities and technologies, situated in close connection to the research environment, and a comprehensive national and international research network and good industrial and professional collaboration.

Please refer to Department of Animal and Veterinary Sciences (au.dk) for further information about the department: https://anivet.au.dk/en

Place of work and area of employment
The place of work is the Department of Animal and Veterinary Sciences, AU Viborg,
Blichers Allé 20, DK-8830 Tjele, and the area of employment is Aarhus University (AU) with related departments.

Living in Denmark
Please visit the international staff website: https://internationalstaff.au.dk/prearrival/ for information about arriving to and living in Denmark for both the applicants and their potential families.



Application procedure
Shortlisting is used. This means that after the deadline for applications – and with the assistance from the assessment committee chairman, and the appointment committee if necessary, – the head of department selects the candidates to be evaluated. All applicants will be notified whether or not their applications have been sent to an expert assessment committee for evaluation. The selected applicants will be informed about the composition of the committee, and each applicant is given the opportunity to comment on the part of the assessment that concerns him/her self.



Formalities and salary range
Technical Sciences refers to the Ministerial Order on the Appointment of Academic Staff at Danish Universities under the Danish Ministry of Science, Technology and Innovation.

The application must be in English and include a curriculum vitae, degree certificate, a complete list of publications, a statement of future research plans and information about research activities, teaching portfolio and verified information on previous teaching experience (if any). Guidelines for applicants can be found here.

Appointment shall be in accordance with the collective labour agreement between the Danish Ministry of Taxation and the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations. Further information on qualification requirements and job content may be found in the Memorandum on Job Structure for Academic Staff at Danish Universities.

Salary and terms as agreed between the Danish Ministry of Taxation and the Confederation of Professional Unions at basic salary steps 4-8.

Aarhus University’s ambition is to be an attractive and inspiring workplace for all and to foster a culture in which each individual has opportunities to thrive, achieve and develop. We view equality and diversity as assets, and we welcome all applicants.

Research activities will be evaluated in relation to actual research time. Thus, we encourage applicants to specify periods of leave without research activities, in order to be able to subtract these periods from the span of the scientific career during the evaluation of scientific productivity.

Aarhus University offers a broad variety of services for international researchers and accompanying families, including relocation service and career counselling to expat partners. Read more here. Please find more information about entering and working in Denmark here.

Aarhus University also offers a Junior Researcher Development Programme targeted at career development for postdocs at AU. You can read more about it here.

The application must be submitted via Aarhus University’s recruitment system, which can be accessed under the job advertisement on Aarhus University's website.

Declaration of interest regarding PhD project in renal calcium transport
jobs.description:
Declaration of interest regarding PhD project in renal calcium transport

 

The laboratory of Henrik Dimke, Cardiovascular and Renal Research Unit at the Department of Molecular Medicine, University of Southern Denmark is seeking a highly motivated PhD student in the field of renal transport physiology. Particular emphasis will be placed on signalling through the calcium-sensing receptor and the regulation of renal calcium transport in transgenic models.

 

Research environment

The PhD student will join the laboratory of Professor Henrik Dimke in the Cardiovascular and Renal Research Unit. The laboratory studies epithelial ion transport and the mechanisms that maintain calcium, magnesium, and phosphate balance, with particular emphasis on renal calcium transport, the calcium-sensing receptor, claudins, and kidney stone disease. The Research Unit focuses on innovative molecular and biomedical research related to cardiovascular and renal physiology. We offer a stimulating, international research environment where English is the preferred language at meetings and seminars. You will work in the modern NytSUND building, which is directly connected to the new Odense University Hospital and provides state-of-the-art laboratory and animal facilities. You can read more about the department and institute here.

 

Project description

The project will investigate how altered calcium-sensing receptor (CASR) signalling disrupts the endocrine and renal control of calcium homeostasis. Particular attention will be given to autosomal dominant hypocalcaemia type 1, in which excessive CASR activity suppresses parathyroid hormone secretion and promotes renal calcium loss. The project will examine the signalling mechanisms linking CASR activation to renal calcium transport and whole-body calcium balance. The successful applicant will use clinically relevant genetic models, including inducible and cell-specific transgenic approaches, together with detailed physiological characterization, molecular and biochemical techniques, and imaging.

 

Qualifications

Qualified and highly motivated candidates from all nationalities are encouraged to apply. 

 

The successful applicant must have

  • A Master's degree (Danish: kandidatgrad) or another relevant degree that concludes a research-based study programme of minimum five years’ duration at an institution of higher education. If you do not have a Master's degree, the Graduate School will make an individual assessment of your academic qualifications.

  • Good oral and written English language skills

  • you must at the time of submission have documented research experience. E.g. be the author or co-author of an article in a peer-reviewed international journal (must at least be submitted) or of a published abstract from an international scientific conference, or have worked as research assistant full time for at least 6 months (after completing your masters degree). The research experience of each applicant is individually assessed by the Graduate School.

 

The successful applicant should have

  • The ability to work independently and in a structured manner. 

  • Good collaborative and interpersonal skills. 

  • Previous experience with experimental animal work or relevant molecular and biochemical techniques, such as western blotting or immunohistochemistry, is preferred but not required.

 

For further information about the project, please contact:

Professor Henrik Dimke

Department of Molecular Medicine

University of Southern Denmark (SDU)

Tel. +45 65 50 83 10 E-mail: hdimke@health.sdu.dk


Applications must include:

• A letter stating the interest, motivation and qualifications for the project (max. 2 pages) - upload under “Application form”.
• Detailed CV, including personal contact information
• Certified copy of diploma (Master’s degree in a relevant field)

• • Contact details for at least one professional reference who may be contacted during the assessment process.


Shortlisting may be used in the assessment process. References will normally be contacted only for shortlisted candidates.

Further information about the PhD-program can be found at the homepage of the University.


Applications must be submitted electronically using the link "Apply now". Attached files must be in Adobe PDF format. We strongly recommend that you read How to apply for a position at SDU before you apply.

Incomplete applications and applications received after the deadline will neither be considered nor evaluated. 

 

Closing date: October 12th, 2026


Successful candidates will be asked to send an application to the PhD Secretariat, Faculty of Health Sciences, to be enrolled as PhD students.

 

The PhD programme will be carried out in accordance with Faculty regulations and the Danish Ministerial Order on the PhD Programme at the Universities (PhD order).

 

Salary and Working Conditions at SDU

PhD students employed at SDU are employed as PhD fellows according to the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations in public employment (AC) agreement.


Salary and any salary supplement are paid according to your seniority level and as negotiated with your union representative. The base salary (excluding 18.07% pension contribution) is DKK 374,912.98.

 

The Faculty of Health Sciences at the University of Southern Denmark is one of Denmark’s leading faculties of health sciences. With nine departments, internationally top‑class research, and a broad range of health‑related study programmes, we contribute to developing the knowledge, treatments, and healthcare system of the future.

 

As an employee at the faculty, you become part of an ambitious and interdisciplinary environment characterised by high academic standards, strong collaborations, and excellent opportunities for professional development. The faculty has activities in Odense, Esbjerg, and Copenhagen. In Esbjerg and Copenhagen, strong academic communities provide the framework for research and education, while our modern faculty building in Odense brings research, education, and administration together under one roof and is directly connected to Odense University Hospital.

The University wishes our staff to reflect the diversity of society and thus welcomes applications from all qualified candidates regardless of personal background.

What you'll be doing: Running daily kitchen operations at Baggot Street Training new kitchen staff and developing existing team members Holding the team to FEEKA's recipe, hygiene, and presentation standards Managing prep planning, stock levels, and waste against targets Working alongside the Citywest head chef to keep both kitchens aligned Ensuring full compliance with FSAI food safety and allergen requirements Feeding back to the management team on what's working and what could be better Developing new dishes What we're looking for 5 years Proven experience leading a kitchen or kitchen section in a fast-paced environment Experience training and developing kitchen staff Strong organisational skills — prep planning, stock control, daily routines Commitment to hygiene standards and food safety (HACCP knowledge a plus) A calm, positive presence under pressure Reliable, punctual, and consistent Healthy food experience is a bonus but not essential What you get Monday–Friday, daytime only — no evenings, no weekends, no split shifts 20 days paid annual leave plus public holidays Pension auto-enrolment from day one Free lunch, coffee, and staff discount across both stores Career progression as we grow — we promote from within where we can A team that genuinely enjoys coming to work For more about us: www.feeka.ie | Instagram @feeka.ie

jobs.title: 2 Mekanikere/montører søges til spændende automotive virksomhed i Horsens N, Gedved
jobs.description:
RENTEQ Automotive søger efter praktiske og dygtige mekanikere/montører, der kan tage hånd om den mekaniske/eltekniske montage på vores fabrik i Gedved, og som har det rette mindset til at arbejde i en produktion, hvor processerne løbende optimeres.

Om RENTEQ Automotive

RENTEQ Automotive er en ung dansk virksomhed med en ambition om at reducere CO₂-udledningen ved at elektrificere varebiler og entreprenørmaskiner og opbygge batteritrailere. Vi har udvikling i Dragør og produktion på vores fabrik i Gedved, og vi tager hele rejsen på os – fra ingeniørarbejde og udvikling helt frem til serieproduktion.

Jobbet

Som mekaniker/montør hos os arbejder du med den praktiske montage på produktionslinjen – primært opbygning af vores Vanteq, på sigt også entreprenørmaskiner og vores batteritrailer.

Produktionen er stadig ung, så der er masser af plads til at forbedre den. Du arbejder tæt sammen med ingeniør- og produktionsteamet, bidrager til problemløsning tidligt og hjælper os med at bygge klogere fra gang til gang. Du er med til at sikre, at hver eneste komponent behandles korrekt og dokumenteres præcist, idet dit arbejde er fundamentet for hele konverteringsprojektet.

Dine typiske opgaver vil være:

●      Montage af Vanteq på produktionslinjen – efter fastlagte arbejdsinstruktioner

●      Montering af elektriske komponenter, kabelføring og drivline i chassis og karosseri

●      Tilpasning og fejlfinding på komponenter i tæt samarbejde med elektronik- og software-teamet

●      Kvalitetskontrol og dokumentation af alle monteringssteps og fund undervejs i produktionen

●      Løbende forbedring af proces og arbejdsgange – du kan bidrage til de guider og checklister, vi udvikler

●      Primært arbejde med Vanteq – og også entreprenørmaskiner kommer nok også ind i Gedved

●      Sammen holder vi altid produktionen organiseret, udstyr vedligeholdt og processer dokumenteret for at sikre den højest mulige kvalitet.

Er det dig?

Vi leder efter en person med solid praktisk erfaring og en tilgang, der kombinerer præcision med fleksibilitet. Vigtigst er, at du kan arbejde selvstændigt, men også er dygtig til at samarbejde i et team, der hele tiden lærer og udvikler sig. Det vil være en fordel, hvis du kan nikke ja til nedenstående:

●      Erfaring med montering og demontering af motor, hydrauliksystem og brændstofkomponenter på landbrugsmaskiner, entreprenørmaskiner eller varebiler

●      Solidt kendskab til mekaniske systemer, væskesystemer og elektriske grundelementer

●      Ideelt set en stærk interesse for elektrificering

●      AC-kursus eller tilsvarende (ikke obligatorisk, men en stor fordel)

●      Evnen til at arbejde struktureret og dokumentere dit arbejde

●      Selvstændighed og ansvar, men også åbenhed over for feedback og samarbejde

●      Tålmodighed og en positiv tilgang til arbejde i et udviklingsmiljø, hvor vi hele tiden forfiner processen

●      Dansk på højt niveau; fungerende engelsk er en fordel, da vi er et internationalt team.

Vi tilbyder

●      En central rolle i vores produktionsteam, hvor din praktiske viden sætter direkte aftryk på, hvordan vi konverterer maskiner

●      Mulighed for at påvirke og udforme arbejdsprocesserne – dine idéer og erfaringer bliver hørt

●      En fast rytme i produktionen med arbejde på Vanteq og på sigt flere maskintyper

●      Tæt samarbejde med dygtige ingeniører og et uformelt, kollegialt team

●      Ordentlige faciliteter, godt værktøj og en støttende arbejdskultur

●      Løn: 190-240 kr./t afhængig af kompetencer og erfaring

●      Reelle muligheder for at vokse fagligt og personligt i takt med, at virksomheden udvikler sig.

Sådan søger du

Send dit CV og et par linjer om dig selv og din erfaring til simon@ren-teq.com. Vi behandler ansøgninger løbende og inviterer relevante kandidater til en uformel første samtale – så vent ikke for længe med at tage kontakt.

Har du spørgsmål til stillingen, er du meget velkommen til at kontakte Simon på simon@ren-teq.com eller på 21942143
