jobs.title: PhD CANDIDATE IN SOCIAL CRITERIA DRIVEN ABSOLUTE ENVIRONMENTAL.... (m/f)
jobs.employer: Luxembourg Institute of Science and Technology - LIST
jobs.description:
Fixed term contract | Belvaux | 48 months

Are you passionate about research? So are we! Come and join us

The Luxembourg Institute of Science and Technology (LIST) is a leading Research and Technology Organisation (RTO) that drives innovation for the economy and society in Luxembourg and beyond. With cutting-edge expertise in Natural, Built, Industrial environments, Space, AI, Security and defence technologies. LIST bridges scientific excellence and applied research to design solutions that address real-world challenges and create positive impact.

The Environmental Sustainability Assessment and Circularity (SUSTAIN) Unit conducts cross disciplinary research to support the transition toward a more sustainable, resilient, and healthy society. SUSTAIN combines expertise in environmental sciences, circular economy, risk and safety assessment, and sustainable innovation to address complex challenges related to human and environmental health, climate change, and resource efficiency, developing knowledge, methods, and transferable software for the simulation and comprehensive sustainability assessment of socio-economic systems. Its purpose is to foster sustainable eco-innovation, through products and technologies, as well as support sustainability-oriented policy implementation and behavioural change to promote decarbonisation transitions.

Do you want to know more about LIST? Check our website: https://www.list.lu/

How will you contribute?

The world faces a convergence of crises that are transforming the conditions for human development. Climate instability, ecosystem degradation, and the overuse of natural resources have reached critical levels, while social inequality, political fragmentation, and technological disruption are reshaping societies. Traditional notions of economic competitiveness, centred on growth and productivity, are being redefined to include social resilience, inclusiveness, and ecological integrity. Responding to this “polycrisis” requires new pathways that reconcile prosperity with planetary and social limits. Luxembourg offers a particularly illustrative example of these tensions. The country enjoys one of the highest income levels globally and a dynamic financial and business environment that sustains its reputation for economic success. Yet this prosperity depends strongly on cross-border commuting, which creates mobility challenges and environmental stress. Escalating housing prices have made access to affordable living increasingly difficult, displacing a significant share of the workforce beyond national borders. The reliance on imported energy leaves households and firms vulnerable to external shocks. Although Luxembourg's welfare model and social dialogue remain robust, they are under pressure from rising costs of living, widening inequalities, and growing demands on public services. Environmentally, Luxembourg's footprint per inhabitant ranks among the largest worldwide, driven by high consumption and land-use pressures that push the country beyond sustainable limits.

Meeting these intertwined challenges calls for coordinated transformations that bridge sectors, disciplines, and scales. Economic and social progress must be reframed within the concept of a Safe Operating Space—an area in which human well-being is achieved without breaching environmental boundaries. The objective is to steer innovation, governance, and everyday practices toward forms of competitiveness that are compatible with sustainability, rather than in conflict with it. The Doctoral Training Unit C-SOS (Competitiveness within a Safe Operating Space) is designed to cultivate researchers capable of analysing and fostering such transformations. It brings together an interdisciplinary consortium to train 12 PhD candidates in the assessment and design of inclusive and sustainable development trajectories. The programme equips them with conceptual and methodological tools to connect environmental sustainability, social well-being, and economic dynamics into integrated frameworks for decision-making. Its ambition is to inform socio-economic policies, encourage responsible industrial and technological innovation, and contribute to more equitable and resilient societies. Luxembourg provides an ideal environment for this initiative, combining strong expertise in sustainability science and policy analysis. The DTU is a collaboration between researchers at the Luxembourg Institute of Science and Technology (LIST), the University of Luxembourg (UL) and the Urban Development and Mobility Department at the Luxembourg Institute of Socio-Economic Research (LISER). The consortium also includes the National Statistics Office (STATEC). In this DTU, 12 scientists will train 12 PhD students over six years (from January 2027), each obtaining a PhD from UL's doctoral schools.

As part of the C-SOS Doctoral Training Unit, in this PhD you will integrate concepts from Post-Growth, Sufficiency and Doughnut Economics into the downscaling of planetary boundaries, leveraging good examples of application to territories and cities. Possible research questions include: how to couple ecological limits and social foundation as an interdependent system? How to define social foundation? How to allocate the carrying capacity based on social foundation?.

You will be embedded in the SUSTAIN unit at LIST and enrolled as a doctoral candidate at the University of Luxembourg. You will work closely with a diverse cohort of 12 PhD researchers across the social, economic, and environmental sciences, contributing to a shared research agenda on how Luxembourg can thrive within its fair share of planetary limits

You will be mainly in charge of:
• Conducting a systematic review and critical assessment of existing carrying capacity allocation and planetary boundary downscaling approaches, spanning economic and emission based allocation methods, sufficiency based approaches, and Doughnut Economics frameworks
• Developing a methodological framework for coupling ecological limits and social foundation as an interdependent system, integrating Post-Growth, Sufficiency, and Doughnut Economics concepts into the downscaling of planetary boundaries
• Applying the framework to Luxembourg and comparable small territories under a range of allocation scenarios, drawing on Green Deal technology targets, context specific Decent Living Standards, and provisioning systems, producing environmental ceiling estimates grounded in social foundation thresholds
• Building and maintaining a dynamic system model enabling the testing of individual and combined allocation approaches, valuing social outcome generation per unit of environmental impact across relevant planetary boundary dimensions
• Collaborating with other C-SOS doctoral researchers, in particular those working on social foundation, Quality of Life, and economic systems, to ensure that allocation approaches rest on socially realistic and empirically coherent definitions of social foundation
• Publishing results in peer reviewed journals and presenting at international conferences
• Contributing to C-SOS training activities, workshops, and stakeholder engagement events
Is Your profile described below? Are you our future colleague? Apply now!

Education

jobs.title: RESEARCHER IN FIRST-PRINCIPLES MODELLING OF MULTIFERROIC MATERIALS (m/f)
jobs.employer: Luxembourg Institute of Science and Technology - LIST

Are you passionate about research? So are we! Come and join us

The Luxembourg Institute of Science and Technology (LIST) is a leading Research and Technology Organisation (RTO) that drives innovation for the economy and society in Luxembourg and beyond. With cutting-edge expertise in Natural, Built, Industrial environments, Space, AI, Security and defence technologies. LIST bridges scientific excellence and applied research to design solutions that address real-world challenges and create positive impact.

Do you want to know more about LIST? Check our website: https://www.list.lu/

How will you contribute?

The push to reduce global energy consumption has set a clear trend in modern technology towards devices that are smaller, faster and more energy-efficient. Meeting these demands calls for new materials that can perform several functions at once. Magnetoelectric multiferroics are especially attractive in this respect, because they combine magnetism and ferroelectricity in a single phase. Crucially, this opens the possibility of controlling magnetism with an electric field which could enable entirely new device architectures and transform modern computing and data storage. Despite decades of progress, this promise is hard to realise: in most known multiferroics the two orders only coexist well below room temperature, and many are difficult to integrate with standard semiconductor manufacturing. Turning multiferroics into a practical technology therefore requires identifying or designing new materials that show robust, coupled magnetism and ferroelectricity at room temperature and remain compatible with established fabrication processes.

This is the challenge at the heart of the SMART project funded by the FNR CORE programme and led by Natalya Fedorova. We offer a 2-year postdoc position in which you will use first-principles calculations (DFT) together with analytical modelling to design room-temperature multiferroics via doping of semiconductors. Working mainly with DFT, you will carry out a systematic analysis of electronic, structural, magnetic and ferroelectric properties of these materials - computing, for instance, ground-state magnetic configurations, magnetic exchange interactions, electric polarization and polarization-switching pathways. You will then combine these results with analytical models to describe the magnetoelectric coupling in the most promising candidates and to explore how their magnetism could be manipulated with an applied electric field.

You will join the Modelling of Functional Materials group led by Jorge Íñiguez-González (also involved in the project) and will benefit from interactions with other team members.

How will you contribute?
You'll be working on a production-grade Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) system purpose-built for second-level controls on NAV computation in investment funds. The system must retrieve relevant regulatory methodology, replicate calculation steps, detect discrepancies against fund accounting outputs, and produce control reports that are traceable, auditable, and defensible under regulatory scrutiny.
You will contribute to a system where precision, explainability, and reliability are non-negotiable.

Code Development (60%):
·          Build retrieval pipelines optimised for structured regulatory methodology documents (CSSF circulars, ESMA guidelines, fund prospectuses), with adaptive weighting to surface the specific calculation rules relevant to each control query
·          Implement numerical validation pipelines that compare LLM-derived NAV calculation outputs against fund administrator figures, applying configurable tolerance bands and discrepancy flagging logic
·          Implement chunking strategies optimised for fund accounting reports and regulatory circulars, preserving the structure of calculation tables, formula references, and numbered regulatory provisions.
·          Build evaluation frameworks measuring control accuracy (error detection rate, false positive/negative rates on flagged discrepancies) and the quality of generated audit reports
·          Optimise vector database indexing for regulatory document corpora with high update frequency, ensuring fast retrieval as new CSSF/ESMA guidance is published

Research & experimentation (25%):
·          Benchmark embedding models against the current Nomic Embed Text baseline, with a focus on sensitivity to numerical and regulatory language in fund accounting contexts
·          Explore cross-lingual retrieval for EU regulatory documents published across multiple languages, with emphasis on French and German variants of CSSF and ESMA guidance
·          Research agent-based simulation of NAV calculation steps, investigating how LLMs can reason reliably over arithmetic-sensitive regulatory workflows and signal confidence levels
·          Experiment with multi-agent orchestration for second-level control workflows, where agents decompose a NAV control task into parallel verification sub-tasks across pricing, accruals, and corporate actions.

System integration (15%):
·          Integrate LLM backends optimised for structured reasoning and develop prompt engineering patterns that enforce step-by-step calculation verification and explainable output
·          Implement comprehensive logging, structured audit trail generation, and monitoring dashboards that allow compliance officers to review and challenge control decisions

Temporary contract | 14+22(+12) months | Belval

Are you passionate about research? So are we! Come and join us
The Luxembourg Institute of Science and Technology (LIST) is a Research and Technology Organization (RTO) active in the fields of materials, environment and IT. By transforming scientific knowledge into technologies, smart data and tools, LIST empowers citizens in their choices, public authorities in their decisions and businesses in their strategies.
Do you want to know more about LIST? Check our website: https://www.list.lu/

How will you contribute?
You will be part of the LIST Materials Research and Technology department, where you will carry out your work in the Quantum Materials Group, led by Dr. Florian Kaiser.
Quantum technologies have the potential to revolutionise the world in many aspects. Quantum colour centres in in wide bandgap semiconductors have recently emerged as a promising platform, since they can incorporate quantum systems, which can be scaled up by industrial processing. Along these lines, we have recently shown that individual colour centres can be integrated into silicon carbide nanophotonic waveguides with little-to-no degradation of spin-optical coherences. These finding define the strategy for developing a scalable quantum technology architecture.
Our strategy is to use multiplexed and integrated colour centres for quantum communication tasks. Key here is to generate entanglement between colour centres based on spin-photon entanglement, as well as Hong-Ou-Mandel interference. With this milestone demonstration, we strive to kickstart subsequent developments towards a quantum internet architecture.

The objective of this PhD thesis is to support our work towards optical interference between colour centres, i.e., Hong-Ou-Mandel interference. The initial part of this thesis comprises setting up our new optical cryostat platform, which is based on a combination of standard confocal microscopy, and interferometry. In the second step, you will benefit from our ongoing activities towards quantum photonic silicon carbide chips in which we generate colour centres in fibre-coupled waveguides.
You will determine the ideal pulsed excitation schemes for colour centres, considering spectral, temporal and polarization filtering. Subsequently, you will characterise the photon quality depending on experimental parameters, and implement initial two-photon inteference experiments outside of the cryostat, followed by a fully-on-chip demonstration inside the cryostat. If time permits, this project can be further extended to the generation of entanglement between two colour centre chips located in two different cryostats.

As such, the selected candidate will have (i), to fabricate and characterize solid state microbatterie(s) (ii), explore how to promote their optimal charging when they are powered by an energy harvester, (iii) work on the integration of such devices in a model tire.
More precisely, together with the teams of LIST scientists in the field of materials dry synthesis, microfabrication or microelectronics, the candidate will be involved in the experimental/operational fabrication of the materials needed for the realization of microbatteries, the control of their internal interfaces, their integration for the realization of the microdevices, as well as their structural/chemical characterizations and electrochemical performances determination (ionic conductivity measurement, areal capacity determinations in liquid or solid electrolyte, rate capacity, etc.). He will additionally have to work on the final protection of the fabricated Li-ion microbatteries. The candidate will be located at LIST (Belvaux) and will have regular contacts with the company.

·        Good experience with structural and chemical characterizations using state-of-the art techniques (SEM, DRX, XPS, etc.)

Le poste s'adresse à une personne autonome, organisée, à l'aise avec la clientèle et disposant de bonnes connaissances techniques dans le domaine de la mécanique du bâtiment.

Une expérience ou des connaissances dans l'un des domaines suivants constituent un réel avantage : plomberie, chauffage, HVAC, sanitaire, pompage, filtration ou équipements techniques du bâtiment.

Nous recherchons une personne souhaitant s'impliquer durablement dans le développement de notre activité au Luxembourg.

jobs.title: Directeur/trice d'Agence de Promotion Immobilière (m/f)
jobs.description:
Description:

Notre client est un acteur reconnu de la promotion immobilière au Luxembourg, adossé à un groupe européen de référence dans les domaines de la construction et du développement immobilier. Dans le cadre de son développement, nous recrutons son/sa futur(e) Directeur/trice d'Agence de Promotion Immobilière pour piloter l'activité luxembourgeoise.
S'appuyant sur un portefeuille de projets résidentiels et tertiaires déjà sécurisé pour les prochaines années, vous prendrez la responsabilité du développement de l'activité, du pilotage des opérations et du management des équipes, avec une large autonomie et le soutien d'un groupe solide.

Vos responsabilités

En tant que Directeur/trice d'une Agence de Promotion Immobilière, vous assurez le pilotage global de l'entité, tant sur les aspects stratégiques qu'opérationnels.

Développement de l'activité

• Définir et mettre en œuvre la stratégie de développement de l'activité au Luxembourg.
• Identifier de nouvelles opportunités et développer un réseau de partenaires (investisseurs, propriétaires, architectes, bureaux d'études, collectivités, clients...).
• Contribuer au développement commercial et à la commercialisation des opérations.
• Représenter l'entreprise auprès des principaux acteurs du marché immobilier luxembourgeois.

Pilotage des opérations

• Superviser les projets immobiliers, de la faisabilité jusqu'à la livraison.
• Garantir le respect des objectifs de qualité, de délais, de coûts et de rentabilité.
• Piloter les procédures administratives et réglementaires propres au Luxembourg (PAP, autorisations de construire, etc.).
• Coordonner les équipes internes et les partenaires externes afin d'assurer le bon déroulement des opérations.

Gestion de l'activité

• Piloter l'entité comme un véritable centre de profit.
• Assurer le suivi financier des opérations, analyser les montages et accompagner les décisions d'investissement.
• Assurer un reporting régulier auprès de la Direction Générale.

Management

• Manager et accompagner une équipe d'une petite dizaine de collaborateurs (Responsables de Projets, spécialistes techniques et fonctions administratives).
• Coordonner les intervenants externes (architectes, bureaux d'études, bureaux de contrôle et autres partenaires).
• Fédérer les équipes autour d'objectifs communs et accompagner le développement de l'activité.

Votre profil

Vous évoluez depuis plusieurs années dans le secteur immobilier luxembourgeois et disposez d'une solide compréhension des enjeux liés à la promotion immobilière. Votre parcours vous a permis d'acquérir une vision globale d'une opération immobilière, que ce soit au sein d'un promoteur immobilier ou à travers des fonctions de pilotage de projets complexes dans le secteur de la construction ou du développement immobilier.

Vous maîtrisez notamment:

• L'ensemble du processus de promotion immobilière, de l'acquisition foncière à la livraison des opérations.
• Les montages financiers et le pilotage économique de projets immobiliers.
• La gestion d'un centre de profit ou d'une activité disposant d'objectifs financiers.
• Les procédures administratives luxembourgeoises, notamment les PAP, les autorisations de construire et les relations avec les administrations.
• La commercialisation de programmes immobiliers et la relation avec les différents partenaires du projet.

Au-delà de vos compétences techniques, vous êtes reconnu pour votre leadership, votre capacité à fédérer les équipes, à prendre des décisions et à faire avancer les projets. Vous appréciez évoluer dans un environnement entrepreneurial où autonomie, vision stratégique et pragmatisme sont essentiels.
Le français et l'anglais sont indispensables. La maîtrise du luxembourgeois constitue un atout.

Pour plus d'information, merci de contacter Nicolas Hurlin au +352 26 29 45.

Projektant suradnik sudjeluje u izradi arhitektonskih projekata kroz različite faze projektiranja, u suradnji s glavnim projektantom i ostalim članovima projektnog tima.

Glavne odgovornosti uključuju:

  • sudjelovanje u izradi idejnih, glavnih i izvedbenih projekata

  • izradu i razradu arhitektonske projektne dokumentacije

  • izradu tehničkih nacrta, detalja i grafičkih priloga

  • sudjelovanje u razvoju projektnih rješenja

  • usklađivanje projektne dokumentacije s ostalim strukama

  • pripremu dokumentacije za ishođenje potrebnih dozvola i suglasnosti

  • komunikaciju i koordinaciju s kolegama, suradnicima i ostalim sudionicima u projektu

  • praćenje projekta i izvršavanje zadataka prema dogovorenim rokovima

  • sudjelovanje u obilascima lokacija i gradilišta prema potrebi

Uvjeti i očekivanja

Od kandidata očekujemo:

  • završeno odgovarajuće obrazovanje iz područja arhitekture, graditeljstva ili srodnog tehničkog područja

  • poznavanje rada u relevantnim programima za projektiranje i izradu tehničke dokumentacije

  • preciznost, odgovornost i organiziranost

  • sposobnost timskog rada i kvalitetne komunikacije

  • samostalnost u izvršavanju povjerenih zadataka u skladu s razinom iskustva

  • spremnost na učenje i profesionalni razvoj

Radno iskustvo na sličnim poslovima je prednost, ali razmotrit ćemo i kandidate s manje iskustva koji pokazuju znanje, motivaciju i želju za učenjem.

Mjesto i način rada

Rad se obavlja na licu mjesta, u prostorijama projektantskog ureda.

Tražimo osobu koja će biti svakodnevno prisutna u uredu i aktivno sudjelovati u radu projektnog tima. Ovo radno mjesto nije predviđeno za rad na daljinu (remote) niti isključivo online suradnju.

Što nudimo

  • rad na raznovrsnim arhitektonskim i projektantskim zadacima

  • rad u profesionalnom i suradničkom okruženju

  • mogućnost učenja i razvoja stručnih znanja

  • sudjelovanje u svim fazama razvoja projekta

  • stabilnu i dugoročnu suradnju

  • mogućnost profesionalnog napredovanja u skladu sa znanjem, iskustvom i rezultatima

Ako ste zainteresirani za rad u projektantskom uredu i želite biti dio tima koji zajednički razvija i realizira projekte, pozivamo vas da nam pošaljete svoj životopis i, ako je primjenjivo, portfolio dosadašnjih rad

jobs.title: Mystery Shopper in Latvia
jobs.description:
Mystery Shopper in Latvia

Work tasks: WHAT OUR MYSTERY SHOPPERS DO
Mystery shoppers do not need to be customer service experts, as their personal opinion is not the deciding factor. However, they must be able to assess customer interactions and the service process objectively. We measure how closely employees’ customer service aligns with their company’s service standards and expectations, enabling businesses to identify development needs and provide targeted training. At the same time, we are confident that our mystery shoppers gradually become customer service professionals themselves. We believe this experience increases their value in the job market, especially in customer-facing roles, as we continuously train and guide our mystery shoppers. Our mystery shoppers are welcome to include “Trendline Mystery Shopper” on their CV. For many employers, this demonstrates a solid understanding of customer service processes. WHAT A TRENDLINE MYSTERY SHOPPER DOES NOT DO Trendline mystery shoppers do not provoke or deliberately challenge employees with difficult or misleading questions. Our mystery shoppers visit service providers, banks, retail stores, and sales organizations. The objective is for the mystery shopper to behave like an ordinary customer. This means they do not ask unusual questions that a typical customer would not ask and do not attempt to provoke employees in any way. Mystery shopping visits are conducted according to scenarios provided by Trendline. After each visit, the mystery shopper submits a detailed report through the Trendline online platform.

We offer: https://trendline.lt
Over 25 years of experience in developing customer service and sales organizations. We operate in Estonia, Latvia, and Lithuania. Our services include: mystery shopping, training, customer satisfaction surveys and feedback questionnaires, development of customer service standards, production of training videos, and internal audit tools for managers. We provide our clients with a comprehensive solution—from defining customer service standards and principles to employee training and measuring implementation and performance.

Other requirements: WHAT QUALITIES WE LOOK FOR A mystery shopper should be responsible, friendly, honest,
reliable, and willing to follow instructions carefully while maintaining a professional approach. Before applying for assignments, our mystery shoppers can review the available projects, including the scenario, evaluation questionnaire, job description, and compensation. Once an assignment is confirmed, they are free to complete the mystery shopping visit at any convenient time within the specified timeframe. After completing the visit, the mystery shopper submits a concise evaluation report through the mystery shopper module of our online platform. Our mystery shoppers always have access to our dedicated Mystery Shopper Support Service, which provides ongoing assistance to help them complete assignments to a high standard. Upon request, we also offer additional training, as well as technical and practical support. With more than 25 years of experience in training and customer service development, Trendline knows how to focus on what matters most and provides high-quality training for all mystery shoppers.

Option to work from home: Yes

jobs.title: Senior Controller
jobs.description:
Senior Controller

Work tasks: As part of the global bioeconomy, Stora Enso is a leading provider of renewable products in the areas of packaging, biomaterials and wooden construction, as well as one of the world’s largest privately owned forest owners. We believe that everything that is produced today from materials based on fossil raw materials can be made from wood in the future.
Our company employs approximately 19,000 people. Our global Finance Operations unit handles accounting activities and provides financial services across a range of areas. In the world of finance, we value accuracy, collaboration and innovation. Career for a better climate. Every day. Your Responsibilities as a Senior Controller Act as a Finance Business Partner for a business area/business unit, legal entity or group function. Lead or support controlling and financial reporting processes for the entity/function within your area of responsibility. Be responsible for the effective and accurate period-end closing, analysis and reporting activities of the entity/function. Contribute to and support the implementation and management of an efficient and accurate forecasting and budgeting process within the entity/function. Represent the entity/function in queries related to other Finance Operations processes, including Record to Report (RtR), Purchase to Pay (PtP) and Order to Cash (OtC). Ensure the implementation and compliance with Stora Enso’s financial processes and policies within the entity/function. Proactively identify opportunities for improvement, make recommendations and lead changes to continuously improve and harmonise end-to-end controlling processes. Lead and support process automation and other development projects. Ensure close collaboration and effective information flow between the entity/function, the Finance department and key stakeholders across other functions. Support and train stakeholders on controlling-related topics. What We Expect from You A Master’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Business Administration or a related field. At least 3 years of relevant professional experience in controlling, management reporting or accounting. A good understanding of controlling processes, including period-end closing, operational financial reporting, budgeting, forecasting and management reporting. Good knowledge of controlling tools and analytics platforms, such as Excel, SAP, OneStream and Power BI. Experience in leading process improvement and harmonisation initiatives. A change-oriented mindset – you are willing to improve processes, develop new ways of working and promote standardisation. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with a high level of attention to detail and quality. The ability to work in a matrix organisation and in an international environment. Excellent communication skills and the ability to influence others and explain complex financial information to people who are not finance specialists. Very good command of English, both spoken and written.

We offer: By joining us, you will become part of an organisation with a diverse and inclusive work culture that supports you in discovering new perspectives and developing professionally.
You will contribute to a more sustainable world, as we believe that everything that is produced today from materials based on fossil raw materials can be made from wood in the future. To help you perform your work safely and feel well, we support both your physical and mental wellbeing. This is a permanent position with an open-ended employment contract. How to Apply You can submit your application to us only in English, using our recruitment system. We hope to receive your application as soon as possible, but no later than 24 September. If you have any questions, please contact our People and Culture representative, Alena Stesnerova, at alena.stesnerova[at]storaenso.com.

Option to work from home: Yes

jobs.title: Software Engineer, User Database Infrastructure
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.



Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.




ABOUT THE ROLE:

This role will be based in San Francisco. We work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays and Thursdays (our Anchor Days) because we do our best thinking and building together in person. We’re looking for someone who’s excited to work alongside the team during those days. 

You’ll build the systems that let any knowledge worker leverage fast, scalable databases without having to become a DBA.

You’ll be a hands-on technical leader, helping set the architectural direction and roadmap as we take a new product from early alpha to general availability. You’ll work directly with early customers to shape foundational technical and product decisions. Then, together, we’ll work on scaling as adoption and workloads grow.

This is a backend-leaning role with work spanning the stack. You might build the systems that provision and manage a fleet of customer Postgres instances, design how user-defined schemas evolve safely, or make complex queries execute efficiently. You’ll also follow those systems into the product: improving how a table loads, how users understand a slow operation, or how an agent safely works with their data.

You’ll help shape the architecture and the product together. Some problems call for a better abstraction, others for a better default, and others for rethinking what we ask the user to do in the first place. You’ll work with teammates and customers to find those answers, ship practical solutions, and evolve them as usage grows.



Our stack includes Postgres, Go, TypeScript, Node.js, and React.




ABOUT THE TEAM:

The people who understand a business best aren’t always the people who can build its software. A support lead knows how tickets should be triaged. An operations manager knows how inventory should move. But turning that knowledge into a reliable system often means finding an engineer, provisioning a database, and building an application.

We’re building database infrastructure for everyone else. We want everyday knowledge workers to bring their data into Notion, connect it, and build workflows around it. And do so with the power of a real database (Postgres!) and the approachability of a tool they already know.

AI agents make that opportunity even bigger: helping people build and operate systems they couldn’t have created on their own.

For our team, this is much more than putting a friendly interface on Postgres. It means making hard database problems disappear from the user’s workflow without sacrificing correctness, performance, or flexibility. How do you let someone reshape a live database as easily as editing a document? Make the right indexes exist without asking someone to become a DBA? Let a weekend experiment grow into a company’s system of record without anyone having to rearchitect it?




WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE:

 - Take a new product from alpha to general availability. Work with early customers to understand what matters, iterate on feedback, and help shape what we ship.

 - Make real customer workloads fast. Improve query execution, indexing, and client data loading so performance holds up as datasets grow and workflows become more demanding.

 - Build systems businesses can trust with their data. Make schema changes, concurrent writes, permissions, and recovery reliable enough for customers to build essential workflows on top.

 - Make powerful capabilities approachable. Turn database provisioning, migrations, and indexes into a reliable, easy-to-use product experience that gives people the power of a database without the burden of managing one.

 - Build for the customers who come next. Automate database provisioning and fleet operations, strengthen observability, and evolve the architecture so we can serve many, many customers.




SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING: 

 - Production relational database experience (e.g., Postgres or MySQL). You’ve made decisions about schemas and indexes, analyzed database performance, and debugged issues involving transactions, locking, or concurrency. Your experience goes beyond accessing a database through an ORM.

 - Engineering experience and technical leadership. You bring 10+ years of experience building and operating production software, with a track record of setting technical direction and leading complex, cross-team initiatives from concept through delivery. You identify the most important problems to solve, turn ambiguous goals into a technical strategy, and align engineers and partner teams around a practical plan. You stay hands-on while helping others make better decisions through design reviews, mentorship, and clear technical guidance.

 - Strong backend engineering fundamentals. You’ve built services that need to remain correct under concurrency and failure. You can reason about retries, partial failures, consistency, and the trade-offs involved in reliable reads and writes.

 - A systematic approach to performance. You use query plans, traces, profiles, and experiments to find bottlenecks and verify improvements. You’re willing to follow a problem across storage, services, and client code rather than stopping at a team boundary.

 - Product judgment. You’re interested in who will use what you build, not just how it works. You can turn a customer’s problem into a technical approach and recognize when a better default or simpler workflow would solve it more effectively.

 - Willingness to work across the stack. You bring backend depth, but you’re comfortable learning unfamiliar systems and working in client code when that’s what delivering a good experience requires.

 - Fluency with AI-assisted engineering. You use AI to accelerate exploration, implementation, and testing while taking responsibility for understanding and validating the result.




NICE TO HAVES:

 - Experience managing fleets of databases or building database platforms, including provisioning, upgrades, backups, and recovery.

 - Deep Postgres expertise, such as advanced query optimization, performance tuning, or workload isolation for large datasets and high-concurrency workloads.

 - Experience building query layers, sync engines, change-data-capture pipelines, permission systems, or other reusable data abstractions.
   
   

Notion is committed to providing highly competitive cash compensation, equity, and benefits. The compensation offered for this role will be based on multiple factors such as location, the role’s scope and complexity, and the candidate’s experience and expertise, and may vary from the range provided below. For roles based in San Francisco, the estimated base salary range for this role is $299,000 – $334,000 per year.

#LI-Onsite




A NOTE ON AI

You don’t need deep AI expertise for every role, but we do expect every Notino to be intellectually curious, drawn to tinkering and discovery, and excited to use AI as a real collaborator in their work. For some roles, AI fluency is a core requirement — when that’s the case, we'll say so explicitly in the qualifications. People who thrive here don’t treat AI as a novelty. They use it to think better, and make their work easier for others to build on.




EQUAL OPPORTUNITY & ACCOMMODATIONS

We hire talented people from a wide range of backgrounds. If you’re excited about this role but don’t meet every bullet, we still encourage you to apply. Notion is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of any legally protected characteristic. In this role, you’ll work hand-in-hand with leadership to identify, structure, and act on the most challenging strategic and operational questions impacting our business.



This role is based in San Francisco, CA. We work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays and Thursdays (our Anchor Days) because we do our best thinking and building together in person. We’re looking for someone who’s excited to work alongside the team during those days.

jobs.title: Bogholder til Skoda Nørresundby
jobs.description:
Bogholder til Škoda Nørresundby – få en central rolle i vores spændende hus

Er du skarp til tal, har du styr på detaljerne – og trives du med at have ansvar og overblik?

Så er det måske dig, vi leder efter som vores nye bogholder hos Škoda Nørresundby.

Vi søger en engageret og ansvarsbevidst kollega, som får en central rolle i vores økonomifunktion. Du bliver en vigtig del af den daglige drift og samtidig en tæt samarbejdspartner for ledelsen og kollegerne på tværs af forretningen.

EN ROLLE MED ANSVAR OG OVERBLIK

Som bogholder får du ansvar for en bred vifte af opgaver inden for økonomi og regnskab. Du kommer blandt andet til at arbejde med:

▪️ Daglig bogføring og finans ▪️ Kreditor- og debitorstyring ▪️ Bankafstemninger og betalinger ▪️ Momsafstemning og momsindberetning ▪️ Måneds- og årsafslutning ▪️ Løn og personaleadministration ▪️ Økonomiske rapporter og nøgletal ▪️ Afstemning af bilanlæg, lager og øvrige balanceposter ▪️ Kontakt til revisor ▪️ Løbende optimering og effektivisering af økonomiprocesserne

Du får en alsidig hverdag, hvor du både arbejder selvstændigt med dine egne ansvarsområder og har tæt kontakt til resten af organisationen.

ET LILLE HUS MED STORE AMBITIONER

Škoda Nørresundby er en mindre, men ambitiøs bilforretning, hvor vi kender hinanden og hjælper hinanden på tværs af afdelingerne.

Hos os er der kort fra idé til handling, og vi tror på, at de bedste resultater skabes sammen.

Det gælder også økonomien. Vi har brug for en kollega, som ikke bare ser tal og posteringer, men som har lyst til at forstå forretningen og være med til at skabe struktur, overblik og gode processer.

Vi har en uformel omgangstone, et stærkt kollegaskab og en hverdag, hvor der også er plads til humor.

HVEM ER DU?

Vi forestiller os, at du:

▪️ Har erfaring fra en lignende stilling som bogholder ▪️ Har en relevant økonomisk uddannelse ▪️ Arbejder struktureret og detaljeorienteret ▪️ Er fortrolig med Excel og økonomisystemer ▪️ Har forståelse for regnskab fra A-Z ▪️ Kan arbejde selvstændigt og tage ansvar ▪️ Er god til at samarbejde på tværs af organisationen ▪️ Har naturligt fokus på at skabe overblik og sikre, at tingene stemmer

HVAD FÅR DU HOS OS?

Du får en spændende og alsidig stilling i en forretning, hvor din indsats kan mærkes.

Vi tilbyder:

▪️ En central rolle med stort ansvar og indflydelse ▪️ Mulighed for at udvikle og præge økonomifunktionen ▪️ Dygtige og engagerede kolleger ▪️ En uformel hverdag med plads til humor og godt kollegaskab ▪️ Gode muligheder for faglig og personlig udvikling ▪️ Løn og ansættelsesvilkår efter kvalifikationer og erfaring

Stillingen er på mellem 30-37 timer og kan således tilpasses dine ønsker og behov.

LYDER DET SOM NOGET FOR DIG?

Hvis du kan se dig selv i rollen og har lyst til at blive en del af Škoda Nørresundby, vil vi meget gerne høre fra dig.

Send din ansøgning og CV til Torben Vinter: tovin@skoda-norresundby.dk

Alle henvendelser behandles naturligvis fortroligt.

Vi holder samtaler løbende og ansætter, når vi har fundet den rette kandidat.

Har du spørgsmål til stillingen eller hverdagen hos os, er du meget velkommen til at ringe til Torben på 40 30 61 89 og tage en uforpligtende snak.

jobs.title: Senior Independent Software Developer
jobs.description:
You must be located in the Americas, Europe, or Israel to apply.


A·Team is a VC-backed, stealth, application-only home on the internet for senior independent software builders to team up with hand-picked, high-growth companies on their next big thing. 

After talking with hundreds of independent engineers, designers, and product folks, we heard over and over that finding vetted, high-quality, consistent clients is hard, and projects are often too small to be rewarding. A·Team matches small teams of the most talented builders in the world with companies backed by a16z, YC, Softbank, General Catalyst, etc. on a contract basis for many of their most important initiatives. We quietly launched in May 2020, and have helped A·Teamers earn $85+ million since.

As part of A·Team, you can expect:

  • High-paying, meaningful missions with the most audacious companies sent your way; generally $90-$150+/hr, with vetted, fascinating clients doing work that matters. We're picky about who we partner with; new clients only come in via trusted referral. We've worked with Lyft, McGraw Hill, ClearCo, Pepsi, Walmart, the former CEO of Waze, the leading vaccine production software, several new unicorns we can't say here, and dozens of startups backed by a16z/YC/Softbank/Insight/Tiger/etc.
  • Work alongside friends old & new: our niche is small/diverse product teams, since clients with larger budgets and higher-impact work tell us they want teams, not individuals. Of course, we keep friends together whenever we can.
  • Full autonomy: say "no" to things that don't excite you. The most talented builders often juggle a few things at once, so there's never pressure to join an A·Team mission if you don't have the bandwidth. If we're no longer a fit, it's easy to leave or pause too. 
  • Small, curated, off-the-record gatherings: for conversations hard to have elsewhere. Long-term, we're creating micro-communities for the world's top builders to become friends around the things they care about.
  • Keep 100% of what you earn: if you charge $120/hr, you get $120/hr. A·Team makes money by charging a small, flat, transparent platform fee on top of your rate.

 

 

How to apply:

Go here: https://build.a.team/remotivereferral + mention Remotive. We respect your time so the application is short. We're also much more interested in seeing what you've made, and excited to chat more if there’s a fit.

What you’ll do:

  • Once part of A.Team, you’ll regularly be invited to impactful missions that match your interests. Find the right pick from early-stage incubations with world-class founders, to fast-growing super-funded companies, to old school non-tech incumbents looking to build as a tech giant would

  • Missions usually involve building an ambitious piece of software from 0 to 1 as part of a small 3-4 person team. 

  • You’ll be paid to scope it out, give the client options, guide strategy, and execute on the selected solution. Sometimes the client has a clear vision, sometimes not; which is why A.Team builders tend to be senior folks who can work together to find the right direction. 

Who A·Team is for:

  • Senior software developers who left large companies and high-growth startups to pursue their craft with autonomy.

  • Those who prefer consistent contract work over a full-time role, who want to create a variety of new products alongside other top-tier builders.

  • The majority of A.Teamers spend most of their time doing independent work, but a sizeable percentage are either employed full-time (but testing out client work), bootstrapping a side project, or looking for their next big thing

Who A·Team is not for:

  • People looking for small gigs

  • Folks looking to build simple wordpress/wix/squarespace-style websites

  • Those still early in their careers (<4 years) and recent university/bootcamp grads (at least not yet)

Our long-term vision:

A·Team is a new type of company for a new kind of independent software builder. We call them "unhirables": people who traditional companies couldn’t hire full-time even if they wanted to, but who want to do their most meaningful work with their favorite people in small, autonomous, distributed expert teams. 

To help us secure amazing missions, we raised $60 million+  from Insight Partenrs, Tiger Global, NFX, RocNation, along with the former CEO of Upwork, the founders of Fiverr and Lemonade, Apple's Global Head of Recruiting, YC Partner Aaron Harris, Wharton's Adam Grant, and Duke's Dan Ariely.

jobs.title: Indkøbsansvarlig
jobs.description:
Er du den, der kan sikre, at de rette materialer kommer i hus, og har du mod på en rolle med indkøb og teamansvar som omdrejningspunkt?


Stillingen ved Evapco Europe byder på et bredt ansvar i en veletableret, international vækstvirksomhed, hvor du kan forme din rolle og gøre en forskel.

¤Ansvarsområder

Som supply chain team lead hos Evapco Europe bliver du en vigtig del af indkøbsafdelingen i Aabybro. Du får ansvar for operationelt indkøb, primært ordrebaseret, samt teamledelsen af en shippingmedarbejder/indkøber og to lagermedarbejdere. Strategisk indkøb fylder ca. 30 % i jobbet. Du vil opleve et bredt samarbejde med både salg, produktion, lager og leverandører, og derfor er evnen til at kommunikere bredt en vigtig succesfaktor i jobbet. Virksomheden har ved årsskiftet konverteret til Business Central fra Axapta.

¤Dine arbejdsopgaver:

• Dagligt ordrebaseret indkøb af og kontraktforhandlinger på materialer og råvarer, særligt rustfrit stål, kobber m.m.
• Forecasting
• Logistik og ordretransport
• Dialog og koordinering med leverandører i bl.a. Danmark, Italien og Kina
• Kvartalsvise budget- og prisindekseringsmøder med ledelsen
• Daglig teamledelse samt årlige løn- og medarbejdersamtaler

Du vil i jobbet referere til den europæiske indkøbsdirektør, der er lokaliseret i Italien, og du vil samarbejde med dine kolleger i Belgien og Italien. Der vil være ca. 20 årlige rejsedage, primært i forbindelse med leverandørbesøg.

¤Din profil

Vi forestiller os, at du kommer med nogle års erfaring som indkøber, supply chain-ansvarlig eller lignende i en produktions- eller industrivirksomhed. Du trives med operationelt indkøb og synes, det vil være en spændende udfordring at motivere og lede et mindre team.
Som person ser vi gerne, at du er struktureret og selvstændig, og at du kan lide at skabe relationer til både dine leverandører og kolleger.
Koncernsproget er engelsk, så gode kundskaber i både skrift og tale er vigtigt.

¤Evapco tilbyder

Du bliver en del af en virksomhed med en flad struktur, hvor humøret er højt og samarbejdet godt blandt de 65 kolleger på tværs af afdelingerne. Udover dette vil du få løn efter kvalifikationer. Der vil være fokus på din trivsel og udvikling, og der er derfor mulighed for uddannelser og kurser.
Evapco har dansk kontor i Aabybro, nord for Aalborg. Du kan læse mere på: www.evapco.dk

¤Ansøgning


Vi søger en medarbejder, der kan starte hurtigst muligt, men vi venter gerne på den rette i forhold til opsigelsesperiode. Send gerne din ansøgning og dit CV. Hvis du har spørgsmål til stillingen, kan du kontakte seniorkonsulent Jesper Høgh på tlf. 92 92 16 38.
Denne rekruttering håndteres af Randstad, og alle henvendelser bedes rettet hertil.

¤Om Evapco Europe A/S
Evapco Europe er specialiseret inden for produktion og udvikling af specialdesignede varmevekslere til en lang række brancher inden for bl.a. energi-, fødevare- og industrisektoren. Evapco Europe har fabrikker i Italien, Belgien og Danmark og er en del af en større global organisation med hovedsæde i Taneytown, Maryland, USA. Evapco Europe blev grundlagt i 1992 som Flex Coil, blev i 2009 opkøbt af amerikanske Evapco og består i dag af samlet 3.000 dygtige kolleger. Man har vækstet støt de senere år, og det forventes at fortsætte i de kommende år.

¤Om Randstad
Hos Randstad hjælper vi mennesker og virksomheder med at udnytte deres fulde potentiale. Vi kombinerer viden med moderne teknologi for at skabe forandringer, der hjælper mennesker fremad. Vi kalder det Human Forward.
Randstad DK er en del af den internationale Randstad Group, som er verdens største udbyder af HR-løsninger. Med over 4.700 kontorer fordelt på 39 lande formidler vi hver dag arbejde til mere end 650.000 mennesker verden over.
I Danmark er vi blandt de førende vikar- og rekrutteringsbureauer med afdelinger i København, Aarhus, Aalborg og Kolding. En position, vi har opnået, fordi vi som eksperter på arbejdsmarkedet formår at matche kvalificerede kandidater med de rette jobmuligheder.

Kilsaran Paving and Walling requires multiple Electrician roles for their premises at Piercetown, Dunboyne, Meath, A86W820. The salary range starts from €36,605 (18.05/hr) to €54,000 (26.63/hr) based on a 39-hour week. Salary will increase proportionately if additional hours are required. Salary offered shall be based on relevant experience and qualifications. Job Description - Experienced, fully qualified Electrician required for the Paving & Walling production facilities in Dunboyne, Co. Meath. The role has full responsibility for routine maintenance, servicing and fault-finding on production plant equipment and machinery, ensuring efficient operation and adherence to health and safety standards. The successful candidate will work closely with fitters, liaise with contractors and suppliers, carry out electrical installations and breakdown repairs, and prioritise preventative maintenance to support a demanding production schedule. The role forms part of a high-performance manufacturing business supplying Irish and UK customers and includes expectations for compliance with company health and safety policies and reporting of hazards and incidents. Maintain all production machinery and electrical equipment in conjunction with on-site fitters; diagnose and repair electrical breakdowns promptly to minimise production downtime; assist with electrical installations and upgrades; liaise with external contractors and suppliers for specialised work or parts; implement and prioritise preventative maintenance programs to support production targets; lead by example on all health and safety matters, ensure compliance with company H&S policies and procedures, report hazards and incidents, and promote safe working practices across the site. KEY REQUIREMENTS Required Qualifications - Fully qualified Electrician (QQI Level 6) with a minimum of 5 years' relevant experience. Proven experience in industrial and domestic electrical installation techniques and maintenance of production machinery. Strong fault-finding and breakdown repair skills, experience working in a manufacturing/production environment preferred. Good communication skills to liaise with fitters, contractors and suppliers. Strong commitment to health and safety, ability to follow preventative maintenance schedules and to work with production teams to minimise downtime. Willingness to undertake further training and development as required.

Location: South Korea | Remote
Engagement: Freelance / Independent Contractor | Project-Based | Part-Time

About the Project

We are looking for English-speaking Image Quality Evaluators based in South Korea to support AI training and evaluation projects.

You will review images and assess their quality according to project guidelines, helping improve the accuracy and performance of AI systems.

You do not need to be Korean. We welcome applicants of any nationality who are currently living in South Korea, have lived there for several years, and are highly familiar with Korean culture, everyday life, and local context.

What You'll Do

  • Evaluate images based on quality standards and project guidelines.
  • Identify issues such as blur, poor lighting, noise, exposure, compression, and framing.
  • Evaluate visual content with awareness of South Korean cultural and local context.
  • Accurately describe and interpret images in English.
  • Maintain high accuracy, consistency, and productivity.
  • Flag unusual cases or data-quality issues to the project team.

Requirements

  • Currently residing in South Korea.
  • Legally authorized to work as an independent contractor in South Korea.
  • Have a South Korean bank account in your own name to receive payments.
  • Have lived in South Korea for several years and have strong familiarity with Korean culture and local context.
  • English: C1 level or above.
  • Strong attention to detail and ability to follow detailed guidelines.
  • Laptop/desktop and reliable internet connection.
  • Previous experience in AI, data annotation, transcription, QA, or content evaluation is a plus, but not required.

Nationality is not a requirement. Local knowledge and lived experience in South Korea are.



Please mention the word **FUTURESTIC** and tag RNTIuMTc2LjEzNy4yMTQ= when applying to show you read the job post completely (#RNTIuMTc2LjEzNy4yMTQ=). This is a beta feature to avoid spam applicants. Companies can search these words to find applicants that read this and see they're human.

jobs.title: Principal Product Manager
jobs.description:
DomainTools is looking for a Principal Product Manager to join its Product team. Data is the backbone of our products, and this role will be responsible for growing and refining the data products that drive our threat intelligence solutions, with API-first delivery and integration into UI, AI and third-party experiences and workflows. This is a strategic role for the company that has a high impact on the companyâs success, and has a great deal of visibility both inside and outside the company. The ideal candidate is a strong leader and successful product manager with a track record of delivering market-leading data products, with insights derived from direct customer interaction and big-data analysis. If you want to make a big impact in an established, growth-stage company, and if you love data product management, DomainTools is the place to be!

The product manager is expected to contribute to her/his team a solid knowledge of the various constraints of the business, and a prioritized assessment of the opportunities that the business can capitalize on. The product manager must also contribute to the product team a deep knowledge of our users and customers, and an understanding of the platforms that our customers use to engage with our products. Finally the product manager is expected to track industry trends and the competitive landscape as they pertain to their products.Â 

While each member of the product team may be accountable for a specific area, we look for product managers that understand that consistent innovation is the result of each member of the product team contributing their passion and their ideas.Â  The product manager must collaborate closely with engineering, marketing, sales and solutions engineering teams to deliver world-class solutions to market.

This job, as with the other roles on the product team, is an individual contributor role. You will need to be able to influence your teammates, colleagues, stakeholders, and key executives, through your use of data and logic.

Basic Qualifications:

  • Minimum 7 years in cybersecurity or data-related product management, delivering data-driven analytics and products
  • Deep knowledge of their business and its customers, understanding how data products are utilized by its users, and valued by buyers
  • Experience working with threat intelligence products, threat feeds, APIs, and related technologies
  • Experience interacting with customers who leverage data warehousing, data science, and Big Data technologies
  • Experience with integration of data products into third-party environments (both customer and partner ecosystems)
  • Experience working with Agile (kanban/scrum) development teams and processes
  • Excellent people skills, working with cross-functional teams across the organization to bring a solution from ideation to market
  • Excellent writing, communication, and presentation skills
  • US-based, with a willingness to accommodate core hours that overlap at least 9am-3pm US Pacific time

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience in cybersecurity investigations, threat defense, incident response, or related activities
  • Solid understanding of the cybersecurity market and modern security architectures
  • Familiarity with specific data domains used in cybersecurity, including DNS, IP, TLS/SSL certificates, web crawl, BGP, NetFlow data
  • Experience with real-time data collection, processing and delivery
  • Experience with large language models (LLMs) and agentic workflows
  • Experience with data products that leverage predictive analytics / machine learning (ML)
  • Experience with distributed systems and cloud computing

jobs.title: Contract Talent Acquisition Sourcer, Sales (AMER)
Procurement Lead Buyer (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
Description de tâches:


Find your purpose at KPMG Luxembourg:

Join a team of diverse and dedicated problem solvers, connected by a common cause: to turn insight into opportunity for clients and communities around the world. If you are eager to learn, are interested in growing rapidly and strive to make an impact in a diverse environment, you're in the right place at the right time.
Learn more about Careers at KPMG Luxembourg


We are looking for a Lead Buyer (m/f/d) for our Procurement team

As a Lead Buyer reporting to the Procurement Manager, you will play a key role in supporting and developing the procurement function at KPMG Luxembourg. You will be responsible for managing end-to-end sourcing and purchasing activities across your assigned procurement categories while working closely with internal stakeholders to understand business needs and deliver value through strategic procurement initiatives.

In this role, you will contribute to the development of purchasing strategies, supplier optimization initiatives and cost-saving opportunities. You will also ensure compliance with procurement policies, maintain strong supplier relationships and support the continuous evolution of the procurement function.


What you will be working on:

Propose and develop purchasing strategies for assigned procurement categories.
Analyze spend allocation, supplier portfolios and procurement opportunities.
Develop short-, medium- and long-term action plans including spend optimization, contract renewal strategies, supplier rationalization and risk mitigation initiatives.
Participate in defining savings targets and identifying opportunities for improvement.
Identify, evaluate and select suppliers based on quality, cost and reliability.
Lead sourcing activities including RFPs, RFQs and supplier negotiations.
Manage purchase orders and monitor delivery performance.
Build and maintain strong supplier relationships and monitor supplier performance.
Ensure compliance with procurement policies, internal controls and regulatory requirements.
Prepare procurement reports and contribute to cost control initiatives.

Job Description

We are seeking a Finance Business Partner (Business Services) based in Luxembourg (hybrid). You will partner with Business Services leadership to drive lean accounting, process optimization and AI-driven reporting, lead budgeting and forecasting cycles, and deliver actionable financial insights that improve performance. The role suits a senior, pragmatic finance professional (10+ years) with SAP and BI experience, a strong process orientation, and a proven ability to deliver under pressure.

As Senior Finance Business Partner (Business Services) you will be the finance lead embedded with Business Services, acting as a change agent to drive lean accounting, process optimization and data-driven decision making. You will tightly partner with COO (Head of Business Services) and the business services leaders to translate operational needs into actionable financial insights, streamline processes through automation and AI-enabled tools, and support performance improvement across cost, quality and delivery. This replacement role requires a senior, hands-on professional who thrives under pressure, prioritizes effectively, and contributes as a collaborative team player.

What you will be working on

• Act as the trusted finance partner to CFO, Head of Finance, COO and Business Services leadership: deliver financial insight, challenge assumptions and influence decisions.
• Act as a sparring partner to the Director of FP&A contributing to robust discussions on financial performance, forecasting assumptions, business plans, controlling model and strategic priorities.
• Lead process improvement and lean accounting initiatives to simplify workflows, reduce waste and strengthen internal controls.
• Design, develop and maintain reporting and analysis that support operational decisions — move towards near real-time, KPI-driven dashboards.
• Drive automation and AI adoption across finance processes (reporting, forecasting, reconciliations, controls), identifying opportunities for AI.
• Support monthly close activities and ensure accuracy and timeliness of financial data.
• Lead budgeting, forecasting and budgetary control processes for Business Services; provide scenario analysis and actionable recommendations.
• Translate business change needs into finance requirements and support implementation of new tools, systems or processes (working closely with Digital Accelerator team  and Finance peers).
• Deliver ad hoc financial analysis and sponsor small-to-medium projects that enhance financial performance or operating model.
• Promote financial and business awareness across the Business function and within Finance through coaching and clear communication.

What we look for

• Strong accounting and controlling background with a minimum of 10 years' relevant experience.
• Advanced Excel; experience with SAP finance modules and Reporting tools.
• Hands-on familiarity with automation/AI tools or demonstrable appetite and experience driving such initiatives.
• Solid budgeting, forecasting and financial modelling skills.
• Excellent communication and presentation skills in English; other languages an asset.
• Proven track record in a finance business partnering role supporting shared services, central functions or similar.
• Demonstrable experience running process improvement projects and delivering automation/AI-driven efficiencies.
• Comfortable operating independently, handling ambiguous situations and escalating appropriately.
• Behavioral skills and competencies: growth mindset, change agent, process-oriented, detail focused, pressure management, team work, decision quality and uphold KPMG firm standars.
• Professional accounting qualification (ACCA, CPA, CFA or equivalent) and experience in professional services or the Big Four environment as an asset.

jobs.title: Directeur amélioration continue (m/f)
jobs.description:
Description des tâches:

Director, Continuous Improvement and Industry 4.0

• Zone Industrielle P.E.D, BP 38, Rodange, Luxembourg, Luxembourg Employees work in a hybrid mode
• Full-time
• Compensation: EUR 116,340 - EUR 186,144 - yearly

Job Description

Are you ready to architect the future of Advanced Manufacturing?
At the Materials Group (MG), we are not just optimizing operations, we are redefining them. We are seeking a visionary and dynamic Director, Continuous Improvement and Industry 4.0  to lead our central Enterprise Lean System (ELS) function.
This is a high-impact, regional executive role designed for an operational architect who can bridge the gap between world-class, foundational Lean Six Sigma methodologies and cutting-edge Industry 4.0 technologies (AI, Predictive Analytics, and Cognitive Automation). Based in our Rodange facility, you will hold the keys to regional standardization, capability building, and digital supply chain transformation across Europe.

The Challenge & The Vision

As the Director of Central ELS, you will play two pivotal roles: the Guardian of Standards and the Pioneer of Innovation.
You will lead a high-performing central team to drive continuous improvement, establishing a high-margin production environment. Concurrently, you will orchestrate the transition from manual Lean frameworks to an AI-driven "Lighthouse Factory" footprint, leveraging predictive models, virtual environments, and connected systems.

Key Responsibilities

1. Guardian of Operational & Supply Chain Standards

• Act as the regional "Center as Guardian," serving as the sole architect of operational standards in the Regional Playbook.
• Govern all core manufacturing work standards (5S, Standard Work Audits, Daily Tier Meetings, Kaizen, SMED, TPM, and OEE Tracking/Loss Analysis).
• Establish robust supply chain standards, covering Production Planning Logic, Inventory Buffer Protocols, Freight Spend Governance, and S&OP Integration.
• Govern and standardize Data Science & AI models across the region.

2. Capability Builder & Training Academy Leader

• Standardize regional workforce mindsets and skillsets through a centralized regional training engine.
• Maintain the end-to-end certification pathway for Yellow, Green, and Black Belt mastery, alongside modern Digital Literacy pathways.
• Design functionally deep training curricula and scale execution through "Train-the-Trainer" initiatives with local site leaders.

3. Orchestrator of Strategy Deployment

• Lead the Yearly Strategic Deployment process ensuring 100% functional alignment between Sales, Marketing, Operations, Supply Chain, Finance, HR, and IT.
• Utilize the Annual Operating Plan (AOP) and key performance metrics to establish regional breakthrough targets.
• Facilitate the collaborative "Catchball" process to negotiate and lock departmental action plans.
• Manage the monthly governance framework for PDCA reviews at executive and functional levels.

4. Pioneer of ELS 4.0 & Digital Twin Innovation

• Drive the shift to automated, AI-driven operations, implementing predictive models that empower local sites to preempt issues.
• Lead shopfloor IoT integration, ensuring machines feed real-time performance data directly into core IT systems.
• Deploy a Regional Control Tower live-dashboard to visualize the entire end-to-end supply chain.
• Deploy advanced solutions for AI-Driven Predictive Quality, Maintenance, Cognitive Automation, and dynamic 3D Digital Twin simulations.

5. Champion of the Hub & Spoke Model

• Serve as the central regional filter and amplifier for operational innovation.
• Capture best-in-class local site innovations directly from the Gemba, codifying validated successes into the "Gold Standard" regional playbook for network-wide deployment.

6. High-Performing Team Leader

• Cultivate an inspiring team culture rooted in high performance, psychological safety, and radical accountability.
• Mentor and coach a dedicated central team, providing clear career development pathways and fostering cross-functional collaboration.

Qualifications

Who You Are

• The Expert: You possess extensive experience leading Lean, Six Sigma, and Continuous Improvement functions on a regional or global scale.
• The Digital Native: You have a proven track record of implementing Industry 4.0 solutions (IoT, Predictive Maintenance, AI, or Digital Twins) within a manufacturing environment.
• The Architect: You excel at designing, documenting, and scaling operational systems and standards from scratch.
• The Communicator: You are an expert at navigating Hoshin Kanri / Strategic Deployment, bringing diverse stakeholders (from the shopfloor to the C-suite) along on the transformation journey.
• The People Developer: You love building capability, leading academies, and mentoring future operational leaders.

• Location: We welcome candidates residing near any of our major manufacturing hubs in Luxembourg, France, the UK, Germany, or Belgium.

Additional Information

Why join Avery Dennison:  We are a global materials science and digital identification solutions company with locations in over 50 countries, and approximately 35,000 employees worldwide. As a science and innovation company, we believe that diverse teams are stronger teams. We are committed to fostering a culture of curiosity and courage, where you can grow your career with a company that has innovation in its DNA. Founded on creating real-world impact to enable a better future, we strive to provide an open, collaborative culture where diversity of thought is encouraged and respected. Hear from our employees about what it's like working at Avery Dennison. Learn more at www.averydennison.com.At Avery Dennison, we work with the biggest brands in the FMCG, apparel, automotive, and pharma industries. Our Rodange Site Avery Dennison Luxembourg Sàrl location, founded in 1989, is a collaborative and dynamic environment that supports our Label and Packaging Materials Group division and employs approximately 540 talented individuals. Key functions at this site include Operations, Customer Service, central teams and various support functions, offering diverse career paths and opportunities for growth.

Equal Opportunity Employer:  Avery Dennison is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability, protected veteran status, or any other protected status. If you are unable to use our online application process due to a disability, please contact us to request an accommodation at Requestaccomodation@eu.averydennison.com. In the EMEA region, we foster an inclusive culture through active Employee Resource Groups (ERGs) like Elevate, Unite, and our Mental Health group. Please visit our DE&I page to learn more about our Diversity, Equity & Inclusion approach.

Pay Transparency Statement:  The salary range for this position is 116340 - 186144 EUR / year.

The hiring base salary range above represents what Avery Dennison reasonably expects to pay for this position as of the date of this posting. Actual salaries will vary within the range, and in some circumstances may be above or below the range, based on various factors including but not limited to a candidate's relevant skills, experience, education and training, and location, as well as the job scope and complexity, responsibilities, and regular and/or necessary travel required for the position, which may change depending on the candidate pool. Définir et piloter la stratégie d'architecture en cohérence avec les ambitions du Groupe et les besoins métiers.
Concevoir et maintenir les cartographies d'architecture (fonctionnelle, applicative, technique, data) pour garantir une vision globale et évolutive du SI.
Accompagner les projets stratégiques en assurant leur alignement avec les principes d'architecture, la sécurité, la scalabilité et la conformité réglementaire.
Collaborer avec les directions métier et IT pour identifier les opportunités de rationalisation, modernisation et innovation.
Déployer une approche basée sur les principes : Strategy aligned, Design First, Cloud Native & AI-Powered Systems, Secure & Compliant by design.
Animer les ateliers et instances de gouvernance d'architecture.
Assurer une veille technologique active et gérer le cycle de vie des solutions dans un Tech Radar.
Intégrer les enjeux Cloud, IA, cybersécurité et durabilité dans les choix d'architecture.


Votre profil :

Expérience confirmée en architecture d'entreprise dans des environnements complexes et en transformation.
Maîtrise des frameworks (TOGAF, C4, UML…) et des outils de modélisation.
Solides compétences en modélisation fonctionnelle et systémique.
Bonne connaissance des architectures Cloud, microservices, API, data-centric et des enjeux de sécurité.
Capacité à dialoguer avec les Comités de Direction et vulgariser les concepts techniques.
Leadership reconnu, sens de la pédagogie et orientation résultats.
Expérience en environnement agile.
Intérêt marqué pour les architectures émergentes en IA Engineering (agents autonomes, MCP, RAG…).


Notre offre :

En rejoignant notre Groupe, vous bénéficierez, entre autres, des avantages suivants :
Un environnement de travail multiculturel, apprenant et innovant,
Un système d'horaire flexible,
Un restaurant d'entreprise à tarif préférentiel,
Une salle de sport avec coach,
Une conciergerie.

jobs.title: Erfaren cykelmekaniker med sans for salg søges
jobs.description:
Vi søger ikke bare en mekaniker – vi søger den person, der kan blive butikkens ansigt udadtil og tage ansvar, som var det sin egen forretning.

Er du en dygtig og selvstændig cykelmekaniker med solid erfaring? Trives du med ansvar, kundekontakt og en varieret hverdag, hvor du selv er med til at få butikken til at fungere? Så er det måske dig, vi leder efter.

Om jobbet

Vi søger en erfaren cykelmekaniker, der kan tage ansvar for både butik og værksted i det daglige. Du skal være tryg ved at arbejde selvstændigt og kunne håndtere alt fra almindelige serviceeftersyn til fejlfinding og større reparationer på alle typer cykler, herunder ladcykler - har du erfaring med elcykler, er det et plus.

Vi forestiller os, at du:

* Har flere års erfaring som cykelmekaniker.

* Kan diagnosticere og løse alle typer mekaniske problemer på cykler.

* Er vant til at arbejde alene og tage ansvar for dagens opgaver.

* Er serviceminded og god til at rådgive kunder.

* Arbejder struktureret, effektivt og med fokus på kvalitet.

* Forstår at mersalg er en del af servicen.

Vi tilbyder

* En konkurrencedygtig løn, der matcher dine kvalifikationer.

* En varieret hverdag i en lille, lokal cykelbutik i Søborg.

* Stor frihed under ansvar og mulighed for at præge den daglige drift.

* Et uformelt arbejdsmiljø med korte beslutningsveje.

* Mulighed for at blive en vigtig del af en butik, hvor godt håndværk og god kundeservice er i fokus. Vi sætter pris på vores ⭐️'er.

Lyder det som noget for dig?

Så send din ansøgning og dit CV på mailen nedenunder. Vi afholder samtaler løbende og ansætter, når vi har fundet den rette kandidat.

Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig.

Michelle Rasmussen

JM Cykler

kontakt@jmcykler.dk

jobs.title: Solutions Architect, Public Sector - East
Design Engineer (Web & Brand)
jobs.description:
At Linear, we're building the product development system for teams and agents. AI is fundamentally changing how software gets built, and we’re shaping the tools this new era requires.

Founded in 2019, Linear has become the platform of choice for more than 40,000 companies (including OpenAI, Coinbase, and Ramp) to plan, build, and ship their products. Today, our team is distributed across North America, Europe, and Australia, and we’re continuing to grow internationally. What unites us is relentless focus, fast execution, and a deep care for software craftsmanship.

We're looking for a Design Engineer with strong visual taste to help drive our creative initiatives across web and brand. When it comes to design and code, we’re looking to work with experienced people who can pick up any problem and solve it. For us, it’s both how it works and how it looks. At its core, Linear is a developer tool where speed, interactions, and small details matter. We expect a broad set of design skills and the ability to create high-quality designs, interactions, and prototypes.

In this role, you will help communicate Linear's story—what we're building and why it matters—as part of our internal creative agency: the Magic Team.

What you'll do

 - You will be responsible for building complex and interactive UI web/app experiences

 - Build beautiful, responsive websites, landing pages, and internal tools

 - Implement creative animations and interactions in code

 - Explore visual design in Figma and translate it to web-native experiences

What we're looking for

 - Eye for good design

 - Strong frontend engineering skills

 - Experience building end-to-end websites and landing pages

 - Experience with React and TypeScript

 - Experience using agentic coding tools as part of the design process (from exploring ideas to building production-quality interactions)

 - A portfolio or Twitter profile showcasing a range of technical skills, a creative use of code, and prototyping skills

What we offer

 - Interesting and challenging work

 - Work life balance

 - Competitive salary and equity

 - Employee-friendly equity terms (extended exercise)

 - Paid lunch and coffee during work days

 - Work remotely, no commuting to the office

 - Paid co-working space/desk at an office

 - Regular team events and offsites

 - 5 weeks paid vacation

 - 4 months paid parental leave
